Specifically, we introduce a semantic-aware visual feature extraction framework that applies a cross-attention mechanism to visual class tokens from intermediate Transformer layers, guided by textual cues to extract visual features with coarse-to-fine semantics. We then embed the feature trees of the two modalities into hyperbolic manifolds with distinct curvatures to effectively model their hierarchical structures. To align across the heterogeneous hyperbolic manifolds with different curvatures, we formulate a KL distance measure between distributions on heterogeneous manifolds, and learn an intermediate manifold for manifold alignment by minimizing the distance. We prove the existence and uniqueness of the optimal intermediate manifold. Experiments on taxonomic open-set classification tasks across multiple image datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines under few-shot and cross-domain settings.

</details>


### [136] [Dual-Stream Diffusion for World-Model Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.27607)
*John Won,Kyungmin Lee,Huiwon Jang,Dongyoung Kim,Jinwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DUST框架，一种基于双流扩散Transformer的世界模型增强型视觉-语言-动作模型(VLA)，通过独立模态流、解耦流匹配损失和异步采样技术，在模拟和真实机器人任务上显著提升了策略学习性能，并支持无动作视频预训练和异构数据集联合训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作模型(VLA)结合世界模型在机器人策略学习中面临挑战，主要问题是模态差异导致难以联合预测状态和动作。

Method: 提出了DUST（双流扩散）框架：1) 多模态扩散Transformer，保持独立模态流同时支持跨模态知识共享；2) 独立噪声扰动+解耦流匹配损失，用于学习跨模态因果关系；3) 异步采样方法，对动作和视觉token分别采样以提升推理时性能。

Result: 在RoboCasa和GR-1模拟基准上，DUST相比SOTA VLA和世界模型基线提升最高6%，推理时缩放额外提升2-5%；在Franka Research 3真实任务中成功率领先基线10%。

Conclusion: DUST通过双流扩散设计有效解决了VLA与世界模型结合中的模态差距问题，同时展示了在无动作视频预训练和异构数据集联合训练中的迁移学习能力。

Abstract: Augmenting vision-language-action models (VLAs) with world models is promising for robotic policy learning but faces challenges in jointly predicting states and actions due to the modality gap. To address this, we propose DUal-STream diffusion (DUST), a world-model augmented VLA framework featuring a multimodal diffusion transformer that maintains separate modality streams while enabling cross-modal knowledge sharing. In addition, DUST utilizes independent noise perturbations and a decoupled flow matching loss to learn cross-modal causal relationships. We further introduce an asynchronous sampling method for action and vision tokens that enhances performance through inference-time scaling. Experimental results on simulated benchmarks like RoboCasa and GR-1 show that DUST achieves up to 6% gains over state-of-the-art VLA and world-modeling baselines, with inference-time scaling providing an additional 2-5% improvement. In real-world tasks using the Franka Research 3, DUST outperforms baselines by 10% in success rate. Finally, we demonstrate that DUST enables effective transfer learning through both pretraining on action-free videos and joint-training with heterogeneous robot and human datasets.

</details>


### [137] [OmniAID: Decoupling Semantic and Artifacts for Universal AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08423)
*Yuncheng Guo,Junyan Ye,Chenjue Zhang,Hengrui Kang,Haohuan Fu,Conghui He,Weijia Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OmniAID框架，通过解耦混合专家架构分离内容相关缺陷与通用伪影，并构建Mirage数据集，在AIGI检测任务上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AIGI检测方法学习单一纠缠的伪造表示，混淆了内容依赖缺陷与内容无关伪影，且受限于过时的基准数据集，无法实现对多样生成模型和语义内容的通用检测。

Method: 采用解耦混合专家（MoE）架构：(1) 可路由专用语义专家处理不同内容域的语义缺陷；(2) 固定通用伪影专家处理内容无关的通用伪影。两阶段训练策略：先通过领域特定硬采样独立训练专家，再训练轻量级门控网络进行输入路由。

Result: 在自建的Mirage大规模当代数据集上，OmniAID超越现有检测器，树立了针对现代野外威胁的AIGI检测新标准。

Conclusion: 通过显式解耦"生成内容"（内容特定缺陷）与"生成方式"（通用伪影），OmniAID实现了鲁棒的泛化能力。

Abstract: A truly universal AI-Generated Image (AIGI) detector must simultaneously generalize across diverse generative models and varied semantic content. Current methods learn a single, entangled forgery representation, conflating content-dependent flaws with content-agnostic artifacts, and are further constrained by outdated benchmarks. We propose OmniAID, a novel framework centered on a decoupled Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture that separates: (1) semantic flaws across distinct content domains via Routable Specialized Semantic Experts, and (2) content-agnostic universal artifacts from content-dependent flaws via a Fixed Universal Artifact Expert. A two-stage training strategy first specializes experts independently with domain-specific hard-sampling, then trains a lightweight gating network for effective input routing. By explicitly decoupling "what is generated" (content-specific flaws) from "how it is generated" (universal artifacts), OmniAID achieves robust generalization. We also introduce Mirage, a large-scale, contemporary dataset comprising a modern training set and a challenging test set. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniAID surpasses existing detectors, establishing a new standard for AIGI detection against modern, in-the-wild threats. Code is available at https://github.com/yunncheng/OmniAID.

</details>


### [138] [An accuracy-aware extension to LRP-based pruning for CNNs to prevent cascading accuracy degradation in data-scarce transfer learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.10861)
*Daisuke Yasui,Toshitaka Matsuki,Hiroshi Sato*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于LRP的精度感知剪枝控制机制，通过动态调整剪枝率和剪枝顺序（使用类别精度的调和平均数），有效抑制了级联精度下降，在少量数据场景下提升了预训练CNN模型的压缩效果和分类精度，VGG16的AUC提升约15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LRP的过滤器剪枝方法在少量数据场景下存在级联精度下降问题，需要一种机制在保持任务性能的同时有效压缩预训练模型。

Method: 提出精度感知的剪枝控制机制，利用类别精度的调和平均数动态调整剪枝率和剪枝顺序，以抑制级联精度下降。

Result: 该机制有效缓解了级联精度下降，相比现有LRP剪枝方法获得更高的分类精度，VGG16上类别平均AUC提升约15%。

Conclusion: 精度感知的剪枝控制机制在少量数据环境下能有效压缩预训练模型并保持任务性能。

Abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) pre-trained on large-scale datasets such as ImageNet are widely used as feature extractors to construct high-accuracy classification models from scarce data for specific tasks. In such scenarios, fine-tuning the pre-trained CNN is difficult due to data scarcity, necessitating the use of fixed weights. However, when the weights are kept fixed, many filters that do not contribute to the target task remain in the model, leading to unnecessary redundancy and reduced efficiency. Therefore, effective methods are needed to reduce model size by pruning filters that are unnecessary for inference. To address this, approaches utilizing Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) have been proposed. LRP quantifies the contribution of each filter to the inference result, enabling the pruning of filters with low relevance. However, existing LRP-based pruning methods have been observed to cause cascading accuracy degradation. In this study, we introduce an accuracy-aware pruning control mechanism for existing LRP-based filter pruning methods, which suppresses cascading accuracy degradation by dynamically adjusting the pruning rate and the pruning order using the harmonic mean of class accuracy, and compresses the pre-trained model while preserving task-specific performance in a small-data environment. We demonstrate that this control mechanism effectively mitigates cascading accuracy degradation and achieves higher classification accuracy compared to existing LRP-based pruning methods, improving the class-averaged area under the accuracy-pruning-rate curve (AUC) of VGG16 by approximately 15\% over conventional LRP-based approaches.

</details>


### [139] [Evaluating Dataset Watermarking for Fine-tuning Traceability of Customized Diffusion Models: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Removal Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.19316)
*Xincheng Wang,Hanchi Sun,Wenjun Sun,Kejun Xue,Wangqiu Zhou,Jianbo Zhang,Wei Sun,Dandan Zhu,Xiongkuo Min,Jun Jia,Zhijun Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型数据集水印技术缺乏统一评估框架的问题，提出了包含通用性、可传递性和鲁棒性的综合评估体系，并揭示现有方法在真实威胁场景下的脆弱性，进而提出一种能完全移除水印且不影响微调效果的实用攻击方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型数据集水印技术缺乏统一的评估框架，无法系统衡量其在真实世界威胁场景下的有效性。

Method: 建立通用威胁模型，提出包含Universality（通用性）、Transmissibility（可传递性）和Robustness（鲁棒性）三个维度的综合评估框架；在此基础上设计了一种实用的水印移除方法。

Result: 现有方法在通用性和可传递性上表现良好，对常见图像处理操作具有一定鲁棒性，但在真实威胁场景下仍存在脆弱性。提出的水印移除方法能完全消除数据集水印而不影响微调效果。

Conclusion: 当前数据集水印技术在面对实际威胁时存在显著不足，亟需更具鲁棒性的防御方案；所提出的水印移除方法为未来研究指明了挑战方向。

Abstract: Recent fine-tuning techniques for diffusion models enable them to reproduce specific image sets, such as particular faces or artistic styles, but also introduce copyright and security risks. Dataset watermarking has been proposed to ensure traceability by embedding imperceptible watermarks into training images, which remain detectable in outputs even after fine-tuning. However, current methods lack a unified evaluation framework. To address this, this paper establishes a general threat model and introduces a comprehensive evaluation framework encompassing Universality, Transmissibility, and Robustness. Experiments show that existing methods perform well in universality and transmissibility, and exhibit some robustness against common image processing operations, yet still fall short under real-world threat scenarios. To reveal these vulnerabilities, the paper further proposes a practical watermark removal method that fully eliminates dataset watermarks without affecting fine-tuning, highlighting a key challenge for future research.

</details>


### [140] [AlignVid: Training-Free Attention Scaling for Semantic Fidelity in Text-Guided Image-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01334)
*Yexin Liu,Wen-Jie Shu,Zile Huang,Haoze Zheng,Yueze Wang,Jingjin Zhu,Manyuan Zhang,Ser-Nam Lim,Harry Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AlignVid提出了一种无需训练的干预方法，通过注意力缩放调制（ASM）和引导调度（GS）来解决文本引导图像到视频生成中因视觉主导导致的语义偏差问题，并在新提出的OmitI2V基准上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本引导图像到视频生成方法在处理需要大幅改变参考图像（如物体添加、移除或修改）的文本编辑时表现不佳，原因是参考图像造成的视觉主导导致注意力分散，抑制了模型融合新语义信息的能力。

Method: 提出AlignVid，一种无需训练的注意力干预方法：1）注意力缩放调制（ASM）——基于注意力能量视角，降低注意力熵，使注意力集中于语义token；2）引导调度（GS）——维持生成稳定性。同时构建OmitI2V基准来评估物体修改、添加和删除任务。

Result: 大量实验表明AlignVid在几乎不增加计算开销的情况下有效提升了语义保真度。

Conclusion: AlignVid通过重新校准内部注意力分布，有效解决了图像到视频生成中视觉主导导致的语义编辑困难问题，代码和基准已开源。

Abstract: Text-guided image-to-video generation has made substantial progress, yet it still struggles to execute text-specified edits that require substantial changes to a reference image (\textit{e.g., object addition, removal, or modification}). Empirically, our analysis reveals that this stems from \textbf{visual dominance}, where the reference image causes severe attention dispersion, inhibiting the model's ability to incorporate new semantic information. To address this, we propose \textbf{AlignVid}, a training-free intervention that re-calibrates the model's internal attention distribution. Drawing on an energy-based perspective of attention, AlignVid employs Attention Scaling Modulation (\textbf{ASM}) to reduce attention entropy and concentrate focus on semantic tokens, alongside Guidance Scheduling (\textbf{GS}) to maintain generation stability. To rigorously assess this capability, we present \textbf{OmitI2V}, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating prompt adherence across object modification, addition, and deletion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AlignVid effectively enhances semantic fidelity with negligible computational overhead. Code and the OmitI2V benchmark are available at https://github.com/LAW1223/AlignVid.

</details>


### [141] [E3AD: An Emotion-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for Human-Centric End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.04733)
*Yihong Tang,Haicheng Liao,Tong Nie,Junlin He,Ao Qu,Kehua Chen,Wei Ma,Zhenning Li,Lijun Sun,Chengzhong Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出E3AD，一个情感感知的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，通过连续VAD情感模型和双路径空间推理模块实现开放域端到端自动驾驶，在情感估计和路径规划上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶系统采用VLA模型，但忽略了乘客情感状态对舒适度和AD接受度的重要性。本文提出开放域端到端自动驾驶，要求车辆理解自由形式自然语言指令、推断情感并规划物理可行轨迹。

Method: 提出E3AD框架：1) 连续Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD)情感模型捕捉语言中的语气和紧迫性；2) 双路径空间推理模块融合自我中心视角和外部视角实现类人空间认知；3) 一致性导向训练方案，结合模态预训练和基于偏好的对齐，强化情感意图与驾驶行为之间的一致性。

Result: 在真实世界数据集上，E3AD在视觉定位和路径规划上取得提升，情感估计的VAD相关性达到SOTA。

Conclusion: 将情感注入VLA风格的驾驶系统能够产生更符合人类期望的定位、规划和反馈。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving (AD) systems increasingly adopt vision-language-action (VLA) models, yet they typically ignore the passenger's emotional state, which is central to comfort and AD acceptance. We introduce Open-Domain End-to-End (OD-E2E) autonomous driving, where an autonomous vehicle (AV) must interpret free-form natural-language commands, infer the emotion, and plan a physically feasible trajectory. We propose E3AD, an emotion-aware VLA framework that augments semantic understanding with two cognitively inspired components: a continuous Valenc-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) emotion model that captures tone and urgency from language, and a dual-pathway spatial reasoning module that fuses egocentric and allocentric views for human-like spatial cognition. A consistency-oriented training scheme, combining modality pretraining with preference-based alignment, further enforces coherence between emotional intent and driving actions. Across real-world datasets, E3AD improves visual grounding and waypoint planning and achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) VAD correlation for emotion estimation. These evaluation results show that injecting emotion into VLA-style driving yields more human-aligned grounding, planning, and feedback.

</details>


### [142] [Lightweight Complementary-Cue Fusion for Robust Video Face Forgery Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29092)
*Sunghwan Baek,Tariq Anwaar,Karanveer Singh,Rita Singh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级融合方法（仅增加292个参数），通过将低频小波去噪特征与相位谱通道或局部二值模式结合，在Xception基线模型（2190万参数）上提升了人脸视频伪造检测的AUC性能（FaceForensics++上从74.8%升至78.6%，DFDC-Preview上从70.5%升至74.9%），以极小代价超越F3Net、SRM等大型模型，表明手工特征+轻量融合在伪造检测中具有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的人脸视频伪造检测方法倾向于使用宽或双流骨干网络，模型庞大且计算成本高。本文旨在探索是否可以通过精心搭配的手工特征和轻量融合方式，在保持模型轻量化的同时获得具有竞争力的检测性能，从而质疑当前过度追求模型规模的趋势。

Method: 基于Xception基线模型（2190万参数），构建两个检测器：LFWS在Xception基础上通过1×1卷积融合低频小波去噪特征（WDF）与来自空间-相位浅层学习（SPSL）的相位谱通道；LFWL融合WDF与局部二值模式（LBP）。融合模块仅增加292个参数，使模型总参数量保持2190万。

Result: 在FaceForensics++上AUC从74.8%提升至78.6%（+3.8%），在DFDC-Preview上从70.5%提升至74.9%（+4.4%），在8个公开基准测试中一致优于F3Net、SRM和SPSL，且未使用额外数据或测试时增强。

Conclusion: 精心配对的手工特征通过轻量融合块可以以极低的计算成本获得与基于频率的大规模检测器相媲美的鲁棒性，提示研究者需要重新评估人脸视频伪造检测中模型规模驱动的设计选择。

Abstract: Current face video forgery detectors use wide or dual-stream backbones. We show that a single, lightweight fusion of two handcrafted cues can achieve higher accuracy with a much smaller model. Based on the Xception baseline model (21.9 million parameters), we build two detectors: LFWS, which adds a 1x1 convolution to combine a low-frequency Wavelet-Denoised Feature (WDF) with a phase-spectrum channel derived from Spatial-Phase Shallow Learning (SPSL), and LFWL, which merges WDF with Local Binary Patterns (LBP) in the same way. This extra module adds only 292 parameters, keeping the total at 21.9 million, smaller than F3Net (22.5 million) and less than half the size of SRM (55.3 million). Even with this minimal overhead, the fused models increase the average area under the curve (AUC) from 74.8% to 78.6% on FaceForensics++ and from 70.5% to 74.9% on DFDC-Preview, gains of 3.8% and 4.4% over the Xception baseline. They also consistently outperform F3Net, SRM, and SPSL in eight public benchmarks, without extra data or test-time augmentation. These results show that carefully paired, handcrafted features, combined through the lightweight fusion block, can provide competitive robustness at a significantly lower cost than comparable frequency-based detectors. Our findings suggest a need to reevaluate scale-driven design choices in face video forgery detection.

</details>


### [143] [MATANet: A Multi-context Attention and Taxonomy-Aware Network for Fine-Grained Underwater Recognition of Marine Species](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03729)
*Donghwan Lee,Byeongjin Kim,Geunhee Kim,Hyukjin Kwon,Nahyeon Maeng,Wooju Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MATANet框架，通过多尺度环境上下文注意力与层级感知表征学习，显著提升水下生物细粒度分类性能，在多个基准数据集上超越现有方法，并在CVPR 2025 FGVC12 FathomNet挑战赛中获第一名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有细粒度海洋生物识别方法主要依赖物体或ROI中心表示，在视觉相似生物常出现在多样环境条件的挑战性水下场景中判别性能受限。

Method: 提出MATANet框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 多尺度环境注意力模块(MCEAM)，建模ROI与多尺度周围环境区域间的交叉注意力，融合局部形态与栖息地上下文信息；(2) 层级感知表征学习模块(HRLM)，利用分类层级作为辅助监督，正则化表征学习并鼓励跨层级的语义结构化嵌入。

Result: 在FathomNet2025和LifeCLEF2015-Fish数据集上持续超越现有方法；在FAIR1M遥感数据集上验证了框架的泛化能力；在CVPR 2025 FGVC12 FathomNet挑战赛中荣获第一名。

Conclusion: 联合建模生物外观、环境上下文和分类层级结构，可学习更具判别性的细粒度分类表征，方法适用于水下及其他领域图像识别任务。

Abstract: Fine-grained recognition of marine organisms is important for ecological research, biodiversity monitoring, habitat conservation, and evidence-based policy-making. However, many existing approaches primarily rely on object- or ROI-centered representations. These limitations can reduce discriminative performance in challenging underwater scenes, where visually similar organisms often appear under diverse environmental conditions. To address these challenges, we propose MATANet (Multi-context Attention and Taxonomy-Aware Network), a framework for fine-grained taxonomic recognition of marine organisms. MATANet is motivated by expert taxonomic identification practices, in which both organism-level morphology and contextual cues are considered during recognition. The framework consists of two main components. First, the Multi-Context Environmental Attention Module (MCEAM) models cross-attention between the primary region of interest (ROI) and multi-scale surrounding environmental regions, thereby combining local morphological cues with habitat-level contextual information. Second, the Hierarchy-Aware Representation Learning Module (HRLM) uses taxonomic hierarchy as auxiliary supervision to regularize representation learning and encourage semantically structured embeddings across taxonomic levels. By jointly modeling organism appearance, environmental context, and taxonomic structure, MATANet learns more discriminative representations for fine-grained taxonomic recognition. Experiments on FathomNet2025 and LifeCLEF2015-Fish demonstrate that MATANet consistently improves recognition performance over existing methods. Additional experiments on FAIR1M further examine the applicability of the proposed framework beyond underwater imagery. Notably, MATANet ranked first in the FathomNet 2025 Challenge at the CVPR 2025 FGVC12 workshop.

</details>


### [144] [Multi-Scale Local Speculative Decoding for Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05149)
*Elia Peruzzo,Guillaume Sautière,Amirhossein Habibian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MuLo-SD，一种多尺度局部投机解码框架，通过低分辨率草稿模型与高分辨率目标模型结合，并引入局部拒绝和重采样机制，在保持图像质量的同时实现最高5倍加速，成为图像合成投机解码的新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归图像模型因序列生成特性存在显著延迟瓶颈，现有投机解码方法受限于令牌级歧义和缺乏空间感知能力，亟需一种能兼顾效率与保真度的加速方案。

Method: 采用低分辨率草稿模型配合上采样模块生成候选令牌，由高分辨率目标模型并行验证；核心创新是局部拒绝与重采样机制，通过聚焦空间邻域而非光栅扫描顺序来高效修正草稿错误，并集成了并行解码重采样。

Result: 在GenEval、DPG-Bench和MS-COCO 5K验证集上，MuLo-SD实现最高5倍加速，优于现有投机解码和并行解码基线，同时保持可比的语义对齐和感知质量。

Conclusion: MuLo-SD通过多尺度草稿与空间感知验证的有机结合，填补了图像合成中效率与保真度之间的鸿沟，为投机解码在图像生成领域设立了新标杆。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models have achieved remarkable success in image synthesis, yet their sequential nature imposes significant latency constraints. Speculative Decoding offers a promising avenue for acceleration, but existing approaches are limited by token-level ambiguity and lack of spatial awareness. In this work, we introduce Multi-Scale Local Speculative Decoding (MuLo-SD), a novel framework that combines multi-resolution drafting with spatially informed verification to accelerate AR image generation. Our method leverages a low-resolution drafter paired with an up-sampling step to propose candidate image tokens, which are then verified in parallel by a high-resolution target model. Crucially, we incorporate a local rejection and resampling mechanism, enabling efficient correction of draft errors by focusing on spatial neighborhoods rather than raster-scan resampling after the first rejection. When integrated with parallel decoding resampling, MuLo-SD achieves substantial speedups -- up to $\mathbf{5\times}$ -- outperforming both speculative decoding and parallel decoding baselines in terms of acceleration, while maintaining comparable semantic alignment and perceptual quality. These results are validated using GenEval, DPG-Bench, and FID/HPSv2 on the MS-COCO 5k validation split. Extensive ablations highlight the impact of up-sampling design, probability pooling, and local rejection and resampling with neighborhood expansion. Our approach sets a new state-of-the-art in speculative decoding for image synthesis, bridging the gap between efficiency and fidelity. Project page is available at https://qualcomm-ai-research.github.io/mulo-sd-webpage/ .

</details>


### [145] [Video Individual Counting and Tracking from Moving Drones: A Benchmark and Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.12500)
*Yaowu Fan,Jia Wan,Tao Han,Andy J. Ma,Wanli Ouyang,Antoni B. Chan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MovingDroneConeCrowd++数据集和GD3A（计数）及DVTrack（跟踪）方法，用于快速移动无人机拍摄的大规模密集人群计数与跟踪。GD3A通过最优传输与自适应dustbin分数建立像素级描述子对应，再通过分组关联将全局密度图分解为共享、流入、流出密度图；DVTrack通过描述子投票将描述子级匹配转化为实例级关联。实验表明，计数误差降低47.4%，跟踪精度提升64.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法大多依赖固定相机数据集，场景覆盖有限，无法满足大规模场景下密集人群分析的需求。移动无人机拍摄的视频存在飞行高度、角度和光照条件多变、人群密集且运动复杂等挑战，现有方法难以取得满意的视频个体计数与跟踪性能。

Method: 1) GD3A：通过最优传输与自适应dustbin分数建立帧间像素级描述子对应，再采用分组关联指导全局密度图分解为共享、流入、流出密度图；2) DVTrack：通过描述子投票将描述子级匹配转化为实例级关联；核心思想是基于每个行人的分组多描述子关联结果，而非单一向量，组内匹配误差不影响最终结果。

Result: 在移动无人机密集人群视频上，计数误差降低47.4%，跟踪精度提升64.6%。

Conclusion: 提出的GD3A和DVTrack方法在密集人群和复杂空中条件下具有更强的鲁棒性，显著优于现有方法；数据集、代码和预训练模型已开源。

Abstract: Counting and tracking dense crowds in large-scale scenes is a highly practical yet challenging problem. Existing methods mostly rely on fixed-camera datasets with limited scene coverage, making them inadequate for crowd analysis in large-scale scenes. To bridge this gap, we introduce MovingDroneCrowd++, the largest video-level dataset dedicated to dense crowd counting and tracking with fast-moving drones, captured under diverse flight altitudes, camera angles, and illumination conditions. Existing methods, however, still fail to achieve satisfactory video individual counting or tracking performance under these challenging aerial conditions. To this end, we propose GD3A (Global Density map Decomposition via group-wise Descriptor Association), a video individual counting method that first establishes pixel-level correspondences between pedestrian descriptors across frames via optimal transport with an adaptive dustbin score. Then, group-wise association is adopted to guide the decomposition of the global density map into shared, inflow, and outflow density maps. We further introduce a pedestrian tracking method, DVTrack (Descriptor Voting Track), which converts descriptor-level matching into instance-level association through descriptor voting. Our methods rely on the association results of group-wise multiple descriptors for each pedestrian rather than a single vector. Since intra-group matching errors do not affect the final counting and tracking results, our methods are more robust in dense crowds and challenging aerial conditions. Experiments show that our methods achieve substantial gains in both crowd counting and tracking on moving-drone videos with dense crowds and complex motions, reducing counting error by 47.4% and improving tracking accuracy by 64.6%. Code, dataset, and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/fyw1999/MovingDroneCrowd.

</details>


### [146] [4DPC$^2$hat: Towards Dynamic Point Cloud Understanding with Failure-Aware Bootstrapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03890)
*Xindan Zhang,Weilong Yan,Yufei Shi,Xuerui Qiu,Tao He,Ying Li,Ming Li,Hehe Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出4DPC²hat，首个针对动态点云序列理解的多模态大语言模型，通过构建大规模跨模态数据集4DPC²hat-200K（含44K动态序列、200K QA对）、Mamba增强时序推理架构和失败感知自举学习策略，显著提升了动作理解与时序推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM主要聚焦静态3D物体理解，对动态点云序列的理解几乎空白，主要受限于大规模跨模态数据集缺失以及时-空上下文中运动建模的困难。

Method: 1) 构建大规模数据集4DPC²hat-200K：采用拓扑一致4D点构建+两层级标注的两阶段流程；2) 提出Mamba增强时序推理MLLM，捕获点云序列的长程依赖与动态模式；3) 提出失败感知自举学习策略，迭代识别模型缺陷并生成针对性QA监督以增强推理能力。

Result: 在动作理解和时序推理任务上，4DPC²hat显著优于现有模型，为4D动态点云理解建立了坚实基础。

Conclusion: 4DPC²hat有效填补了动态点云序列理解领域空白，其数据集构建方法、时序推理架构和自举学习策略为后续研究提供了重要基础。

Abstract: Point clouds provide a compact and expressive representation of 3D objects, and have recently been integrated into multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods primarily focus on static objects, while understanding dynamic point cloud sequences remains largely unexplored. This limitation is mainly caused by the lack of large-scale cross-modal datasets and the difficulty of modeling motions in spatio-temporal contexts. To bridge this gap, we present 4DPC$^2$hat, the first MLLM tailored for dynamic point cloud understanding. To this end, we construct a large-scale cross-modal dataset 4DPC$^2$hat-200K via a meticulous two-stage pipeline consisting of topology-consistent 4D point construction and two-level captioning. The dataset contains over 44K dynamic object sequences, 700K point cloud frames, and 200K curated question-answer (QA) pairs, supporting inquiries about counting, temporal relationship, action, spatial relationship, and appearance. At the core of the framework, we introduce a Mamba-enhanced temporal reasoning MLLM to capture long-range dependencies and dynamic patterns among a point cloud sequence. Furthermore, we propose a failure-aware bootstrapping learning strategy that iteratively identifies model deficiencies and generates targeted QA supervision to continuously strengthen corresponding reasoning capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our 4DPC$^2$hat significantly improves action understanding and temporal reasoning compared with existing models, establishing a strong foundation for 4D dynamic point cloud understanding.

</details>


### [147] [Efficient, Validation-Free Intrinsic Quality Estimation for Large-Scale Face Recognition Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29720)
*Zhichao Chen,Yongle Zhao,Kaicheng Yang,Meng Yang,Yin Xie,Ziyong Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需验证的度量方法Intrinsic Quality (IQ)，用于评估人脸识别数据集的内在潜力，无需完整训练即可预测下游模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的人脸识别数据集评估需要完整的模型训练，耗时耗资源。亟需一种快速、轻量的方法在训练前诊断数据集质量，从而高效筛选和构建高质量数据集。

Method: IQ包含两个组件：(i) 邻域一致性分数——通过最近邻量化局部身份标签的一致性；(ii) 全局表示子空间复杂度（有效秩）——捕捉底层嵌入几何结构与数据集多样性。可利用轻量代理模型或数据子集快速计算。

Result: IQ能够在无需全规模训练的前提下，快速评估数据集质量，并预测下游人脸识别模型的性能表现。

Conclusion: IQ为数据集诊断和筛选提供了高效替代方案，适用于干净、含噪及混合质量的人脸识别数据集，有助于在资源密集型训练前做出数据决策。

Abstract: We propose Intrinsic Quality (IQ), a validation-free metric designed to estimate the inherent potential of face recognition (FR) datasets to produce high-performance models without the need for full-scale training. IQ integrates two components: (i) a Neighbor-Consistency Score that quantifies local identity label agreement via nearest neighbors, and (ii) Global Representation Subspace Complexity (Effective Rank, ER), which captures the underlying embedding geometry and dataset diversity. IQ allows for rapid evaluation using lightweight proxy models or data subsets, facilitating dataset diagnosis and curation prior to resource-intensive full-scale training. We describe an experimental protocol tailored to clean, noisy, and mixed-quality FR datasets, and outline evaluation methodologies to validate IQ's predictive power for downstream performance.

</details>


### [148] [PipeMFL-240K: A Large-scale Dataset and Benchmark for Object Detection in Pipeline Magnetic Flux Leakage Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07044)
*Tianyi Qu,Songxiao Yang,Haolin Wang,Huadong Song,Xiaoting Guo,Wenguang Hu,Guanlin Liu,Honghe Chen,Yafei Ou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了PipeMFL-240K，一个大规模、精细标注的管道MFL伪彩图像数据集和基准，包含249,320张图像和200,020个边界框标注，覆盖12个类别，旨在解决MFL数据中长尾分布、小目标检测和类内变异等挑战，并推动可复现的MFL管道完整性评估研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 管道完整性对于工业安全和环境保护至关重要。尽管深度学习有望自动化MFL检测结果解释，但缺乏大规模公开数据集和基准，导致模型难以公平比较和可复现评估，阻碍了可靠模型的进展。

Method: 构建了PipeMFL-240K数据集，包含从12条总长约1,530 km的管道收集的249,320张MFL伪彩图像及200,020个高质量边界框标注，涵盖12个类别；并在该数据集上使用多种先进目标检测器进行广泛实验以建立基线。

Result: 实验表明，现有先进目标检测器在处理MFL数据的内在特性（极端长尾分布、小目标、类内变异）时仍存在困难，性能提升空间显著。PipeMFL-240K成为首个该规模和范围的公开数据集与基准。

Conclusion: PipeMFL-240K为MFL管道检测提供了可靠的挑战性测试平台，为高效管道诊断和维护规划奠定了基础，有望加速MFL管道完整性评估领域的算法创新和可复现研究。

Abstract: Pipeline integrity is critical to industrial safety and environmental protection, with Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL) detection being a primary non-destructive testing technology. Despite the promise of deep learning for automating MFL interpretation, progress toward reliable models has been constrained by the absence of a large-scale public dataset and benchmark, making fair comparison and reproducible evaluation difficult. We introduce \textbf{PipeMFL-240K}, a large-scale, meticulously annotated dataset and benchmark for complex object detection in pipeline MFL pseudo-color images. PipeMFL-240K reflects real-world inspection complexity and poses several unique challenges: (i) an extremely long-tailed distribution over \textbf{12} categories, (ii) a high prevalence of tiny objects that often comprise only a handful of pixels and (iii) substantial intra-class variability. The dataset contains \textbf{249,320} images and \textbf{200,020} high-quality bounding-box annotations, collected from 12 pipelines spanning approximately \textbf{1,530} km. Extensive experiments are conducted with state-of-the-art object detectors to establish baselines. Results show that modern detectors still struggle with the intrinsic properties of MFL data, highlighting considerable headroom for improvement, while PipeMFL-240K provides a reliable and challenging testbed to drive future research. As the first public dataset and the first benchmark of this scale and scope for pipeline MFL inspection, it provides a critical foundation for efficient pipeline diagnostics as well as maintenance planning and is expected to accelerate algorithmic innovation and reproducible research in MFL-based pipeline integrity assessment.

</details>


### [149] [SAVAA: Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs via Step-wise Adaptive Visual Attention Amplification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13600)
*Jiacheng Zhang,Feng Liu,Chao Du,Tianyu Pang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种步进自适应的视觉注意力放大方法（SAVAA），通过视觉基础熵（VGE）估计幻觉风险，自适应调整每个生成步骤的视觉注意力放大系数，解决了现有方法固定放大系数导致的双重失效模式（欠放大导致幻觉未消解、过放大引入新幻觉），在多个LVLM和幻觉基准测试上显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉注意力放大（VAA）方法在每一步生成中使用固定的放大系数，导致双重失效模式：某些步骤放大过弱无法消除幻觉，某些步骤放大过强反而引入新幻觉。

Method: 提出SAVAA框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 视觉基础熵（VGE），一种轻量级幻觉风险估计器，结合预测熵和视觉基础信息来评估每个生成token的幻觉风险；(2) 步进自适应放大机制，根据VGE估计的风险值动态调整下一步的VAA系数，高风险步骤施加强放大，低风险步骤施加弱放大。

Result: 在LLaVA-NeXT-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B和InternVL3.5-8B三个LVLM上，SAVAA在CHAIR、SHR和AMBER等生成式幻觉基准测试中显著优于所有基线方法。

Conclusion: 步进自适应的视觉注意力放大策略能有效解决固定放大系数的双重失效问题，VGE作为轻量级风险估计器能准确指导自适应放大，代码已开源。

Abstract: A line of recent training-free methods for mitigating hallucinations in large vision-language models (LVLMs) operates by amplifying attention to visual tokens during autoregressive generation within a single forward pass. We refer to this paradigm as visual attention amplification (VAA). In this paper, we identify a dual failure pattern in existing VAA methods caused by their use of a fixed amplification factor across generation steps: it can be too weak at some steps, leaving hallucinations unresolved, while too strong at others, introducing new hallucinations. Motivated by this finding, we propose Step-wise Adaptive Visual Attention Amplification (SAVAA), a new VAA framework that estimates hallucination risk for each generated token and uses the estimated risk to adaptively amplify visual attention at the next generation step. Specifically, we introduce Visual Grounding Entropy (VGE), a lightweight hallucination-risk estimator that augments predictive entropy with visual grounding, assigning higher risk to tokens that are uncertain, weakly grounded in the image, or both. Guided by VGE, SAVAA uses the estimated risk to calibrate the VAA factor for the next generation step, applying stronger amplification to higher-risk steps and weaker amplification to lower-risk steps. Across LLaVA-NeXT-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and InternVL3.5-8B, SAVAA significantly outperforms baseline methods on generative hallucination benchmarks such as CHAIR, SHR and AMBER. Code is available at: https://github.com/JiachengZ01/SAVVA.

</details>


### [150] [Multi-Turn Adaptive Prompting Attack on Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14399)
*In Chong Choi,Jiacheng Zhang,Feng Liu,Yiliao Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出多轮自适应提示攻击（MAPA），通过交替文本-视觉攻击动作和跨轮次迭代优化，有效突破多模态大语言模型的安全对齐，将攻击成功率提升15-30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多轮越狱攻击主要用于文本LLM，但在多模态LVLM上的有效性未被充分探索，且简单引入视觉输入反而容易被防御机制检测。

Method: MAPA采用双层设计：(1) 每轮交替文本-视觉攻击动作以最大化恶意响应；(2) 跨轮次通过迭代前后向调整攻击轨迹，逐步放大响应的恶意程度。

Result: 在LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-Vision-11B-Instruct和GPT-4o-mini上，攻击成功率比现有方法提升15-30%。

Conclusion: MAPA通过精细调控文本与视觉模态的交替攻击策略，有效规避了多模态模型的安全防御，验证了多模态越狱攻击的可行性。

Abstract: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks have proven effective against text-only large language models (LLMs), where malicious content is gradually introduced to bypass safety alignment. However, effectively extending such attacks to large vision-language models (LVLMs) remains underexplored. In this paper, we find that naively incorporating visual inputs can make multi-turn jailbreaks easier to defend against; for example, overly malicious visual content will easily trigger the defense mechanism in safety-aligned LVLMs, resulting in more conservative responses. Based on this finding, we propose multi-turn adaptive prompting attack (MAPA) that 1) at each turn, alternates text-vision attack actions to elicit the most malicious response; and 2) across turns, adjusts the attack trajectory through iterative back-and-forth refinement to gradually amplify response maliciousness. This two-level design enables MAPA to consistently outperform state-of-the-art methods, improving attack success rates by 15-30% on recent benchmarks against LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-Vision-11B-Instruct and GPT-4o-mini. Our code is available at: https://github.com/thomaschoi143/MAPA.

</details>


### [151] [GASS: Geometry-Aware Spherical Sampling for Disentangled Diversity Enhancement in Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17200)
*Ye Zhu,Kaleb S. Newman,Johannes F. Lutzeyer,Adriana Romero-Soriano,Michal Drozdzal,Olga Russakovsky*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出几何感知球面采样(GASS)，通过将CLIP嵌入中的多样性分解为文本相关和文本无关两个正交方向，显式控制两种变异来源，从而在保持图像保真度和语义对齐的同时，增强文本到图像生成模型的多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2I模型虽语义对齐度高，但给定同一提示时生成的图像多样性不足；现有方法主要依赖基于熵的指导来增加样本差异，缺乏对多样性来源的显式控制。

Method: 将CLIP嵌入中的多样性度量分解为两个正交方向：文本嵌入方向（捕捉与提示相关的语义变异）和正交方向（捕捉与提示无关的变异，如背景）。GASS通过增加生成图像嵌入沿两个轴的几何投影扩展来增强多样性，并沿生成轨迹通过扩展预测引导T2I采样过程。

Result: 在不同冻结T2I骨干网络（U-Net和DiT，扩散和流模型）和基准测试上验证了GASS的有效性，在最小影响图像保真度和语义对齐的前提下实现了解耦的多样性增强。

Conclusion: 通过几何视角显式解耦多样性的不同来源，可以在不牺牲图像质量和语义一致性的情况下有效提升T2I生成多样性。

Abstract: Despite high semantic alignment, modern text-to-image (T2I) generative models still struggle to synthesize diverse images from a given prompt. In this work, we enhance the T2I diversity through a geometric lens. Unlike most existing methods that rely primarily on entropy-based guidance to increase sample dissimilarity, we introduce Geometry-Aware Spherical Sampling (GASS) to enhance diversity by explicitly controlling both prompt-dependent and prompt-independent sources of variation. Specifically, we decompose the diversity measure in CLIP embeddings using two orthogonal directions: the text embedding, which captures semantic variation related to the prompt, and an identified orthogonal direction that captures prompt-independent variation (e.g., backgrounds). Based on this decomposition, GASS increases the geometric projection spread of generated image embeddings along both axes and guides the T2I sampling process via expanded predictions along the generation trajectory. Our experiments on different frozen T2I backbones (U-Net and DiT, diffusion and flow) and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of disentangled diversity enhancement with minimal impact on image fidelity and semantic alignment.

</details>


### [152] [JAEGER: Joint 3D Audio-Visual Grounding and Reasoning in Simulated Physical Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18527)
*Zhan Liu,Changli Tang,Yuxin Wang,Zhiyuan Zhu,Youjun Chen,Yiwen Shao,Tianzi Wang,Lei Ke,Zengrui Jin,Chao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JAEGER是一个将音视频大语言模型扩展到3D空间的框架，通过融合RGB-D观测和多声道一阶环绕声，结合神经强度向量（Neural IV）实现空间定位与推理。在包含6.1万条指令的SpatialSceneQA基准上，该方法在空间感知和推理任务上持续超越2D基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音视频大语言模型局限于2D感知，依赖RGB视频和单声道音频，无法在复杂3D环境中进行可靠的声源定位和空间推理，存在维度不匹配的根本性问题。

Method: 提出JAEGER框架，集成RGB-D观测与多声道一阶环绕声；提出神经强度向量（Neural IV）学习鲁棒的空间音频表示，增强到达方向估计能力；构建SpatialSceneQA基准（61k指令样本）用于训练与评估。

Result: 在多样化的空间感知与推理任务上，JAEGER持续优于2D基线模型，验证了显式3D建模的必要性。

Conclusion: 显式3D建模对于推进AI在物理环境中的发展至关重要，JAEGER通过3D音视频大语言模型有效解决了空间定位与推理难题。

Abstract: Current audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) are predominantly restricted to 2D perception, relying on RGB video and monaural audio. This design choice introduces a fundamental dimensionality mismatch that precludes reliable source localization and spatial reasoning in complex 3D environments. We address this limitation by presenting JAEGER, a framework that extends AV-LLMs to 3D space, to enable joint spatial grounding and reasoning through the integration of RGB-D observations and multi-channel first-order ambisonics. A core contribution of our work is the neural intensity vector (Neural IV), a learned spatial audio representation that encodes robust directional cues to enhance direction-of-arrival estimation, even in adverse acoustic scenarios with overlapping sources. To facilitate large-scale training and systematic evaluation, we propose SpatialSceneQA, a benchmark of 61k instruction-tuning samples curated from simulated physical environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently surpasses 2D-centric baselines across diverse spatial perception and reasoning tasks, underscoring the necessity of explicit 3D modelling for advancing AI in physical environments. Our source code, pre-trained model checkpoints, and datasets are available at https://github.com/liuzhan22/JAEGER.

</details>


### [153] [Structure-Aware Text Recognition for Ancient Greek Critical Editions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02803)
*Nicolas Angleraud,Antonia Karamolegkou,Benoît Sagot,Thibault Clérice*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在解读古希腊文批判版本（包含密集的参考文献层级和大量页边注释）方面的局限性。作者构建了包含18.5万页合成图像的大规模语料库和跨越一个多世纪的真实扫描基准数据集，评估了三种SOTA VLM。结果表明，在零样本设置下，大多数VLM显著逊于现有商业软件；但Qwen3VL-8B模型在真实扫描上达到了1.0%的中位字符错误率，展现了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在端到端文档理解方面取得了进展，但其对历史学术文本复杂布局语义（如古希腊文批判版本中的密集参考层级和页边注释）的解读能力仍十分有限，亟需系统性的评估和改进。

Method: (i) 从TEI/XML源生成18.5万页带有受控版式和布局变化的合成页面图像；(ii) 构建跨越一个多世纪编辑与排版实践的真实扫描基准数据集；(iii) 在零样本和微调两种范式下评估三种SOTA VLM。

Result: 零样本设置下，大多数VLM显著不如现有商业软件；Qwen3VL-8B模型在真实扫描上达到1.0%的中位CER，实现SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 当前VLM架构在处理高度结构化的历史文档时存在实质性局限，但Qwen3VL-8B的结果也展示了VLM在结构化复杂学术文档识别方面的未来潜力。

Abstract: Recent advances in visual language models (VLMs) have transformed end-to-end document understanding. However, their ability to interpret the complex layout semantics of historical scholarly texts remains limited. This paper investigates structure-aware text recognition for Ancient Greek critical editions, which have dense reference hierarchies and extensive marginal annotations. We introduce two novel resources: (i) a large-scale synthetic corpus of 185,000 page images generated from TEI/XML sources with controlled typographic and layout variation, and (ii) a curated benchmark of real scanned editions spanning more than a century of editorial and typographic practices. Using these datasets, we evaluate three state-of-the-art VLMs under both zero-shot and fine-tuning regimes. Our experiments reveal substantial limitations in current VLM architectures when confronted with highly structured historical documents. In zero-shot settings, most models significantly underperform compared to established off-the-shelf software. Nevertheless, the Qwen3VL-8B model achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching a median Character Error Rate of 1.0\% on real scans. These results highlight both the current shortcomings and the future potential of VLMs for structure-aware recognition of complex scholarly documents.

</details>


### [154] [MOO: A Multi-view Oriented Observations Dataset for Viewpoint Analysis in Cattle Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04314)
*William Grolleau,Achraf Chaouch,Astrid Sabourin,Guillaume Lapouge,Catherine Achard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了大规模合成数据集MOO（多视角定向观察），包含1,000头牛从128个均匀采样视角拍摄的128,000张标注图像，用于研究空中-地面动物重识别中的视角变化问题。通过量化仰角影响，发现存在关键仰角阈值，超过该阈值模型对未见视角的泛化能力显著提升。在四个真实牛数据集上的零样本和监督实验验证了合成几何先验能有效弥合领域鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动物重识别数据集缺乏精确角度标注，无法系统分析视角变化（尤其是空中-地面视角差异）对识别性能的影响。

Method: 构建大规模合成MOO数据集（1,000头牛×128个视角=128,000张图像），利用该受控数据集量化仰角对重识别的影响，识别关键仰角阈值，并在真实数据集上验证迁移能力。

Result: 发现存在关键仰角阈值，超过该阈值模型对未见视角的泛化能力显著提升；合成几何先验在零样本和监督设置下均能提升四个真实牛数据集的性能。

Conclusion: MOO数据集和量化分析为跨视角动物重识别研究奠定了基础，验证了合成几何先验可有效弥合合成与真实数据之间的领域鸿沟。

Abstract: Animal re-identification (ReID) faces critical challenges due to viewpoint variations, particularly in Aerial-Ground (AG-ReID) settings where models must match individuals across drastic elevation changes. However, existing datasets lack the precise angular annotations required to systematically analyze these geometric variations. To address this, we introduce the Multi-view Oriented Observation (MOO) dataset, a large-scale synthetic AG-ReID dataset of $1,000$ cattle individuals captured from $128$ uniformly sampled viewpoints ($128,000$ annotated images). Using this controlled dataset, we quantify the influence of elevation and identify a critical elevation threshold, above which models generalize significantly better to unseen views. Finally, we validate the transferability to real-world applications in both zero-shot and supervised settings, demonstrating performance gains across four real-world cattle datasets and confirming that synthetic geometric priors effectively bridge the domain gap. Collectively, this dataset and analysis lay the foundation for future model development in cross-view animal ReID. MOO is publicly available at https://github.com/TurtleSmoke/MOO.

</details>


### [155] [X-GS: An Extensible Framework for Perceiving and Thinking via 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09632)
*Yueen Ma,Zenglin Xu,Irwin King*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: X-GS是一个可扩展的3D高斯泼溅框架，包含Perceiver（统一多种3DGS技术实现实时在线SLAM与语义蒸馏）和Thinker（集成多模态模型完成下游任务）两大组件，在多个基准上验证了高效性和新解锁的多模态能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS方法大多孤立运行，专注于特定领域，缺乏统一的框架来整合多种技术和支持多模态下游任务。

Method: 提出X-GS框架，包含两个核心组件：X-GS-Perceiver通过视觉基础模型和三种加速机制改进在线SLAM与语义蒸馏；X-GS-Thinker基于对比式和生成式视觉语言模型，利用Perceiver的语义高斯泼溅实现3D视觉定位和场景描述等任务。

Result: 在多个不同基准上的实验结果表明，X-GS框架具有高效性，并成功解锁了新的多模态能力。

Conclusion: X-GS是一个可扩展的统一框架，能够集成多种3DGS技术并与多模态模型无缝对接，在实时SLAM和语义理解方面展现出优越性能。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful technique for novel view synthesis, subsequently extending into numerous spatial AI applications. However, most existing 3DGS methods operate in isolation, focusing on specific domains. In this paper, we introduce X-GS, an extensible framework consisting of two major components. The X-GS-\textit{Perceiver} unifies a broad range of 3DGS techniques to enable real-time online SLAM with semantic distillation. The X-GS-\textit{Thinker} accommodates multimodal models, enabling them to seamlessly interface with the \textit{Perceiver} to complete downstream tasks. In our implementation of X-GS, the \textit{Perceiver} leverages the latest vision foundation models to improve online SLAM performance and employs three key mechanisms to accelerate semantic distillation. The \textit{Thinker} can be built upon both contrastive and generative vision-language models and utilizes the \textit{Perceiver}'s semantic Gaussian splats to unlock capabilities such as 3D visual grounding and scene captioning. Experimental results on diverse benchmarks demonstrate the efficiency and newly unlocked multimodal capabilities of the X-GS framework.

</details>


### [156] [SDF-Net: Structure-Aware Disentangled Feature Learning for Opticall-SAR Ship Re-identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12588)
*Furui Chen,Han Wang,Yuhan Sun,Jianing You,Yixuan Lv,Zhuang Zhou,Hong Tan,Shengyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SDF-Net，利用几何一致性先验进行光学-SAR船舶跨模态重识别，通过结构一致性约束和特征解耦融合，在HOSS-ReID数据集上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学与SAR图像因成像机理不同（被动光学vs主动雷达）存在严重辐射差异，现有方法仅关注统计分布对齐或语义匹配，忽略了船舶作为刚体其几何结构在跨模态下保持稳定这一物理先验。

Method: 基于ViT骨干网络，设计结构一致性约束从中间层提取尺度不变梯度能量统计量以锚定表示；在终端阶段将特征解耦为模态不变的身份特征和模态特定的属性特征，并通过无参数的加法残差融合提升判别力。

Result: 在HOSS-ReID数据集上的大量实验表明，SDF-Net一致性地优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 利用几何结构先验进行跨模态特征解耦学习是解决光学-SAR船舶重识别的有效途径，代码和模型已开源。

Abstract: Cross-modal ship re-identification (ReID) between optical and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery is fundamentally challenged by the severe radiometric discrepancy between passive optical imaging and coherent active radar sensing. While existing approaches primarily rely on statistical distribution alignment or semantic matching, they often overlook a critical physical prior: ships are rigid objects whose geometric structures remain stable across sensing modalities, whereas texture appearance is highly modality-dependent. In this work, we propose SDF-Net, a Structure-Aware Disentangled Feature Learning Network that systematically incorporates geometric consistency into optical--SAR ship ReID. Built upon a ViT backbone, SDF-Net introduces a structure consistency constraint that extracts scale-invariant gradient energy statistics from intermediate layers to robustly anchor representations against radiometric variations. At the terminal stage, SDF-Net disentangles the learned representations into modality-invariant identity features and modality-specific characteristics. These decoupled cues are then integrated through a parameter-free additive residual fusion, effectively enhancing discriminative power. Extensive experiments on the HOSS-ReID dataset demonstrate that SDF-Net consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. The code and trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/cfrfree/SDF-Net.

</details>


### [157] [Getting to the Point: Pointing Improves LVLMs at Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21746)
*Simone Alghisi,Massimo Rizzoli,Seyed Mahed Mousavi,Giuseppe Riccardi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于指向的方法（Pointing-based methods）在零样本视觉计数任务中的作用，发现Point-then-Count (PtC)方法通过预测目标坐标再计数取得了最高准确率，且94%以上的预测点正确对应图像目标。机理分析表明性能提升源于坐标中的空间信息，但存在空间偏差，且PtC提升了分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管指向方法已被证明能提升大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的视觉推理性能，但其为何以及如何提升模型推理能力的机制尚不清楚。本文旨在通过零样本计数任务，揭示指向方法提升LVLMs视觉推理的内在机制。

Method: 在零样本计数任务中，对比多种微调和免训练方法在先进LVLMs上的表现，重点评估Point-then-Count (PtC)方法——模型首先生成目标对象的点坐标，再预测数量。通过F1-score评估坐标 grounding 质量，并进行机理分析（空间信息编码、空间偏差、分布外泛化）。

Result: PtC在所有评估方法中准确率最高，94%以上预测点正确ground到图像目标（基于F1-score）。性能提升源于预测坐标编码的空间信息，但不同图像区域的grounding表现存在空间偏差。PtC在合成数据和真实数据上均提升了分布外泛化能力。

Conclusion: 指向方法（特别是PtC）通过坐标提供的空间信息提升LVLMs的计数能力，但存在空间偏差问题。该方法能有效改善模型在分布外场景下的泛化性能，表明坐标信息在帮助LVLMs提升计数技能方面具有潜力。

Abstract: Pointing-based methods decompose complex tasks as sequential grounding and reasoning steps. Given a query, the model first grounds the relevant objects by generating their coordinates, and then predicts an answer conditioned on these points. While this approach has been shown to increase the performance of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), it remains unclear why and how it improves the models' visual reasoning. In this work, we evaluate pointing-based methods in the task of zero-shot counting in visual scenes. We experiment with multiple fine-tuning and training-free approaches on state-of-the-art LVLMs, and compare them with Point-then-Count (PtC), where models first generate point coordinates for the target objects and then predict their count. Our results show that PtC achieves the highest accuracy among the evaluated approaches, with predicted points correctly grounded in the image in more than 94% of cases (based on F1-score). Mechanistic analyses show that gains arise from spatial information encoded in the predicted coordinates. Nevertheless, grounding performance varies across image regions, revealing spatial biases. Finally, the results indicate that PtC improves out-of-distribution generalization on both synthetic and real data, suggesting the potential of coordinates to help LVLMs improve their counting skills.

</details>


### [158] [RHO: Robust Holistic OSM-Based Metric Cross-View Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27758)
*Junwei Zheng,Ruize Dai,Ruiping Liu,Zichao Zeng,Yufan Chen,Fangjinhua Wang,Kunyu Peng,Kailun Yang,Jiaming Zhang,Rainer Stiefelhagen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于全景图与OpenStreetMap的跨视角地理定位方法RHO，构建了大规模基准数据集CV-RHO（270万+图像），通过Split-Undistort-Merge模块解决全景畸变、Position-Orientation Fusion机制提升定位精度，在3-DoF相机位姿估计任务上相比SOTA提升高达20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法多采用针孔相机图像与卫星图像，但全景图与OSM的鲁棒性定位研究不足，且缺乏大规模多样化条件下的标注数据集。

Method: 1）构建CV-RHO数据集（270万+全景图，涵盖不同天气、光照、传感器噪声）；2）提出RHO模型，采用双分支Pin-Pan架构（一个分支处理针孔投影特征，另一个处理全景图）；3）设计Split-Undistort-Merge (SUM)模块矫正全景畸变；4）提出Position-Orientation Fusion (POF)机制融合位置与朝向信息以提升定位精度。

Result: 在CV-RHO数据集上的大量实验表明，RHO模型相比现有最先进基线方法性能提升高达20%。

Conclusion: 验证了CV-RHO数据集的价值和RHO模型在全景-OSM跨视角地理定位中的有效性，为鲁棒视觉定位提供了新思路。

Abstract: Metric Cross-View Geo-Localization (MCVGL) aims to estimate the 3-DoF camera pose (position and heading) by matching ground and satellite images. In this work, instead of pinhole and satellite images, we study robust MCVGL using holistic panoramas and OpenStreetMap (OSM). To this end, we establish a large-scale MCVGL benchmark dataset, CV-RHO, with over 2.7M images under different weather and lighting conditions, as well as sensor noise. Furthermore, we propose a model termed RHO with a two-branch Pin-Pan architecture for accurate visual localization. A Split-Undistort-Merge (SUM) module is introduced to address the panoramic distortion, and a Position-Orientation Fusion (POF) mechanism is designed to enhance the localization accuracy. Extensive experiments prove the value of our CV-RHO dataset and the effectiveness of the RHO model, with a significant performance gain up to 20% compared with the state-of-the-art baselines. Project page: https://github.com/InSAI-Lab/RHO.

</details>


### [159] [Detecting Unknown Objects via Energy-based Separation for Open World Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29954)
*Jun-Woo Heo,Keonhee Park,Gyeong-Moon Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DEUS框架，通过等角紧框架子空间未知分离（EUS）和基于能量的已知区分损失（EKD）来解决开放世界目标检测中的未知物体检测和灾难性遗忘问题，在基准测试中取得了优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放世界目标检测方法依赖已知类别预测来检测未知物体，导致难以有效学习未知物体表征；同时记忆回放虽缓解旧类遗忘，但往往牺牲新学类别的知识。

Method: 提出DEUS框架，包含两个核心组件：1) ETF子空间未知分离（EUS），利用等角紧框架的几何性质创建正交子空间，实现已知与未知物体表征的干净分离，并利用两个空间的能量捕捉未知物体模式；2) 基于能量的已知区分损失（EKD），强制先前分类器与当前分类器分离，最小化新旧类别间的知识干扰。

Result: 在开放世界目标检测基准测试上，DEUS在未知物体检测方面取得了显著的性能提升，同时保持了竞争力的已知类别检测性能。

Conclusion: 通过几何正交子空间分离和能量损失约束，DEUS有效解决了开放世界目标检测中未知物体表征学习和类别间知识干扰两大核心挑战。

Abstract: In this work, we tackle the problem of Open World Object Detection (OWOD). This challenging scenario requires the detector to incrementally learn to classify known objects without forgetting while identifying unknown objects without supervision. Previous OWOD methods have enhanced the unknown discovery process and employed memory replay to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. However, since existing methods heavily rely on the detector's known class predictions for detecting unknown objects, they struggle to effectively learn and recognize unknown object representations. Moreover, while memory replay mitigates forgetting of old classes, it often sacrifices the knowledge of newly learned classes. To resolve these limitations, we propose DEUS (Detecting Unknowns via energy-based Separation), a novel framework that addresses the challenges of Open World Object Detection. DEUS consists of Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF)-Subspace Unknown Separation (EUS) and an Energy-based Known Distinction (EKD) loss. EUS leverages ETF-based geometric properties to create orthogonal subspaces, enabling cleaner separation between known and unknown object representations. Unlike prior energy-based approaches that consider only the known space, EUS utilizes energies from both spaces to better capture distinct patterns of unknown objects. Furthermore, EKD loss enforces the separation between previous and current classifiers, thus minimizing knowledge interference between previous and newly learned classes during memory replay. We thoroughly validate DEUS on OWOD benchmarks, demonstrating outstanding performance improvements in unknown detection while maintaining competitive known class performance.

</details>


### [160] [ReSpinQuant: Efficient Layer-Wise LLM Quantization via Subspace Residual Rotation Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11080)
*Suyoung Kim,Sunghyun Wee,Hyeonjin Kim,Kyomin Hwang,Hyunho Lee,Nojun Kwak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReSpinQuant提出了一种基于残差子空间旋转的量化框架，通过离线激活旋转融合和基匹配技术，实现了层级适应的高表达力与全局旋转方法的低推理开销之间的平衡，在W4A4和W3A3量化上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局旋转PTQ方法推理高效但表达力受限（单一旋转矩阵跨层共享），而层间变换方法精度高但需在线计算导致显著推理开销。现有方法无法同时兼顾表达力与效率。

Method: 提出ReSpinQuant，利用离线激活旋转融合和残差子空间旋转匹配基，将层间变换的旋转矩阵离线融合到权重中，避免在线计算，同时保持层级适应的灵活性。

Result: 在W4A4和W3A3量化设置下，ReSpinQuant超越全局旋转方法，与高计算开销的层间方法精度相当，且推理开销极小。

Conclusion: 通过残差子空间旋转设计，ReSpinQuant成功化解了层间适应高表达力与低推理开销之间的矛盾，为LLM后训练量化提供了高效且精准的解决方案。

Abstract: Rotation-based Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a promising solution for mitigating activation outliers in the quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs). Global rotation methods achieve inference efficiency by fusing activation rotations into attention and FFN blocks, but suffer from limited expressivity as they are constrained to use a single learnable rotation matrix across all layers. To tackle this, layer-wise transformation methods emerged, achieving superior accuracy through localized adaptation. However, layer-wise methods cannot fuse activation rotation matrices into weights, requiring online computations and causing significant overhead. In this paper, we propose ReSpinQuant, a quantization framework that resolves such overhead by leveraging offline activation rotation fusion and matching basis using efficient residual subspace rotation. This design reconciles the high expressivity of layer-wise adaptation with only negligible inference overhead. Extensive experiments on W4A4 and W3A3 quantization demonstrate that ReSpinQuant achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming global rotation methods and matching the accuracy of computationally expensive layer-wise methods with minimal overhead.

</details>


### [161] [A Multi-Agent Feedback System for Detecting and Describing News Events in Satellite Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12772)
*Madeline Anderson,Mikhail Klassen,Ash Hoover,Kerri Cahoy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SkyScraper——一种迭代式多智能体工作流，通过地理编码新闻文章并为相应卫星图像序列合成描述，解决了遥感领域多时序事件描述数据集缺失的问题。实验表明该方法比传统地理编码方法多发现5倍事件，并构建了包含5000个序列的数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感领域缺乏多时序事件描述数据集（每序列至少两张图像），因为（1）在卫星图像中搜索可见事件和（2）标注多时序序列需要大量时间和人力。

Method: 提出SkyScraper——一种迭代式多智能体工作流，对新闻文章进行地理编码，并为对应的卫星图像序列合成描述。通过智能体反馈机制发现新的多时序事件。

Result: SkyScraper相比传统地理编码方法多发现5倍的事件，并构建了包含5000个序列的多时序描述数据集。

Conclusion: 智能体反馈是发现卫星图像中新的多时序事件的有效策略，该工作流还可支持新闻和报道工作。

Abstract: Changes in satellite imagery often occur over multiple time steps. Despite the emergence of bi-temporal change captioning datasets, there is a lack of multi-temporal event captioning datasets (at least two images per sequence) in remote sensing. This gap exists because (1) searching for visible events in satellite imagery and (2) labeling multi-temporal sequences require significant time and labor. To address these challenges, we present SkyScraper, an iterative multi-agent workflow that geocodes news articles and synthesizes captions for corresponding satellite image sequences. Our experiments show that SkyScraper successfully finds 5x more events than traditional geocoding methods, demonstrating that agentic feedback is an effective strategy for surfacing new multi-temporal events in satellite imagery. We apply our framework to a large database of global news articles, curating a new multi-temporal captioning dataset with 5,000 sequences. By automatically identifying imagery related to news events, our work also supports journalism and reporting efforts.

</details>


### [162] [PrecisionCUA: Iterative Visual Refinement for Pixel-Precise Cursor Grounding in Code Editors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.13019)
*Himangi Mittal,Gaurav Mittal,Nelson Daniel Troncoso,Yu Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了代码密集界面（如VS Code、Cursor）中像素级光标定位问题，提出了一种基于迭代视觉反馈的闭环定位机制，通过多轮精细化调整替代单次坐标预测，显著提升了点击精度和任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机使用代理（CUA）在GUI grounding方面主要依赖单次坐标预测，缺乏错误修正机制，在需要亚像素精度的密集编码界面（IDE元素密集、动态变化）中表现不佳，这一编辑级grounding问题尚未被充分探索。

Method: 提出闭环grounding机制：代理利用先前尝试的视觉反馈进行迭代精细化调整，通过多轮交互逐步修正位移误差，适应动态UI变化。在Claude、Qwen、GPT系列模型上进行评估。

Result: 在多个复杂编码基准测试中，多轮迭代精细化方法在点击精度和整体任务成功率上均显著优于现有单次预测模型。

Conclusion: 迭代视觉推理是构建下一代可靠软件工程代理的关键组成部分，该机制能有效解决密集编码界面中的精确定位问题。

Abstract: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) fundamentally rely on graphical user interface (GUI) grounding to translate language instructions into executable screen actions, but editing-level grounding in dense coding interfaces (such as VS Code and Cursor), where sub-pixel accuracy is required to interact with dense IDE elements, remains underexplored. Existing approaches typically rely on single-shot coordinate prediction, which lacks a mechanism for error correction and often fails in high-density interfaces. In this technical report, we conduct an empirical study of pixel-precise cursor localization in coding environments. Instead of a single-step execution, our agent engages in an iterative refinement process, utilizing visual feedback from previous attempts to reach the target element. This closed-loop grounding mechanism allows the agent to self-correct displacement errors and adapt to dynamic UI changes. We evaluate our approach across Claude, Qwen, and GPT on a suite of complex coding benchmarks, demonstrating that multi-turn refinement significantly outperforms state-of-the-art single-shot models in both click precision and overall task success rate. Our results suggest that iterative visual reasoning is a critical component for the next generation of reliable software engineering agents. Code: https://github.com/microsoft/precision-cua-bench/tree/main.

</details>


### [163] [UDM-GRPO: Stable and Efficient Group Relative Policy Optimization for Uniform Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18518)
*Jiaqi Wang,Haoge Deng,Ting Pan,Yang Liu,Chengyuan Wang,Fan Zhang,Yonggang Qi,Xinlong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出UDM-GRPO框架，首次将强化学习（GRPO）与均匀离散扩散模型（UDM）结合，通过将最终干净样本视为动作、利用前向过程重建轨迹，以及引入Reduced-Step和CFG-Free策略，显著提升了文本到图像生成性能，在GenEval、PickScore和OCR等多个基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管UDM在离散生成建模中展现出潜力，但其与强化学习的融合尚未被探索。直接应用GRPO到UDM会导致训练不稳定和性能增益有限，因此需要一种专门设计的框架来实现两者的有效结合。

Method: 提出UDM-GRPO框架，核心包括：(i) 将最终干净样本作为动作，提供更准确稳定的优化信号；(ii) 通过扩散前向过程重建轨迹，使概率路径与预训练分布更好对齐；同时引入Reduced-Step和CFG-Free两种策略提升训练效率。

Result: 在多个T2I任务上取得显著提升：GenEval准确率从69%提升至96%，PickScore从20.46提升至23.81，在连续和离散设置下均达到SOTA；OCR基准准确率从8%提升至57%。

Conclusion: UDM-GRPO是首个成功将UDM与强化学习结合的方法，通过精心设计的对齐策略有效解决了训练不稳定问题，在多项文本到图像生成任务上显著超越基线，展现出良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Uniform Discrete Diffusion Model (UDM) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for discrete generative modeling; however, its integration with reinforcement learning remains largely unexplored. We observe that naively applying GRPO to UDM leads to training instability and marginal performance gains. To address this, we propose UDM-GRPO, the first framework to integrate UDM with RL. Our method is guided by two key insights: (i) treating the final clean sample as the action provides more accurate and stable optimization signals; and (ii) reconstructing trajectories via the diffusion forward process better aligns probability paths with the pretraining distribution. Additionally, we introduce two strategies, Reduced-Step and CFG-Free, to further improve training efficiency. UDM-GRPO significantly improves base model performance across multiple T2I tasks. Notably, GenEval accuracy improves from $69\%$ to $96\%$ and PickScore increases from $20.46$ to $23.81$, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both continuous and discrete settings. On the OCR benchmark, accuracy rises from $8\%$ to $57\%$, further validating the generalization ability of our method. Code is available at https://github.com/Yovecent/UDM-GRPO.

</details>


### [164] [Causal Disentanglement-Inspired Degradation Representation Learning for Full-Reference Image Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.21654)
*Zhen Zhang,Jielei Chu,Tian Zhang,Lin Ma,Fengmao Lv,Weide Liu,Tianrui Li,Yuming Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于因果推断和解耦表示学习的全参考图像质量评估新范式，通过将退化估计建模为因果解缠过程，利用内容不变性和视觉掩蔽效应提取受内容影响的退化特征，在完全监督、少标签和无标签场景下均取得竞争性能，并在跨域泛化方面优于现有无训练模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于深度网络的FR-IQA模型通常依赖对参考图像和失真图像深度特征进行成对比较，缺乏对图像内容与退化特征之间因果关系的建模，导致跨域泛化能力不足。本文旨在从因果推断角度出发，提出一种更符合人类视觉系统的质量评估范式。

Method: 1）利用参考图像与失真图像之间的内容不变性，解耦退化表示与内容表示；2）受人类视觉掩蔽效应启发，设计掩蔽模块建模图像内容与退化特征之间的因果关系，提取受内容影响的退化特征；3）通过监督回归或无标签降维方法从退化特征预测质量分数。

Result: 在标准IQA基准上，该方法在完全监督、少标签和无标签三种设置下均取得高度竞争性能；在水下、射线、医学、中子及屏幕内容等非标准自然图像域中，由于无需标签即可进行场景特定训练，展现出优于现有无训练FR-IQA模型的跨域泛化能力。

Conclusion: 因果解耦范式为FR-IQA提供了新思路，有效解决了跨域泛化瓶颈，尤其在标签稀缺的实际场景中具有显著优势。

Abstract: Existing deep network-based full-reference image quality assessment (FR-IQA) models typically work by performing pairwise comparisons of deep features from the reference and distorted images. In this paper, we approach this problem from a different perspective and propose a novel FR-IQA paradigm based on causal inference and decoupled representation learning. Unlike typical feature comparison-based FR-IQA models, our approach formulates degradation estimation as a causal disentanglement process guided by intervention on latent representations. We first decouple degradation and content representations by exploiting the content invariance between the reference and distorted images. Second, inspired by the human visual masking effect, we design a masking module to model the causal relationship between image content and degradation features, thereby extracting content-influenced degradation features from distorted images. Finally, quality scores are predicted from these degradation features using either supervised regression or label-free dimensionality reduction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves highly competitive performance on standard IQA benchmarks across fully supervised, few-label, and label-free settings. Furthermore, we evaluate the approach on diverse non-standard natural image domains with scarce data, including underwater, radiographic, medical, neutron, and screen-content images. Benefiting from its ability to perform scenario-specific training and prediction without labeled IQA data, our method exhibits superior cross-domain generalization compared to existing training-free FR-IQA models.

</details>


### [165] [Beyond Chain-of-Thought: Rewrite as a Universal Interface for Generative Multimodal Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22280)
*Peixi Wu,Ke Mei,Feipeng Ma,Bosong Chai,Zhibin Lan,Chenxi Zhao,Shannan Yan,Jie Chen,Zhangchi Hu,Yansong Peng,Bo Lin,Junjie Zhou,Dacheng Yin,Tianyi Wang,Fengyun Rao,Jing Lyu,Hebei Li,Xiaoyan Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RIME框架，通过重写驱动、跨模态对齐和强化学习，在保持生成式多模态嵌入优势的同时，显著减少推理冗余并提升检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于CoT推理的生成式多模态嵌入在广泛检索场景中存在冗余思考步骤和语义歧义问题，影响检索效率和准确性。

Method: 1) 重写驱动多模态嵌入(RIME)：统一框架联合优化生成与嵌入，使生成结果更适配检索；2) 跨模态对齐(CMA)：桥接生成式与判别式嵌入空间，实现灵活的互检索以权衡效率与精度；3) 精简强化学习(Refine-RL)：以判别式嵌入作为稳定语义锚点，指导重写优化过程。

Result: 在MMEB-V2、MRMR和UVRB基准上，RIME显著优于现有生成式嵌入模型，同时大幅缩短了思考链长度。

Conclusion: RIME通过重写驱动和强化学习策略，有效解决了生成式多模态嵌入在检索中的冗余与歧义问题，实现了效率与精度的更好平衡。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a promising foundation for universal multimodal embeddings. Recent studies have shown that reasoning-driven generative multimodal embeddings can outperform discriminative embeddings on several embedding tasks. However, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning tends to generate redundant thinking steps and introduce semantic ambiguity in the summarized answers in broader retrieval scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose Rewrite-driven Multimodal Embedding (RIME), a unified framework that jointly optimizes generation and embedding through a retrieval-friendly rewrite. Meanwhile, we present the Cross-Mode Alignment (CMA) to bridge the generative and discriminative embedding spaces, enabling flexible mutual retrieval to trade off efficiency and accuracy. Based on this, we also introduce Refine Reinforcement Learning (Refine-RL) that treats discriminative embeddings as stable semantic anchors to guide the rewrite optimization. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2, MRMR and UVRB demonstrate that RIME substantially outperforms prior generative embedding models while significantly reducing the length of thinking.

</details>


### [166] [SpaMEM: Benchmarking Dynamic Spatial Reasoning via Perception-Memory Integration in Embodied Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22409)
*Chih-Ting Liao,Xi Xiao,Chunlei Meng,Zhangquan Chen,Yitong Qiao,Weilin Zhou,Tianyang Wang,Xu Zheng,Xin Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SpaMEM，一个大规模诊断基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在具身环境中通过动作序列维持空间信念的能力。该基准包含超过1000万张高保真图像、4种模态、3级推理层次和15个诊断任务，揭示出现有模型在坐标一致性和视觉记忆方面的系统瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在静态视觉-空间推理上表现良好，但在具身环境中面对持续更新的自我中心观察时，无法维持长程空间连贯性。需要一个能够隔离空间信念演化机制的诊断基准。

Method: 构建了基于物理引擎的1000套程序化生成房屋环境，包含25,000+交互序列和10,601,392张图像（RGB、深度、实例分割、语义分割）。形式化定义了3级空间推理层次（原子空间感知、带文本状态的时间推理、端到端视觉信念维护）共15个诊断任务，并评估短期（逐步）更新与长期（回合级）重建能力。

Result: 代表性开源VLM在基准测试中表现出系统性瓶颈：坐标一致的地面定位是硬天花板；从Level 2到Level 3的性能骤降暴露了模型对符号化文本状态的原型依赖——模型在基于文本的记账式推理上表现良好，但无法维持鲁棒的视觉记忆。

Conclusion: SpaMEM为具身空间推理提供了细粒度的诊断标准，激励未来研究设计显式的状态表示、信念修正机制和长程回合级整合模块。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced static visual--spatial reasoning, yet they often fail to preserve long-horizon spatial coherence in embodied settings where beliefs must be continuously revised from egocentric observations under environmental change. We introduce SpaMEM (Spatial Memory from Action Sequences), a large-scale diagnostic benchmark that isolates the mechanics of spatial belief evolution via action-conditioned scene transformations (spawn, place, remove) over long interaction horizons. SpaMEM is built on a physically grounded dataset with 10,601,392 high-fidelity images across four modalities (RGB, depth, instance, semantic segmentation), collected from 25,000+ interaction sequences in 1,000 procedurally generated houses. We formalize embodied spatial reasoning as a three-level hierarchy with 15 diagnostic tasks: Level 1 measures atomic spatial perception from single observations; Level 2 probes temporal reasoning with oracle textual state histories to factor out perceptual noise; and Level 3 requires end-to-end belief maintenance from raw visual streams under the same task dimensions. We further evaluate both short-term (step-wise) updates and long-term (episodic) reconstruction. Benchmarking representative open-source VLM families reveals a consistent stacked bottleneck: coordinate-consistent grounding remains a hard ceiling, and the sharp collapse from Level 2 to Level 3 exposes a pronounced symbolic scaffolding dependency, where models succeed with text-based bookkeeping but struggle to sustain robust visual memory. SpaMEM provides a granular diagnostic standard and motivates explicit mechanisms for state representation, belief revision, and long-horizon episodic integration. A subset of SpaMEM is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mill-ct-liao/SpaMEM.

</details>


### [167] [LabBuilder: Protocol-Grounded 3D Layout Generation for Interactable and Safe Laboratory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02288)
*Jianbao Cao,Zhangrui Zhao,Bohan Feng,Zixuan Hu,Rui Li,Haiyuan Wan,Chenxi Li,Jingyuan Li,Wenzhe Cai,Lei Bai,Wanli Ouyang,Lingyu Duan,Di Huang,Minting Pan,Sha Zhang,Xinzhu Ma,Shixiang Tang,Dongzhan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LabBuilder是一个端到端系统，能够从文本描述自动生成并验证符合化学安全、几何约束和导航要求的3D实验室布局，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化实验室的部署受限于安全且可执行的实验环境设计困难，现有3D场景生成方法主要针对家庭场景，缺乏对科学实验所需的协议依据和布局级安全约束的考虑。

Method: 系统包含三个紧密耦合的组件：LabForge（管理标注资产和化学知识，将自然语言转化为结构化协议）、LabGen（基于协议通过迭代约束感知优化策略合成实验室布局）、LabTouchstone（统一基准评估生成的布局）。

Result: 实验表明LabBuilder显著优于现有最先进方法，生成的实验室环境在几何、化学安全和导航约束下兼具真实性和有效性。

Conclusion: LabBuilder通过端到端的协议驱动布局生成与约束验证，解决了自动化实验室环境设计的核心瓶颈，为科学发现加速提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Automated laboratories hold the promise of accelerating scientific discovery, yet their deployment is bottlenecked by the difficulty of designing safe and executable environments. While simulator-based design offers scalability, existing 3D scene generation methods are primarily tailored for household settings, optimizing for visual plausibility while neglecting the protocol grounding and layout-level safety constraints essential for scientific experimentation. We present LabBuilder, an end-to-end system that generates and verifies 3D laboratory layouts from concise textual specifications. It operates through three tightly coupled components: LabForge first curates a meta-dataset of annotated assets and chemical knowledge, translating natural language specifications into structured protocols; building on these protocols, LabGen synthesizes laboratory layouts via an iterative, constraint-aware optimization strategy; finally, LabTouchstone evaluates the resulting layouts as a unified benchmark. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LabBuilder significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, producing laboratory environments that are realistic and valid under modeled geometric, chemical-safety, and navigation constraints.

</details>


### [168] [Linearizing Vision Transformer with Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02772)
*Yining Li,Dongchen Han,Zeyu Liu,Hanyi Wang,Yulin Wang,Gao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将预训练Softmax注意力Transformer高效转换为线性复杂度TTT架构的方法，通过架构对齐（TTT的两层动态公式与Softmax注意力结构一致）和表征对齐（关键实例归一化与轻量局部增强模块），仅用1小时微调即可将Stable Diffusion 3.5线性化，在保持图像质量的同时实现1.32-1.47倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性复杂度注意力机制可克服Softmax注意力的二次计算瓶颈，但从头训练成本过高；直接继承预训练Transformer权重面临Softmax与线性注意力之间根本性的表征差异，需要有效的权重迁移方法。

Method: 1) 架构对齐：发现TTT（Test-Time Training）的双层动态公式与Softmax注意力在结构上对齐，可直接继承预训练注意力权重；2) 表征对齐：引入关键实例归一化（key instance normalization）解决键移位不变性问题，并设计轻量局部增强模块（locality enhancement module）弥补局部性不足。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion 3.5上验证，仅需4×H20 GPU微调1小时，SD3.5-T⁵即可达到与微调Softmax模型相当的文生图质量，同时在1K和2K分辨率下分别实现1.32×和1.47×推理加速。

Conclusion: 通过架构与表征的双重对齐，成功实现了从预训练Softmax注意力到线性复杂度TTT架构的高效转换，为线性注意力模型的实用化提供了一条低成本路径。

Abstract: While linear-complexity attention mechanisms offer a promising alternative to Softmax attention for overcoming the quadratic bottleneck, training such models from scratch remains prohibitively expensive. Inheriting weights from pretrained Transformers provides an appealing shortcut, yet the fundamental representational gap between Softmax and linear attention prevents effective weight transfer. In this work, we address this conversion challenge from two perspectives: architectural alignment and representational alignment. We identify Test-Time Training (TTT) as a linear-complexity architecture whose two-layer dynamic formulation is structurally aligned with Softmax attention, enabling direct inheritance of pretrained attention weights. To further align representational properties, including key shift-invariance and locality, we introduce key instance normalization and a lightweight locality enhancement module. We validate our approach by linearizing Stable Diffusion 3.5 and introduce SD3.5-T$^5$ (Transformer To Test Time Training). With only 1 hour of fine-tuning on 4$\times$H20 GPUs, SD3.5-T$^5$ achieves comparable text-to-image quality to the fine-tuned Softmax model, while accelerating inference by 1.32$\times$ and 1.47$\times$ at 1K and 2K resolutions. Code is available at https://github.com/LeapLabTHU/Transformer-to-TTT.

</details>


### [169] [LIVEditor-14B: Lightning Unified Video Editing via In-Context Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04569)
*Shitong Shao,Zikai Zhou,Haopeng Li,Yingwei Song,Wenliang Zhong,Lichen Bai,Zeke Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ISA（上下文稀疏注意力）框架，首次实现ICL视频编辑中近乎无损的稀疏加速，并通过LIVEditor-14B模型在降低60%注意力延迟的同时超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频编辑中的上下文学习（ICL）范式面临二次方注意力复杂度的计算瓶颈，现有方法难以在保持质量的同时加速。

Method: ISA包含两个核心策略：(1) 高效预选剪枝冗余上下文token；(2) 动态查询分组机制，将高误差查询分配至全注意力，低误差查询分配至0阶泰勒稀疏注意力。同时构建了1.7M高质量视频编辑数据集及LIVEditor-14B模型。

Result: LIVEditor-14B在注意力模块延迟降低约60%，并在EditVerseBench、IVE-Bench、VIE-Bench上超越SOTA方法，实现近乎无损加速。

Conclusion: 验证了上下文token低显著性与查询锐度与近似误差相关性的理论发现，证明了ISA框架在ICL视频编辑中高效且保质的可行性。

Abstract: Video editing has evolved toward In-Context Learning (ICL) paradigms, yet the resulting quadratic attention costs create a critical computational bottleneck. In this work, we propose In-context Sparse Attention (ISA), the first near-lossless empirical sparse framework tailored for ICL video editing. Our design is grounded in two key insights: first, context tokens exhibit significantly lower saliency than source tokens; second, we theoretically prove and empirically validate that Query sharpness correlates with approximation error. Motivated by these findings, ISA implements an efficient pre-selection strategy to prune redundant context, followed by a dynamic query grouping mechanism that routes high-error queries to full attention and low-error ones to a computationally efficient 0-th order Taylor sparse attention. Furthermore, we build \textbf{\texttt{LIVEditor-14B}} , a novel lightning video editing model via ISA and a proposed video-editing data pipeline that curated a 1.7M high-quality dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LIVEditor-14B achieves a $\sim$60% reduction in attention-module latency while surpassing state-of-the-art methods across EditVerseBench, IVE-Bench, and VIE-Bench, delivering near-lossless acceleration without compromising visual fidelity.

</details>


### [170] [Aes3D: Aesthetic Assessment in 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05155)
*Chuanzhi Xu,Boyu Wei,Haoxian Zhou,Xuanhua Yin,Zihan Deng,Haodong Chen,Qiang Qu,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Aes3D，首个面向3D神经渲染场景美学评估的系统框架，包括首个3D场景美学数据集Aesthetic3D和轻量级预测模型Aes3DGSNet，该模型直接从3D高斯基元预测场景级美学分数，无需渲染多视角图像，在保持轻量设计的同时实现了强性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D场景评估方法主要关注重建保真度和感知真实性，缺乏对构图、和谐性、视觉吸引力等高层次美学属性的评估。主要挑战在于：(1)缺乏带美学标注的3D高斯泼溅数据集；(2)3DGS作为低层级基元表示难以捕获高层美学特征。

Method: 提出Aes3D框架，包含：(1)Aesthetic3D数据集——基于3D场景美学标注策略构建的首个专用数据集；(2)Aes3DGSNet——轻量级模型，直接对3D高斯基元进行操作，通过多视角3DGS场景表示的美学监督学习捕获高层美学线索并回归美学分数，无需渲染多视角图像。

Result: 实验表明该方法在保持轻量设计的同时实现了强性能，为3D场景美学评估建立了新基准。

Conclusion: Aes3D是首个系统性解决3D神经渲染场景美学评估问题的框架，填补了该领域空白，代码和数据集将开源。

Abstract: As 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) gains attention in immersive media and digital content creation, assessing the aesthetics of 3D scenes becomes important in helping creators build more visually compelling 3D content. However, existing evaluation methods for 3D scenes primarily emphasize reconstruction fidelity and perceptual realism, largely overlooking higher-level aesthetic attributes such as composition, harmony, and visual appeal. This limitation comes from two key challenges: (1) the absence of general 3DGS datasets with aesthetic annotations, and (2) the intrinsic nature of 3DGS as a low-level primitive representation, which makes it difficult to capture high-level aesthetic features. To address these challenges, we propose Aes3D, the first systematic framework for assessing the aesthetics of 3D neural rendering scenes. Aes3D includes Aesthetic3D, the first dataset dedicated to 3D scene aesthetic assessment, built on our proposed annotation strategy for 3D scene aesthetics. In addition, we present Aes3DGSNet, a lightweight model that directly predicts scene-level aesthetic scores from 3DGS representations. Notably, our model operates solely on 3D Gaussian primitives, eliminating the need for rendering multi-view images and thus reducing computational cost and hardware requirements. Through aesthetics-supervised learning on multi-view 3DGS scene representations, Aes3DGSNet effectively captures high-level aesthetic cues and accurately regresses aesthetic scores. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves strong performance while maintaining a lightweight design, establishing a new benchmark for 3D scene aesthetic assessment. Code and datasets will be made available in a future version.

</details>


### [171] [InfoGeo: Information-Theoretic Object-Centric Learning for Cross-View Generalizable UAV Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07099)
*Hongyang Zhang,Maonnan Wang,Ziyao Wang,Hongrui Yin,Man On Pun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出InfoGeo框架，利用信息瓶颈理论和物体中心学习来增强跨视角地理定位在复杂环境下的鲁棒性和泛化能力，显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法依赖全局特征对齐，但受区域纹理和天气变化引起的域偏移影响严重，尤其在无人机视角下，广阔视野引入密集细粒度物体造成视觉杂乱，导致性能下降。

Method: 受物体中心学习启发，提出InfoGeo信息论框架，将优化重构为信息瓶颈过程，包含两个核心目标：(i) 通过对齐跨视角的物体中心结构关系最大化视角不变信息；(ii) 通过跨视角知识约束最小化视角特定噪声信号。

Result: 在多个基准数据集和挑战性场景下的广泛评估表明，InfoGeo显著优于当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: InfoGeo通过物体中心的结构关系对齐和跨视角知识约束，有效解决了域偏移和视觉杂乱问题，为跨视角地理定位提供了更具鲁棒性和泛化能力的解决方案。

Abstract: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) is fundamental for precise localization and navigation in GPS-denied environments, aiming to match ground or UAV imagery with satellite views. Existing approaches often rely on global feature alignment, but they suffer from substantial domain shifts induced by varying regional textures and weather conditions. This issue becomes even more pronounced in UAV-based scenarios, where the broader perspective inevitably introduces dense, fine-grained objects, creating significant visual clutter. To address this, we draw inspiration from Object-Centric Learning (OCL) and propose InfoGeo, an information-theoretic framework designed to enhance robustness and generalization. InfoGeo reformulates the optimization as an information bottleneck process with two core objectives: (i) maximizing view-invariant information by aligning the object-centric structural relations across views, and (ii) minimizing view-specific noisy signals through cross-view knowledge constraints. Extensive evaluations across diverse benchmarks and challenging scenarios demonstrate that InfoGeo significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [172] [CaC: Advancing Video Reward Models via Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Concentrating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11723)
*Jiyuan Wang,Huan Ouyang,Jiuzhou Lin,Chunyu Lin,Dewen Fan,Boheng Zhang,Haonan Fan,Fei Zuo,Jia Sun,Huaiqing Wang,Honglie Wang,Yiyang Fan,Zhenlong Yuan,Zijun Li,Yongrui Heng,Guosheng Lin,Fan Yang,Tingting Gao*

Main category: cs.CV
