TL;DR: 本文提出CaC（Concentrate and Concentrate），一种基于视觉语言模型的由粗到细的异常奖励模型，通过全局时间扫描、局部空间定位和结构化时空思维链推理来检测视频异常。该方法使用大规模生成式视频异常数据集进行三阶段渐进训练，包括单/多帧监督微调和基于两轮GRPO的强化学习，引入时空IoU奖励。实验表明CaC在细粒度异常基准上准确率提升25.7%，作为奖励信号可减少11.7%的生成视频异常。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在细粒度视频异常检测中缺乏对时空异常的精确定位和推理能力，难以从粗粒度视频理解过渡到细粒度异常感知，需要一种能够从粗到细聚焦异常、并具备结构化推理能力的奖励模型。

Method: 采用由粗到细的CaC框架：推理时先全局时间扫描定位异常时间窗，再局部空间细化定位，最后通过时空思维链推理输出判断。构建首个大规模生成式视频异常数据集（含逐帧边界框、时间窗和细粒度归因标注）。设计三阶段渐进训练：阶段一单帧SFT学习空间锚定，阶段二多帧SFT学习时间锚定，阶段三两轮GRPO强化学习优化，引入时间IoU和空间IoU奖励监督中间定位过程。

Result: 在细粒度异常基准上准确率提升25.7%；作为奖励信号用于视频生成时，异常减少11.7%且整体视频质量提升。

Conclusion: CaC通过粗到细的聚焦机制和结构化时空推理，有效提升了视觉语言模型在细粒度异常检测中的性能，并能作为可解释的奖励信号改善视频生成质量。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose Concentrate and Concentrate (CaC), a coarse-to-fine anomaly reward model based on Vision-Language Models. During inference, it first conducts a global temporal scan to anchor anomalous time windows, then performs fine-grained spatial grounding within the localized interval, and finally derives robust judgments via structured spatiotemporal Chain-of-Thought reasoning. To equip the model with these capabilities, we construct the first large-scale generated video anomaly dataset with per-frame bounding-box annotations, temporal anomaly windows, and fine-grained attribution labels. Building on this dataset, we design a three-stage progressive training paradigm. The model initially learns spatial and temporal anchoring through single- and multi-frame supervised fine-tuning, and then is optimized by a reinforcement learning strategy based on two-turn Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Beyond conventional accuracy rewards, we introduce Temporal and Spatial IoU rewards to supervise the intermediate localization process, effectively guiding the model toward more grounded and interpretable spatiotemporal reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CaC can stably concentrate on subtle anomalies, achieving a 25.7% accuracy improvement on fine-grained anomaly benchmarks and, when used as a reward signal, CaC reduces generated-video anomalies by 11.7% while improving overall video quality.

</details>


### [173] [ProtoMedAgent: Multimodal Clinical Interpretability via Privacy-Aware Agentic Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14113)
*Alvaro Lopez Pellicer,Plamen Angelov,Marwan Bukhari,Yi Li,Eduardo Soares,Jemma Kerns*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProtoMedAgent是一个通过神经符号瓶颈将原型网络输出转化为结构化临床报告的框架，采用零梯度测试时优化、精确集合差分和Scribe-Critic循环来严格约束生成过程，在4160名患者队列上实现了91.2%的比较集忠实度，远超标准RAG的46.2%，并通过ℓ-多样性相变将成员推断风险降低9.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可解释原型网络在临床诊断中提供了基于案例的推理，但其连续输出缺乏医疗文档所需的语义结构。标准RAG在桥接这一差距时会出现"检索谄媚"现象，即LLM为对齐视觉预测而生成事后合理化幻觉。

Method: 将多模态临床报告形式化为迭代的零梯度测试时优化问题，在冻结的原型骨干网络上，将潜在视觉和表格特征蒸馏为离散语义记忆。在线生成受精确集合差分和Scribe-Critic循环严格约束，并通过基于k-匿名和ℓ-多样性的语义隐私门控来安全限制数据披露。

Result: 在4160名患者队列上，ProtoMedAgent的比较集忠实度达91.2%，远超标准RAG的46.2%；通过ℓ-多样性相变将成员推断风险降低9.8%。

Conclusion: ProtoMedAgent通过严格的神经符号瓶颈和形式化约束，有效解决了原型网络输出到临床文档的语义鸿沟问题，在忠实度和隐私保护方面均显著优于标准RAG方法。

Abstract: While interpretable prototype networks offer compelling case-based reasoning for clinical diagnostics, their raw continuous outputs lack the semantic structure required for medical documentation. Bridging this gap via standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) routinely triggers ``retrieval sycophancy,'' where Large Language Models (LLMs) hallucinate post-hoc rationalizations to align with visual predictions. We introduce ProtoMedAgent, a framework that formalizes multimodal clinical reporting as an iterative, zero-gradient test-time optimization problem over a strict neuro-symbolic bottleneck. Operating on a frozen prototype backbone, we distill latent visual and tabular features into a discrete semantic memory. Online generation is strictly constrained by exact set-theoretic differentials and a reflective Scribe-Critic loop, mathematically precluding unsupported narrative claims. To safely bound data disclosure, we introduce a semantic privacy gate governed by $k$-anonymity and $\ell$-diversity. Evaluated on a 4,160-patient clinical cohort, ProtoMedAgent achieves 91.2% Comparison Set Faithfulness where it fundamentally outperforms standard RAG (46.2%). ProtoMedAgent additionally leverages a binding $\ell$-diversity phase transition to systematically reduce artifact-level membership inference risks by an absolute 9.8%.

</details>


### [174] [Diagnosing and Correcting Concept Omission in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14270)
*Kanghyun Baek,Jaihyun Lew,Chaehun Shin,Jungbeom Lee,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出遗漏信号干预（OSI）方法，通过放大文本嵌入中的"遗漏信号"来缓解多模态扩散Transformer（MM-DiTs）在文本到图像生成中的概念遗漏问题，在FLUX.1-Dev和SD3.5-Medium上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态扩散Transformer（MM-DiTs）在文本到图像生成中常出现概念遗漏问题，即指定的对象或属性未能出现在生成图像中。

Method: 通过对文本token进行线性探针分析，发现文本嵌入中存在表征目标概念缺失的"遗漏信号"；据此提出遗漏信号干预（OSI），通过放大该信号来主动催化缺失概念的生成。

Result: 在FLUX.1-Dev和SD3.5-Medium上的实验表明，OSI即使在极端场景下也能显著缓解概念遗漏问题。

Conclusion: OSI通过利用和放大遗漏信号，有效改善了MM-DiTs中概念遗漏的缺陷，提升了文本到图像生成的完整性和准确性。

Abstract: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have achieved remarkable progress in text-to-image generation, yet they frequently suffer from concept omission, where specified objects or attributes fail to emerge in the generated image. By performing linear probing on text tokens, we demonstrate that text embeddings can distinguish a characteristic `omission signal' representing the absence of target concepts. Leveraging this insight, we propose Omission Signal Intervention (OSI), which amplifies the omission signal to actively catalyze the generation of missing concepts. Comprehensive experiments on FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Medium demonstrate that OSI significantly alleviates concept omission even in extreme scenarios.

</details>


### [175] [GHOST: Geometry-Hierarchical Online Streaming Token Eviction for Efficient 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15852)
*Leyang Chen,Junyi Wu,Zhiteng Li,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GHOST是一个无需训练的KV缓存管理框架，利用模型自身的3D几何输出在线驱逐冗余token，在保持重建质量的同时将KV缓存削减近一半，推理速度提升1.75倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频单目流式3D重建中，KV缓存随序列长度线性增长造成严重内存瓶颈；现有方法要么截断缓存导致重建质量下降，要么使用与3D场景结构无关的注意力分数启发式方法，无法保留几何上有价值的token。

Method: 提出GHOST框架，包含三项相互增强的创新：分层双级重要性评分机制、保护特殊token不被驱逐的特权机制、余弦相似度引导的逐层预算分配策略。

Result: 在多个基准上保持优异重建质量，KV缓存削减近一半，推理速度相比现有最优方法提升1.75倍。

Conclusion: GHOST有效解决了长视频流式3D重建中的KV缓存内存瓶颈问题，实现了高效的内存管理与高质量重建的平衡。

Abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction from long monocular video sequences requires maintaining a key-value (KV) cache that grows linearly with sequence length, creating a severe memory bottleneck. Existing approaches either truncate the cache to a fixed set of anchor frames, leading to reconstruction quality degradation, or rely on attention-score heuristics that are agnostic to 3D scene structure, failing to preserve geometrically valuable tokens. To address these problems, we present GHOST (Geometry-Hierarchical Online Streaming Token Eviction), a training-free KV cache management framework that exploits the model's own 3D geometry outputs to evict redundant tokens online. GHOST introduces three mutually reinforcing innovations: a hierarchical dual-level importance scoring scheme, a privilege mechanism that protects special tokens from eviction, and a cosine-similarity-guided layer-wise budget allocation. Experiments on various benchmarks show that GHOST preserves excellent reconstruction quality while cutting the KV cache by nearly half and delivering 1.75x faster inference compared to state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/lokiniuniu/GHOST.

</details>


### [176] [Hilbert-Geo: Solving Solid Geometric Problems by Neural-Symbolic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16385)
*Ruoran Xu,Haoyu Cheng,Bin Dong,Qiufeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Hilbert-Geo，首个立体几何统一形式化语言框架，并基于该框架提出Parse2Reason方法（先解析后推理），在立体几何和平面几何任务上均取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何推理工作主要聚焦平面几何，由于3D空间图示和复杂推理的限制，在立体几何上通常失败。为弥合这一差距，亟需一个统一的立体几何形式化语言框架。

Method: 提出Hilbert-Geo框架（包含谓词库和定理库），以及Parse2Reason方法：解析阶段使用条件描述语言（CDL）将问题文本和立体图像形式化为结构化谓词；推理阶段利用CDL和定理库进行关系推理和代数计算，生成可验证的推理过程。

Result: 在SolidFGeo2k上达77.3%，在MathVerse-Solid上达84.1%，显著优于Gemini-2.5-pro（54.2%）和GPT-5（62.9%）；在平面几何数据集PlaneFGeo3k上达80.2%，验证了框架的通用性。

Conclusion: Hilbert-Geo作为首个立体几何统一形式化语言框架，结合Parse2Reason方法有效解决了立体几何推理难题，同时兼容平面几何，展示了良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Geometric problem solving, as a typical multimodal reasoning problem, has attracted much attention and made great progress recently, however most of works focus on plane geometry while usually fail in solid geometry due to 3D spatial diagrams and complex reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce Hilbert-Geo, the first unified formal language framework for solid geometry, including an extensive predicate library and a dedicated theorem bank. Based on this framework, we propose a Parse2Reason method containing two steps of first parsing then reasoning. In the parsing step, we utilize conditional description language (CDL), a formalized language composed of predicates specifically designed to construct geometric conditions, to represent both problem description (natural text) and solid diagrams (visual image). In the reasoning step, we leverage those formal CDL and the theorem bank to perform relational inference and algebraic computation, generating strictly correct, verifiable, and human-readable reasoning processes. Notably, our proposed Hilbert-Geo is also applicable to plane geometry. To advance geometric reasoning, we curate two expert-annotated dataset SolidFGeo2k and PlaneFGeo3k, which are furnished with geometric formal language annotations, solutions and answers. Extensive experiments show that our proposed method achieves the state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance 77.3% in SolidFGeo2k and 84.1% in MathVerse-Solid (one small subset in MathVerse dedicated to solid geometry), substantially outperforming leading MLLMs, such as Gemini-2.5-pro (54.2% on SolidFGeo2k) and GPT-5 (62.9% on MathVerse-Solid). In addition, our method achieves the SOTA accuracy 80.2% in PlaneFGeo3k, demonstrating the generality of the Hilbert-Geo in geometric reasoning. Our code and datasets will be publicly available.

</details>


### [177] [Diffusion Models, Denoiser Architecture and Creativity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16415)
*Itamar Levine,Yair Weiss*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过理论和实验证明，扩散模型的创造性源于去噪器架构与目标分布之间的交互作用，而非模型本身的固有特性。不同架构（线性、多项式、瓶颈）会导致不同的生成分布，且UNET架构的微小变化会显著影响生成样本的真实性，表明去噪器的归纳偏置必须与目标分布强对齐才能成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型能够生成与训练数据不同的高度真实图像（即具有"创造性"），这与已知理论（若使用贝叶斯最优去噪器，模型只会复制训练样本）相矛盾，作者试图解释这一悖论。

Method: 理论推导了三种去噪器架构（线性、多项式、瓶颈）下生成样本分布与目标分布及架构的显式关系；实验上通过修改UNET架构的微小部分观察创造性变化。

Result: 不同去噪器架构导致不同的创造性形式；UNET架构的微小改动常使生成样本高度不真实；去噪器的归纳偏置与目标分布的强对齐是扩散模型成功的关键。

Conclusion: 扩散模型的创造性并非模型本身的固有属性，而是去噪器架构的归纳偏置与目标分布相互作用的结果，这解释了为什么实际中扩散模型能产生创造性输出而非简单复制训练数据。

Abstract: The creativity of diffusion models refers to their ability to generate highly realistic images that are different from their training data. Creativity is somewhat surprising since it is known that if the denoiser used in the diffusion model is the Bayes optimal denoiser for a given training set, then the model will simply copy the training samples. In this paper we present empirical and theoretical results that suggest that creativity in diffusion models is due to an interaction between the denoiser architecture and the target distribution. Theoretically, we give explicit forms for the distribution of generated samples as a function of the target distribution and the denoiser architecture for three different denoiser architectures (linear, polynomial, bottleneck). Empirically, we show that small changes in the popular UNET denoiser architecture leads to very different forms of creativity, and these small changes often yield samples that are highly nonrealistic. Taken together, our results show that diffusion models will only be successful if the inductive bias of the denoiser architecture is in strong alignment with the true target distribution.

</details>


### [178] [HyperVision: A Channel-Adaptive Ground-Based Hyperspectral Vision Pre-trained Backbone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17286)
*Guanyiman Fu,Jingtao Li,Zihang Cheng,Zhuanfeng Li,Diqi Chen,Yan Xu,Xiangyu Liu,Fengchao Xiong,Jianfeng Lu,Chengrong Chen,Jun Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HyperVision是首个地面高光谱预训练骨干网络，通过通道自适应动态嵌入、多源伪标签和跨模态知识蒸馏，在26个数据集上预训练，仅需头部微调即可在语义分割、目标跟踪和显著性检测三个下游任务中达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地面高光谱成像缺乏通用的预训练骨干网络，面临传感器光谱配置差异大、标注数据稀缺且不一致、现有数据集规模和场景多样性有限三大挑战。

Method: 1) 通道自适应动态嵌入机制处理异构光谱输入；2) 多源伪标签方法融合SAM2空间结构和HyperFree光谱材料信息进行无监督学习；3) 跨模态知识蒸馏从预训练RGB视觉模型迁移语义表示。

Result: 在15k图像、26个数据集上预训练后，仅需头部适配，在高光谱语义分割Acc_M提升16.3%，目标跟踪AUC提升2.1%，显著性检测MAE降低35.5%。

Conclusion: HyperVision证明了首个地面高光谱通用预训练骨干的有效性，克服了光谱异构和标注不足等核心难题，为高光谱基础模型奠定了基础。

Abstract: While hyperspectral imaging provides rich spatial-spectral information across hundreds of narrow wavelength bands for precise material identification, ground-based hyperspectral pre-trained backbones remain absent, constrained by varying spectral configurations across sensors, the scarcity and inconsistency of labels, and the limited scale and scene diversity of existing datasets. To address these challenges and enable universal perception, we propose HyperVision, the first ground-based hyperspectral pre-trained backbone. First, to handle varying spectral configurations, HyperVision adopts a channel-adaptive dynamic embedding mechanism to map heterogeneous inputs into a unified token space. Second, we develop an unsupervised representation learning framework. Specifically, to address label scarcity and inconsistency, a multi-source pseudo-labeling method is introduced to fuse spatial structures from SAM2 and fine-grained spectral material information from HyperFree. Furthermore, to enrich scene diversity and compensate for limited dataset scale, a cross-modal knowledge distillation mechanism is utilized to transfer rich semantic representations from a pre-trained RGB vision model to our backbone. Pre-trained on a collection of 15k images from 26 diverse ground-based datasets, HyperVision demonstrates exceptional generalization. Requiring only efficient head-only adaptation without adjusting backbone parameters, it achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to task-specific methods across three downstream tasks under varying sensor configurations, yielding up to a 16.3% relative improvement in hyperspectral semantic segmentation $\mathrm{Acc}_{\mathrm{M}}$, a 2.1% relative gain in object tracking AUC, and a 35.5% reduction in salient object detection MAE. The source code and pre-trained model will be publicly available on https://github.com/lronkitty/HyperVision .

</details>


### [179] [TWINGS: Thin Plate Splines Warp-aligned Initialization for Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22069)
*Hyeseong Kim,Geonhui Son,Deukhee Lee,Dosik Hwang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TWINGS通过薄板样条（TPS）变形模型对齐反投影点与三角化控制点，为3D高斯泼溅提供几何精确的初始化，显著提升稀疏视图下的新视角合成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视图输入下，3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）面临点云稀疏性问题，导致场景重建质量下降。

Method: 采用薄板样条（TPS）平滑非刚性变形模型，通过最小化弯曲能量从控制点对应关系估计全局连贯的变形场，将深度估计反投影点与三角化3D控制点对齐，生成校准后的反投影点；随后在控制点附近采样这些校准点，为3DGS提供快速且几何精确的初始化。

Result: 在DTU、LLFF和Mip-NeRF360数据集上，TWINGS在稀疏视图场景下始终优于现有方法，重建细节保持和颜色保真度更优。

Conclusion: TWINGS通过解决点云稀疏性问题，有效提升了稀疏视图下3DGS的重建质量，实现了结构细节和颜色保真的显著改善。

Abstract: Novel view synthesis from sparse-view inputs poses a significant challenge in 3D computer vision, particularly for achieving high-quality scene reconstructions with limited viewpoints. We introduce TWINGS, a framework that enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) by directly addressing point sparsity. We employ Thin Plate Splines (TPS), a smooth non-rigid deformation model that minimizes bending energy to estimate a globally coherent warp from control-point correspondences, to align backprojected points from estimated depth with triangulated 3D control points, yielding calibrated backprojected points. By sampling these calibrated points near the control points, TWINGS provides a fast and geometrically accurate initialization for 3DGS, ultimately improving structural detail preservation and color fidelity in reconstructed scenes. Extensive experiments on DTU, LLFF, and Mip-NeRF360 demonstrate that TWINGS consistently outperforms existing methods, delivering detailed and accurate reconstructions under sparse-view scenarios.

</details>


### [180] [JMed48k: A Multi-Profession Japanese Medical Licensing Benchmark for Vision-Language Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22080)
*Yue Xun,Junyu Liu,Qian Niu,Xinyi Wang,Zheng Yuan,Zirui Li,Zequn Zhang,Bowen Zhao,Shujun Wang,Irene Li,Kan Hatakeyama-Sato,Yusuke Iwasawa,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JMed48k是一个包含48,862道题目和20,142张图像的多职业日本医疗执照考试基准，用于评估视觉语言模型。通过分析21个模型在文本和图像场景下的表现，发现专有和开源模型能从图像中获益，而医学专用模型对视觉证据利用有限。图像移除的影响在不同职业间差异显著（从+5.7到+39.8个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗执照评估基准多聚焦单一职业或通用医学知识，缺乏跨职业、多模态的日语医疗基准，无法系统评估视觉语言模型在不同医疗专业场景下的表现。

Method: 从日本厚生劳动省官方PDF中提取2005-2025年11种国家执照考试的48,862道题目和20,142张图像，按8类视觉内容分类。构建JMed48k-Eval评估子集（5年内12,484道计分题），评估21个模型（含专有、开源、医学专用），并设计配对图像移除审计（在移除图像前后对比答案变化，分析四种答案转换状态）。

Result: 专有和开源模型从图像中获益显著，而医学专用系统对视觉证据利用有限（移除图像后许多正确答案仍然保持）。图像移除的净效果在不同职业间差异达七倍：医师题目+5.7分，公共卫生护士题目+39.8分。

Conclusion: JMed48k为视觉语言模型在医疗执照场景下提供了可复现、按职业分层评估的基准，揭示了当前模型在视觉信息利用方面的显著差异，特别是医学专用模型存在视觉证据利用不足的问题。

Abstract: We introduce JMed48k, a multi-profession Japanese healthcare licensing benchmark for evaluating vision-language models. Built from official PDF materials released by the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, JMed48k contains 48,862 exam questions and 20,142 images from 11 national licensing examinations between 2005 and 2025, with visual content annotated under an 8-type taxonomy. From this corpus, we derive JMed48k-Eval, a recent five-year evaluation subset with 12,484 scored questions, including 9,905 text-only questions and 2,579 questions with images. We evaluate 21 proprietary, open-source, and medical-specific models, reporting text-only and with-image performance separately. Because these subsets contain different questions, we further introduce a paired image-removal audit that evaluates questions with images before and after removing visual content to explore four answer-transition states. The audit shows that proprietary and open source models gain substantially from images, whereas medical-specific systems show limited observable use of visual evidence, with many correct answers persisting after image removal. Even among proprietary models, the net image-removal effect varies sevenfold across professions, from +5.7 points on Physician questions to +39.8 points on Public Health Nurse questions. We release JMed48k to support reproducible, profession-stratified evaluation of vision-language models in medical licensing settings.

</details>


### [181] [Direct content-based retrieval from music scores images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22255)
*Noelia Luna-Barahona,Antonio Ríos-Vila,Félix Fuentes-Hurtado,David Rizo,Jorge Calvo-Zaragoza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了音乐乐谱图像的内容检索方法，比较了基于OMR的转录方法、无转录的Transformer模型和基于文本提示的大语言模型在四个不同语料库上的表现。OMR方法在领域内检索表现更好，而无转录模型在跨领域泛化方面更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乐谱数字化对保存和可访问性至关重要，但目前信息检索主要依赖元数据搜索（如标题或作曲家），而基于内容的乐谱图像检索尚未得到充分探索，对音乐家、音乐学家和教育工作者具有潜在价值。

Method: 首先研究乐谱检索中最相关的特征，并定义从任何标注语料库构建查询数据集的系统方法。实验对比了三种方法：基于OMR的转录方法、基于Transformer的无转录模型（直接从乐谱图像识别查询）、以及基于文本提示的大语言模型。在四个具有不同规模、图像质量和排版方式的语料库上进行评估。

Result: OMR流水线在领域内检索上表现更优；无转录模型在处理领域变化方面更有效；每种方法在不同条件下各有优势。

Conclusion: 不同乐谱检索方法各有适用场景：OMR方法适合领域内高精度检索，无转录模型更适合跨领域泛化场景，展现了内容检索在音乐乐谱图像中的可行性。

Abstract: The digitization of musical scores plays a crucial role in their preservation and accessibility, yet information retrieval still depends mainly on metadata searches, such as by title or composer. Content based search in music score images remains underexplored compared to text documents, despite its potential value for musicians, musicologists, and educators. This work contributes to the field by first studying which characteristics of a score are most relevant for search and by defining a systematic method to build query datasets from any annotated corpus. We also consider diverse methods for content-based search on music score images, ranging from transcription-based approaches relying on Optical Music Recognition (OMR), to a transcription-free Transformer model trained to recognize queries directly from score images, and a text-prompted Large Language Model. Our experiments evaluate these models on four corpora exhibiting diverse characteristics in terms of dataset size, image quality, and typesetting mechanisms. Overall, each method excels under different conditions: OMR-based pipelines achieve higher in-domain retrieval, whereas transcription-free models handle domain variability more effectively.

</details>


### [182] [SCOPE: Simulating Cross-game Operations in Playable Environments for FPS World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23345)
*Zizhao Tong,Yeying Jin,Hongfeng Lai,Zeqing Wang,Zhaohu Xing,Kexu Cheng,Haoran Xu,Zhao Pu,Shangwen Zhu,Ruili Feng,Jian Zhao,Yan Zhang,Hao Tang,Ling Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SCOPE框架，通过将动作条件注入预训练视频扩散模型的每个transformer块，实现FPS游戏中高频重叠控制信号的像素级时空分离，并构建首个多游戏FPS数据集CrossFPS，支持零样本跨游戏迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在单游戏上全局注入动作，无法处理FPS游戏中每帧高频重叠控制信号（如射击与移动并存），导致未受影响区域被破坏。

Method: 在预训练视频扩散模型的每个transformer块中插入条件模块，将特征重塑为逐像素时间序列，使每个位置依据局部视觉内容计算动作响应，无需分割标签即可分离in-scope（武器局部区域）与out-of-scope效果；同时构建CrossFPS多游戏数据集（7款游戏69K片段，10自由度控制器信号）。

Result: 实验验证了强动作响应性、精确的scope分离效果以及有效的跨游戏泛化能力。

Conclusion: SCOPE通过像素级时空动作条件注入，成功解决了FPS游戏中高频重叠控制信号的建模难题，并首次实现了零样本跨游戏迁移。

Abstract: Interactive world models for first-person shooter (FPS) games must resolve high-frequency overlapping control signals at every frame without disrupting unaffected regions. Existing methods inject actions globally and train on single titles, failing under dense FPS inputs. We observe that FPS actions are spatially selective: discrete events such as firing or reloading affect only a localized region around the weapon (the scope), while continuous camera and movement signals govern stable surroundings. We propose SCOPE, which inserts a conditioning module into each transformer block of a pretrained video diffusion model. It reshapes features into per-pixel temporal sequences so that each position computes its action response from local visual content. This separates in-scope effects from out-of-scope generation without segmentation labels. We also introduce CrossFPS, the first multi-game FPS dataset with frame-aligned action telemetry. It comprises 69K clips from 7 titles with 10-DoF controller signals, curated to remove gameplay bias. The model learns general visual-to-action mappings rather than game-specific patterns, enabling zero-shot transfer to unseen scenes. Experiments confirm strong action responsiveness, precise scope separation, and effective cross-game generalization.

</details>


### [183] [PixIE: Prompted Pixel-Space Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23531)
*Ruirui Lin,Guoxi Huang,David Bull,Nantheera Anantrasirichai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixIE是一种利用视觉基础模型（DINOv3）语义提示的像素级低光图像增强框架，通过跨尺度去噪、DINO提示像素块（DPPB）细节恢复、空间-通道压缩（SCC）和多感受野像素嵌入（MRPE）等技术，在LLIE基准上PSNR提升1.9-15.0%，LPIPS降低8.5-44.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光图像存在严重噪声、对比度损失和语义模糊，使得增强成为一个去噪与细节恢复的联合问题。现有方法难以同时有效处理噪声抑制和细节保真。

Method: 1) 跨尺度去噪（cross-scale denoising）抑制噪声并保持结构；2) DINO提示像素块（DPPBs）注入中间层DINOv3特征进行逐像素调制；3) 空间-通道压缩（SCC）联合降低空间token网格和通道维度，实现高效像素级注意力；4) 多感受野像素嵌入（MRPE）提供邻域感知的像素表示，增强对信号相关噪声的鲁棒性。

Result: 在LLIE基准上，PixIE相比近期SOTA方法PSNR提升1.9-15.0%，LPIPS降低8.5-44.4%，定性结果显示出更清晰的细节和更稳定的纹理。

Conclusion: PixIE通过语义引导的像素级增强框架，同时提升了重建保真度和感知质量，证明了语义提示与像素空间操作结合的有效性。

Abstract: Low-light images suffer from severe noise, contrast loss, and semantic ambiguity, making enhancement a joint problem of denoising and detail recovery. We propose PixIE, a feed-forward pixel-space LLIE framework semantically prompted by a vision foundation model. PixIE first performs cross-scale denoising to suppress noise and preserve structure, then refines details using DINO-Prompted Pixel Blocks (DPPBs), which inject intermediate DINOv3 features through patch-conditioned, spatially continuous per-pixel modulation. To make pixel-space attention efficient across scales, we introduce Spatial-Channel Compaction (SCC), which jointly reduces the spatial token grid and channel dimension. We further propose Multi-Receptive-Field Pixel Embedding (MRPE) to provide neighborhood-aware pixel representations before semantic prompting, improving robustness to signal-dependent noise beyond point-wise embeddings. Experiments on LLIE benchmarks show that PixIE improves average PSNR by 1.9-15.0% over recent state-of-the-art methods and reduces LPIPS by 8.5-44.4%. Qualitative comparisons further show sharper details and more stable textures, improving both reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality.

</details>


### [184] [Nano World Models: A Minimalist Implementation of Future Video Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23993)
*Siqiao Huang,Partha Kaushik,Michael Chen,Hengkai Pan,Kaiwen Geng,Omar Chehab,Fernando Moreno-Pino,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Nano World Models 是一个围绕扩散驱动（diffusion forcing）构建的极简代码库，用于未来视频预测。它提供了统一的生成目标、模型规模、动作调节机制、隐空间、数据集、评估协议和长程推演接口，支持可重复、可扩展的世界模型科学研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管工业级交互视频生成发展迅速，但研究社区仍缺乏紧凑、可重复、易扩展的实现来研究现代世界模型的设计选择，现有实现之间各组件往往纠缠不清。

Method: 基于扩散驱动（diffusion forcing）构建极简代码库，提供统一的生成目标、模型规模、动作调节、隐空间观测、数据集、评估协议和长程推演接口，实现在简单控制环境、游戏仿真、真实机器人数据上的可控实验。

Result: 系统研究了预测参数化、架构规模、动作注入、采样预算和领域复杂度对视频预测质量及自回归推演行为的影响。

Conclusion: Nano World Models 通过开源代码、配置、评估脚本和预训练检查点，为开放、可重复、科学化的世界模型研究提供了一个紧凑且可扩展的实验基础。

Abstract: World models have become a central paradigm for learning predictive simulators that support generation, planning, and decision-making. Yet, despite rapid progress in industry-scale interactive video generation, the broader research community still lacks compact, reproducible, and easily extensible implementations for studying the design choices underlying modern world models. We introduce Nano World Models, a minimalist codebase for future video prediction centered around diffusion forcing. Nano World Models provides a unified interface for generative objectives, model scales, action-conditioning mechanisms, latent observation spaces, datasets, evaluation protocols, and long-horizon rollout procedures. This design enables controlled studies of world-modeling components that are often entangled across separate implementations. Through experiments across simple control environments, game simulation, and real-robot data, we examine how prediction parameterization, architecture scale, action injection, sampling budget, and domain complexity affect video prediction quality and autoregressive rollout behavior. By releasing code, configurations, evaluation scripts, and pretrained checkpoints, Nano World Models aims to provide a compact yet extensible experimental substrate for open, reproducible, and scientific world-model research.

</details>


### [185] [Coarse-to-Fine Domain Incremental Learning with Attentive Distillation for Mining Footprint Segmentation in Multispectral Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24460)
*Alif Tri Handoyo,Vincent C. S. Lee,Rizka Widyarini Purwanto,Alex M. Lechner,Deanna Kemp,Muhamad Risqi U. Saputra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MineC2FNet，一种粗到细的域增量学习框架，利用丰富的粗粒度边界数据提升细粒度矿区足迹分割性能，通过师生架构和注意力蒸馏机制处理域偏移，并发布了包含219张精细标注图像的数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的全球采矿足迹自动分割受限于精细标注数据的稀缺性，而大规模粗边界数据集虽易获取，但由于显著的域偏移问题难以直接用于提升精细分割性能。

Method: MineC2FNet采用师生架构，在特征层和预测层引入注意力蒸馏机制，选择性迁移粗域中的通用知识，同时利用有限的细粒度数据进行边界细化，实现从粗到细的域增量学习。

Result: 与最新的域适应和域增量学习方法相比，MineC2FNet在矿区足迹分割任务上取得了更优性能，有效处理了域偏移问题。

Conclusion: 所提出的粗到细域增量学习框架能够有效利用粗粒度数据提升精细分割任务，同时发布的精细标注数据集和代码将推动该领域研究进展。

Abstract: Automatically mapping and segmenting global mining footprints using remote sensing and deep learning is critical for monitoring the socio-environmental risks and impacts of mining, yet its progress is hindered by the scarcity of fine-grained annotated data. Although large-scale datasets with coarse boundaries are widely available, leveraging them to improve fine-grained segmentation is challenging due to significant domain shift. To address this, we propose MineC2FNet, a coarse-to-fine domain incremental learning framework that exploits abundant coarse data to enhance fine-grained mining footprint segmentation. MineC2FNet adopts a teacher-student architecture with attentive distillation at both the feature and prediction levels, selectively transferring generalized knowledge from the coarse domain while enabling boundary refinement using limited fine-grained data (fine domain). We further introduce an expertly validated dataset of 219 images with precise boundary annotations across diverse geographies and commodities. Extensive experiments against state-of-the-art approaches, including domain adaptation and domain incremental learning methods, demonstrate that MineC2FNet achieves superior performance while effectively handling domain shift. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/risqiutama/MineC2FNet.

</details>


### [186] [SRUG: Shadow-Guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24700)
*Yonghao Zhao,Zexin Yin,Jian Yang,Beibei Wang,Jin Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SRUG框架，通过阴影引导的3D补全模型恢复不可见区域几何，结合迭代材质分解方案和物理光照模型，实现城市场景的可重照明，在视图合成和重照明任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市场景重照明存在两大挑战：1）不可见区域投射的阴影难以合理建模；2）稀疏输入视图和复杂光照条件导致材质分解存在严重歧义。

Method: 1）阴影引导的3D补全模型恢复不可见区域几何；2）基于大材质模型（LMM）的迭代材质分解方案提供材质监督；3）物理光照模型捕捉复杂光照并支持可靠重照明。

Result: 在视图合成和重照明任务上，定量评估和视觉比较均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: SRUG通过阴影引导补全和迭代材质分解有效解决了城市场景重照明的病态问题，生成了物理合理的阴影和可靠的材质分解。

Abstract: Creating relightable urban scenes from images or videos is widely useful but highly ill-posed. Urban environments are typically unbounded and extend beyond the visible regions. As a result, many portions of the scene remain unobserved, yet these invisible regions can cast shadows onto visible areas. Reasonably modeling shadows cast by such invisible regions is challenging and poses a significant obstacle to creating relightable urban scenes. At the same time, sparse input views and complex illumination conditions further complicate relighting, as they introduce severe ambiguities in material decomposition. In this paper, we propose Shadow-guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation model (SRUG), a novel framework designed to address relighting challenges in urban scenes. SRUG leverages shadows to guide a 3D completion model for recovering the geometry of invisible regions, promoting the synthesis of physically reasonable shadows. In addition, SRUG employs an iterative material decomposition scheme that applies the large material model (LMM) to provide material supervision and iteratively decompose the scene's material properties, enabling robust material decomposition. Building upon these components, we introduce a physically-based lighting model that captures the complex illumination of urban scenes and supports reliable relighting. Extensive quantitative evaluations and visual comparisons demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both novel view synthesis and relighting tasks.

</details>


### [187] [VEOcc: Voxel-Centric Online Semantic Occupancy Prediction For Embodied Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25059)
*Ruoyu Wang,Yong Liu,Sheng Tao,Yuhang Lin,Yukai Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VEOcc是一种基于体素中心的在线3D占用预测与建图框架，通过递归感知-同化范式无需先验场景尺度估计，结合跨时间逻辑聚合、可靠性置信度调制和置信度驱动的增量状态更新策略，在局部和具身场景下达到SOTA性能，并展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高斯中心化方法难以保持结构边界保真度，且严重依赖预定义的场景尺寸先验，限制了操作效率。为解决这些问题，VEOcc旨在消除初始尺度估计需求，实现高效、开放式的在线地图扩展。

Method: 提出体素中心框架VEOcc，采用递归感知-同化范式；提出时空感知在线更新策略，包含三种核心机制：跨时间逻辑聚合（TLA）保证时序一致性、可靠性感知置信度调制（RCM）校准空间不确定性、置信度驱动的增量状态更新（CSU）实现鲁棒的全局状态同化。

Result: 在Occ-ScanNet和EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet数据集上达到SOTA性能；在自采集视频序列的零样本评估中展现出强大的分布外泛化能力。

Conclusion: VEOcc为自主探索提供了一种准确且高效的解决方案，在真实世界探索中具有实用价值。

Abstract: Crucial for autonomous exploration, online 3D occupancy prediction and mapping incrementally constructs dense spatial representations on the fly. However, recent Gaussian-centric methods struggle with structural boundary fidelity and rely heavily on predefined scene-size priors, fundamentally limiting their operational efficiency. In this work, we present VEOcc, a voxel-centric framework formulated as a recursive perception-and-assimilation paradigm. By eliminating the need for initial scale estimation, VEOcc enables highly streamlined, open-ended map expansion. Furthermore, to robustly aggregate noisy temporal observations within the discrete voxel space, we propose a Spatio-Temporal-Aware Online Update Strategy. It integrates Cross-Temporal Logit Aggregation (TLA) for temporal consistency, Reliability-Aware Confidence Modulation (RCM) for spatial uncertainty calibration, and Confidence-Driven Incremental State Update (CSU) for robust global state assimilation. % Extensive experiments on Occ-ScanNet and EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet demonstrate that VEOcc establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both local and embodied settings, providing an accurate and efficient solution for real-world exploration. Extensive experiments on Occ-ScanNet and EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet demonstrate that VEOcc establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both local and embodied settings. Notably, zero-shot evaluations on self-collected video sequences further confirm its robust out-of-distribution generalization capability in completely unseen real-world environments. Ultimately, our framework provides an accurate and highly efficient solution for autonomous exploration. Code and supplementary visualizations are available on our project page: https://wryzju.github.io/VEOcc/.

</details>


### [188] [A Principled Self-Referenced Early Stopping Approach for Deep Image Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25299)
*Chaoyan Huang,Cheng-Han Huang,Ismail R. Alkhouri,Rongrong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对深度图像先验（DIP）在无训练数据条件下求解逆成像问题时存在的过拟合问题，提出了一种基于伪自参考图像构建的早停检测框架，通过构造两个独立噪声副本的近似替代，实现了无需噪声水平估计的稳定早停策略，在多个逆成像任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DIP在优化过程中因网络过参数化会过拟合噪声测量，而现有基于输出方差波动的早停方法在应用中会出现波动过早导致重建不稳定的问题，亟需更鲁棒的过拟合检测方法。

Method: 1）理论证明当有两个独立噪声副本时可实现近乎最优的早停；2）由于实际中难以获得两个完全独立的副本，提出基于构造伪自参考图像的过拟合检测框架；3）设计了三种针对不同逆成像问题的具体算法；4）提供了单参考验证、伪验证估计和共享噪声影响的理论分析。

Result: 在自然图像恢复和医学图像重建等多种逆成像任务、不同噪声水平和噪声类型下，所提方法均一致优于现有DIP早停方法，且无需准确的噪声水平估计。

Conclusion: 本文提出的伪自参考图像早停框架有效解决了DIP过拟合检测中的稳定性问题，具有广泛的适用性和实用性。

Abstract: Recently, Deep Image Prior (DIP) has demonstrated strong capabilities for solving inverse imaging problems (IIPs) by optimizing a randomly initialized convolutional neural network in a training-data-free regime. However, DIP suffers from overfitting to noisy measurements due to network over-parameterization, making early stopping (ES) essential. The most successful ES method tracks fluctuations in the running variance of the network output to detect overfitting. However, in many applications, these fluctuations may appear prematurely, leading to unstable reconstructions. In this paper, we first show that nearly optimal DIP early stopping can be achieved when two independent noisy copies of the degraded image are available. Motivated by this observation, and since obtaining two fully independent copies is infeasible, we propose an overfitting detection framework based on constructing pseudo self-referenced images, resulting in three IIP-specific algorithms. Our approach is further supported by theoretical results on single-reference validation, pseudo-validation estimation, and the impact of shared noise. Across different IIPs, ranging from natural image restoration to medical image reconstruction, and under varying noise levels and noise types, our methods consistently outperform existing DIP early stopping approaches, all without requiring an accurate estimate of the noise level.

</details>


### [189] [Paris 2.0: A Decentralized Diffusion Model for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26064)
*Ali Rouzbayani,Bidhan Roy,Marcos Villagra,Zhiying Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Paris 2.0 是首个通过去中心化计算预训练的视频生成模型，在低分辨率文本到视频训练中，相比单体模型将FVD从561.04降至279.01（约2倍提升），同时提高了CLIP文本-视频相似度和美学评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 证明视频生成也可以通过去中心化训练（无需单体GPU集群）实现，解决去中心化训练中时序连贯视频生成这一悬而未决的问题。

Method: 基于Paris 1.0（去中心化扩散模型DDM）的训练方案，将去中心化训练从图像生成扩展到视频生成，构建了首个通过去中心化计算预训练的视频生成模型。

Result: 在低分辨率文本到视频训练中，相比相同数据和计算预算下的单体模型：FVD从561.04降至279.01（约2倍改进），CLIP文本-视频相似度和美学评分均有提升。

Conclusion: 去中心化训练在视频生成任务上不仅可行，而且性能优于同等条件下的单体模型，标志着去中心化视频生成的重要突破。

Abstract: We present Paris 2.0, the first video generation model pre-trained through decentralized computation. Its training recipe builds upon Paris 1.0 (arXiv:2510.03434), the first ever open-weight Decentralized Diffusion Model (DDM), which showed that image generation can be trained without a monolithic GPU cluster. However, temporally coherent video generation had remained an open problem under decentralized training, and Paris 2.0 closes it.
  In low-resolution text-to-video training, against a monolithic model trained on the same data under a matched total compute budget, Paris 2.0 cuts Frechet Video Distance (FVD) from 561.04 to 279.01, a ~2.0x improvement, and lifts CLIP text-video similarity and aesthetic score.

</details>


### [190] [Reinforcing Few-step Generators via Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26108)
*Yushi Huang,Xiangxin Zhou,Ruoyu Wang,Chi Zhang,Jun Zhang,Tianyu Pang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RTDMD是一个两阶段框架，通过统一分布匹配蒸馏与奖励引导的强化学习，实现了仅需4步推理即可在偏好、美学和组合性指标上达到最先进的少步文本到图像生成效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少步扩散蒸馏虽能高效生成图像，但将这些模型与人类偏好对齐仍然具有挑战性。

Method: 提出两阶段框架RTDMD：第一阶段引入AC-DMD，通过子区间分布匹配和一致性正则化跟踪生成器分布；第二阶段联合优化分布匹配项和奖励最大化项，其中奖励最大化项采用混合策略梯度（结合GRPO风格估计与直接奖励反向传播），并引入SubGRPO降低方差。

Result: 在SD3、SD3.5和FLUX.2上，RTDMD仅用4步推理就在偏好、美学和组合性指标上建立了新的最先进结果，优于此前所有少步文本到图像生成方法。

Conclusion: RTDMD成功统一了分布匹配蒸馏与奖励引导强化学习，为少步生成模型的对齐问题提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Recent advances in few-step diffusion distillation have enabled efficient image generation, yet aligning these models with human preferences remains challenging. We propose Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching Distillation (RTDMD), a two-stage framework that unifies distribution matching distillation with reward-guided reinforcement learning for few-step flow generators. We show that minimizing the KL divergence to a reward-tilted teacher distribution naturally decomposes into a distribution matching term and a reward maximization term. In the first stage, we introduce Ambient-Consistent Distribution Matching Distillation (AC-DMD), which performs subinterval-wise distribution matching and augments the fake score objective with a consistency regularizer to help the fake score model track the shifting generator distribution under limited updates. In the second stage, we jointly optimize both terms: for the reward maximization term, we derive a hybrid policy gradient that combines a GRPO-style estimator for the stochastic intermediate transitions with direct reward backpropagation through the deterministic final step, and further introduce step-subset GRPO (SubGRPO) to reduce variance. Experiments on SD3, SD3.5, and FLUX.2 demonstrate that RTDMD establishes new state-of-the-art results across preference, aesthetic, and compositional metrics with only 4 inference steps, outperforming previous few-step text-to-image generation methods. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Harahan/RTDMD.

</details>


### [191] [ChartAct: A Benchmark for Dynamic Chart Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26994)
*Muye Huang,Lin Wu,Lingling Zhang,Hang Yan,Zhiyuan Wang,Yumeng Fu,Zesheng Yang,Jun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ChartAct，一个针对动态图表理解的交互式基准测试。该基准包含673个来自真实网站的动态图表和1,440个问答样本，在动态图表和仪表板图表两种环境下评估模型。实验表明，现有模型（包括多模态模型和GUI代理）在动态图表理解上表现有限，最强模型Claude-Opus-4.7成功率为84.5%，多数模型低于60%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图表理解基准主要关注静态图表，而现实中的图表往往是动态且可交互的（如悬停、点击、缩放、拖动等操作后才能显示关键信息）。缺乏评估模型在交互环境下理解动态图表能力的基准。

Method: 构建ChartAct基准，从8个真实图表网站收集并筛选673个动态图表，涵盖7种常见图表类型，构建1,440个高质量问答样本。每个样本在动态图表和仪表板图表两种环境中实例化，并系统评估11种先进多模态模型和GUI代理。

Result: 最强模型Claude-Opus-4.7平均成功率为84.5%，但多数模型低于60%，说明现有模型在动态图表理解上仍存在明显局限性。

Conclusion: ChartAct为研究真实交互环境中的图表理解提供了新基准，揭示了现有模型在该任务上的不足。

Abstract: Charts are widely used to present complex data for analysis and decision making. Existing chart understanding benchmarks mainly focus on static charts, but real-world charts are often dynamic and interactive. Key information may only appear after actions such as hovering, clicking, zooming, or dragging. Dynamic chart understanding therefore requires models to identify visible content, choose proper interactions, and reason over changing chart states. To evaluate this ability, we propose ChartAct, an interactive benchmark for dynamic chart understanding. ChartAct collects and filters 673 dynamic charts from 8 real chart websites, covers 7 common chart types, and constructs 1,440 high-quality question-answer samples. Each sample is instantiated in two environments, Dynamic Chart and Dashboard Chart, to evaluate dynamic chart understanding under different contexts. Based on ChartAct, we systematically evaluate 11 advanced multimodal models and GUI agents. Experimental results show that existing models still have clear limitations in dynamic chart understanding. The strongest model, Claude-Opus-4.7, achieves an average success rate of 84.5\%, while most models remain below 60\%. We also conduct detailed failure attribution and case analysis. ChartAct provides a new benchmark for studying chart understanding in real interactive environments. Codes at https://github.com/wulin-wulin/OSWorld_Chart

</details>


### [192] [Structure over Pixels: Learning Variable-Length Visual Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27696)
*Piotr Wyrwiński,Kacper Dobek,Krzysztof Krawiec*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STROP是一种离散视觉分词器架构，通过四阶段课程学习（以冻结的DINOv3特征为监督）和专用长度头，在单次前向传播中自适应估计每张图像的最优程序长度，绕过了像素级重建梯度，使码本完全由高层潜在表征质量塑造，生成的程序长度随场景复杂度增长，并展现出组合结构特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应分词器要么需要事后搜索，要么在预训练的固定码率集合中选择，而非学习与模型和场景耦合的连续每图序列长度；且通常以像素重建为训练目标，强调纹理而非结构。

Method: 提出STOP架构，包含：(1) 四阶段课程学习，以冻结的DINOv3特征进行局部率-失真探测作为监督；(2) 专用长度头，在单次前向传播中估计主动前缀长度；(3) 绕过像素级重建梯度，码本完全由高层潜在表征质量驱动。

Result: 程序长度随场景复杂度增长；在下游密集预测迁移任务和码本词汇直接检查中均展现出组合结构特征。

Conclusion: STROP通过绕开像素重建、以高层特征质量驱动码本学习，实现了与场景复杂度耦合的自适应序列长度，并自然涌现出组合结构表征能力。

Abstract: Discrete visual tokenizers translate images into ordered sequences of codes, providing a natural representation for structural description of scenes. Yet existing adaptive tokenizers either require post-hoc search or select among a discrete set of pre-trained rates, rather than learning a continuous per-image sequence length coupled to the model and scene, and they typically train against pixel reconstruction, emphasizing texture rather than structure. We propose STROP, a discrete visual tokenizer architecture that forms structural scene representations and simultaneously learns how long an image's visual program should be. Using a four-phase curriculum supervised by local rate--distortion probes against frozen DINOv3 features, STROP optimizes a dedicated length head that estimates the active prefix length in a single forward pass. By bypassing pixel-level reconstruction gradients, the codebook is shaped entirely by the quality of higher-level latent representations. Program length grows with scene complexity, and signs of compositional structure emerge both in downstream dense-prediction transfer and in direct inspection of the learned code vocabulary.

</details>


### [193] [ROVER: Routing Object-Centric Visual Evidence for Grounded Multi-Image Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27959)
*Guannan Lv,Ren Nie,Hongjian Dou,Tingting Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ROVER，一种轻量级可学习插件，通过步骤特定的令牌三元组实现目标中心视觉证据的高效全局路由，在无需裁剪图像或复杂启发式方法的情况下，显著提升多图像推理任务中的答案准确率和 grounding 准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在多图像推理中存在两类局限性：(1) 基于grounding的方法聚焦RoI区域，通过裁剪图像块或RoI特征注入推理上下文，削弱了整体场景理解和物体间关系，且解码成本随RoI数量和大小增长；(2) 自适应视觉特征选择方法需要细粒度监督或复杂启发式规则。亟需一种高效、轻量的全局视觉证据路由机制。

Method: ROVER是一个轻量级可学习插件。在每个目标grounding预测时，注入步骤特定的令牌三元组，协同实现：(i) 聚合当前推理上下文，(ii) 通过目标中心差分注意力将帧内线索蒸馏到视觉工作空间，(iii) 在该空间内跨目标和图像路由并整合历史感知证据。集成到Qwen2.5-VL-7B，采用交织的SFT-to-GRPO训练流程。

Result: 在MM-GCoT上答案准确率+4.8%，grounding准确率+14.6%；在VideoEspresso上答案准确率+8.6%。VideoEspresso训练模型展现出强迁移性，在多个不同基准上平均超越基础模型+4.7%。

Conclusion: ROVER通过轻量级插件设计，在不牺牲全局场景理解的前提下实现了高效的视觉证据路由，显著提升了多图像推理性能，且具有良好的跨基准迁移能力。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have increasingly localized and interleaved visual evidence for deliberative reasoning. Grounding-based approaches typically focus on regions of interest (RoIs) by injecting cropped image patches or RoI-specific features into the reasoning context. However, such designs can weaken holistic scene understanding and inter-object relations, while incurring decoding costs that scale with the number and size of RoIs. Alternatively, adaptive visual feature selection often requires fine-grained supervision or complex heuristics. To address these limitations, we propose ROVER (Routing Object-centric Visual Evidence for grounded multi-image Reasoning), a lightweight, learnable plugin for efficient global visual evidence routing. Upon each object grounding prediction, ROVER injects a step-specific token triplet to synergistically: (i) aggregate the ongoing reasoning context, (ii) distill intra-image cues into a visual working space via object-centric differential attention, and (iii) route and integrate history-aware evidence across objects and images within this space for subsequent reasoning. We integrate ROVER into Qwen2.5-VL-7B and develop an interleaved SFT-to-GRPO training pipeline. Strictly adhering to the original datasets and evaluation protocols, our method achieves the best performance on MM-GCoT (+4.8% answer accuracy, +14.6% grounding accuracy) and VideoEspresso (+8.6% answer accuracy). The VideoEspresso-trained model demonstrates strong transferability, outperforming the base model by +4.7% on average across diverse benchmarks.

</details>


### [194] [Resolution-free neural surrogates for geometric parameterization and mapping with spatially varying fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28551)
*Yanwen Huang,Lok Ming Lui,Gary P. T. Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种分辨率无关的神经替代模型，用于解决由空间变化参数场驱动的几何映射问题。该模型通过多分辨率几何编码策略，在任意结构化或非结构化点集上预测映射位置，并利用变分能量、扩散密度均衡和拟共形理论中的几何约束进行无标签训练。在拟共形映射和密度均衡映射任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统几何映射方法（如变分模型、扩散过程、椭圆偏微分方程）在处理高分辨率系统时，当底层参数场因实例不同而变化时，重复求解计算成本极高，亟需一种高效且分辨率无关的替代方案。

Method: 提出分辨率无关的神经替代模型，采用多分辨率几何编码策略，将参数场坐标增强样本作为网络条件输入；通过变分能量、扩散密度均衡和拟共形理论等几何感知约束进行无监督训练，无需标注解数据。

Result: 在拟共形映射和密度均衡映射问题上验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提方法能够高效地替代传统几何映射求解过程，避免了网格依赖和高分辨率重复求解的计算负担，为变形场建模提供了新的分辨率无关范式。

Abstract: Many imaging problems require computing spatial transformations induced by spatially varying intensity, feature, or density fields. Canonical examples include distortion correction, deformable image registration, atlas-based segmentation, and deformation-driven image analysis. These tasks can be formulated as geometric mapping problems in which the transformation is constrained to preserve local structure, control boundary behavior, or regulate angular distortion. Such formulations typically lead to variational models, diffusion processes, or elliptic partial differential equations. However, repeatedly solving high-resolution systems becomes computationally expensive when the underlying parameter fields vary across instances. In this work, we propose a resolution-free neural surrogate for geometric parameterization and mapping problems. Given a spatially varying parameter field $p:Ω\to\mathbb{R}^m$ and query locations $\{x_i\}_{i=1}^N\subsetΩ$, the model predicts mapped locations $\{u(x_i)\}_{i=1}^N$ on arbitrary structured or unstructured point sets. To avoid dependence on a fixed grid, we use a multi-resolution geometric encoding strategy that conditions the network on coordinate-augmented samples of the parameter field. The model is trained without labeled solution data by enforcing geometry-aware constraints derived from variational energies, diffusion-based density equalization, and quasi-conformal theory. Experimental results on quasi-conformal mapping and density-equalizing mapping problems are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

</details>


<div id='cs.SI'></div>

# cs.SI [[Back]](#toc)

### [195] [Scalable AI-Driven Analytics for User Engagement and Stance Detection on Social Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29199)
*Thammitage Piyumi Wathsala Seneviratne,Muhammad Ikram,Dinusha Vatsalan,Hassan Asghar,Mohamed Ali Kaafar*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可扩展的AI驱动服务框架，用于分析社交媒体上用户对阴谋论内容的参与度和立场。该框架集成了数据摄取、过滤、主题建模、情感分析和立场检测等模块化流程，并在包含近5万个YouTube视频、超过700万条用户评论的数据集上进行了评估。研究发现阴谋论内容在发布第一周内吸引了高达70%的用户参与，且多数用户对阴谋论持支持立场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要从行为学或内容中心视角分析错误信息和阴谋论内容，缺乏可扩展的、面向服务的解决方案来实现平台规模下的持续监控和用户参与分析。

Method: 提出了一个可扩展的AI驱动服务框架，包含数据摄取、内容过滤、主题建模、情感分析和立场检测等模块化流水线，并在包含近5万个YouTube视频、超过700万条评论的数据集上进行了实现和评估。

Result: 阴谋论内容在发布第一周内吸引高达70%的用户参与，存在强烈的早期放大效应；识别出高度活跃用户子集，这些用户在多个视频和频道中呈现不成比例的高参与度；立场分析显示大多数用户对阴谋论内容持支持态度。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了部署可扩展、面向服务的分析系统用于实时监控用户参与和行为模式的可行性，强调了早期检测和基于服务的监控对缓解有害内容传播的重要性。

Abstract: Social media platforms have become a major vector for the large-scale dissemination of misinformation and conspiracy content, posing significant risks to public trust, health, and societal stability. While prior work has primarily focused on analysing such content from a behavioural or content-centric perspective, there is a lack of scalable, service-oriented solutions that enable continuous monitoring and analysis of user engagement at platform scale.
  In this paper, we present a scalable AI-driven service framework for analysing user engagement and stance on social media content. Our system integrates data ingestion, filtering, topic modelling, sentiment analysis, and stance detection into a modular pipeline that can operate on large-scale, real-world datasets. We implement and evaluate our framework on a dataset comprising over 7 million user comments collected from nearly 50,000 YouTube videos associated with conspiracy narratives.
  Our analysis reveals that conspiracy content attracts up to 70% of total user engagement within the first week of publication, indicating strong early amplification dynamics. Furthermore, we identify a subset of highly active users who exhibit disproportionately high engagement across multiple videos and channels. Stance analysis shows that a majority of users express favourable positions toward conspiracy narratives, highlighting the role of user communities in reinforcing such content.
  The proposed framework demonstrates the feasibility of deploying scalable, service-oriented analytics for real-time monitoring of user engagement and behavioural patterns. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework in capturing large-scale engagement dynamics and highlight the importance of early-stage detection and service-based monitoring for mitigating the spread of harmful content.

</details>


### [196] [Fairness-Aware Profit Maximization using Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29770)
*Poonam Sharma,Sanchit Virdi,Suman Banerjee*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习的方法来解决公平感知利润最大化问题，即在社区划分的社会网络中，在预算约束下选择种子用户集，使得初始激活产生的利润最大化，同时确保每个社区获得至少最小比例的收益。该方法在真实数据集上实现了比基线方法高达10倍的利润提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统影响力最大化问题往往忽略公平性考量，可能导致某些社区获得的影响力收益不成比例地低。本文旨在提出一个兼顾公平性与利润最大化的种子选择问题。

Method: 将问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并设计深度Q学习算法求解。网络用户具有收益值和成本两个参数，在固定预算和社区划分约束下，以最大化利润为目标，同时满足各社区的公平性比例约束。

Result: 在真实社交网络数据集上，所提方法选择的种子集初始激活产生的利润比基线方法高出10倍。

Conclusion: 深度强化学习能够有效解决带公平约束的利润最大化问题，显著优于传统方法。

Abstract: Given a social network represented as a graph where the nodes are the users and the edges represent the social relations, and a positive integer k, how to select k nodes to maximize the influence in the network remains an active area of research. In this paper, we consider a variant of the problem in which network users are associated with two parameters: a benefit value and a cost. A fixed budget is given, and the network is partitioned into communities. The task is to select a subset of users (the seed set) within the budget so that their initial activation maximizes the earned profit, while ensuring that each community realizes at least a minimum fraction of its total benefit under a maximin fairness criterion. For any seed set, the earned benefit is defined as the sum of the benefit values of the users influenced by the seed set, and the profit is defined as the difference between the earned benefit and the total cost. Formally, we call this the Fairness-Aware Profit Maximization Problem. We propose a Deep Reinforcement Learning-based approach for solving it: we first model the problem as a Markov Decision Process and subsequently propose a Deep Q-Learning Algorithm. The proposed solution has been implemented and tested on real-world social network datasets. From the reported results, we observed that the proposed approach yields a seed set whose initial activation produces up to 10 times more profit than the baseline methods. The implementation of our methodology is available at https://github.com/PoonamSharma-PY/DRL_FPM.git.

</details>


### [197] [SAHG: Sector-Anisotropic Hyperbolic Graph Model for Social Bot Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30166)
*Hanning Lu,Yingguang Yang,Jinwei Su,Yang Liu,Zhaoqian Yao,Yaoming Li,Taoran Liang,Ziyi Zhang,Ran Ran,Kefu Xu,Bin Chong*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 提出SAHG模型，通过方向依赖曲率场和各向异性双通道设计，在社交机器人检测中解决欧氏GNN对层次/无标度图的失真问题以及邻域聚合污染问题，在三个基准上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于图的社交机器人检测方法面临两个挑战：一是欧氏GNN扭曲层次化和无标度的社交图结构，固定曲率的双曲模型在不同结构方向上分配均匀的几何分辨率；二是关系证据不可靠，高级机器人会与真实用户建立异质连接，导致邻域聚合混合机器人和人类信号，稀释账户级证据。

Method: 提出SAHG（Sector-Anisotropic Hyperbolic Graph），包含两个核心设计：1）学习方向依赖的曲率场γ(u)，在不同结构方向上自适应调整几何分辨率，并通过扇区原型将角度集中度和对齐度转化为分类器可读特征；2）双通道独立编码架构，将账户级特征和图邻域表示在两个独立的SAH通道中分别编码，仅在分类器处融合，防止污染聚合淹没账户级证据。

Result: 在Fox8-23、BotSim-24和MGTAB三个基准上，SAHG在准确率和F1分数上均达到最高，优于基于特征、基于图、基于LLM和各向同性双曲基线方法。消融实验和几何分析验证了各向异性几何和双通道设计的有效性。

Conclusion: SAHG通过各向异性双曲几何和双通道独立编码，有效解决了社交机器人检测中图结构失真和邻域聚合污染的问题，在多个基准上取得了最优检测性能。

Abstract: LLM-driven social bots can generate fluent, human-like text, reducing the discriminative advantage of content-based detection alone. However, coordinated campaigns still leave relational patterns -- interactions, behavioral similarity, shared neighborhoods, community positions, and coordinated activity -- that graph-based methods can exploit. Existing graph detectors face two challenges when exploiting such evidence. First, Euclidean GNNs distort hierarchical and scale-free social graphs; while hyperbolic geometry addresses this volume-growth mismatch, fixed-curvature models still assign uniform geometric resolution to structural directions with different densities and separation needs. Second, relational evidence is not always reliable: sophisticated bots forge heterophilic connections with genuine users, causing neighborhood aggregation to mix bot and human signals and dilute account-level evidence. We propose \textsc{SAHG} (Sector-Anisotropic Hyperbolic Graph), addressing both challenges. \textsc{SAHG} learns a direction-dependent curvature field $γ(u)$ that adapts geometric resolution across structural directions, and uses sector prototypes to convert angular concentration and alignment into classifier-readable features. To prevent contaminated aggregation from overwhelming account-level evidence, \textsc{SAHG} encodes per-account features and graph-neighborhood representations in two independent SAH channels, fusing them only at the classifier. Experiments on Fox8-23, BotSim-24, and MGTAB show that \textsc{SAHG} achieves the highest accuracy and F1 on all three benchmarks, outperforming feature-based, graph-based, LLM-based, and isotropic hyperbolic baselines. Ablation and geometric analyses confirm the effectiveness of the anisotropic geometry and dual-channel design.

</details>


### [198] [Enhancing structural resilience in healthcare through patient flow network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06031)
*Lu Zhong,Lior Rennert,Sen Pei,Jianxi Gao*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本研究通过分析数十亿电子病历记录，构建了美国跨区域患者流动网络。发现在COVID-19疫情期间，跨区域患者流动比例从疫情前的2.08%上升至2.81%，这种流动吸收了PCPs上平均58%的超额压力，相比疫情前15%的基线提升了43个百分点。强化跨区域患者流动可帮助医疗系统吸收更多压力，减少对初级保健医生的需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模灾害（如疫情和气候事件）导致医疗需求激增，给医疗系统带来巨大压力。尽管已有大量关于医疗韧性的研究，但很少关注医生层面以及患者流动模式如何帮助重新分配需求、减轻超负荷医疗提供者的压力。

Method: 分析了数十亿记录患者就诊初级保健医生（PCPs）的电子病历，构建了美国跨区域患者流动网络，对比COVID-19疫情前后跨区域流动比例的变化，并量化了这种流动对PCPs压力吸收的影响。

Result: 疫情期间跨区域患者流动比例从2.08%升至2.81%；这种流动吸收了PCPs上平均58%的超额压力（较疫情前15%的基线提升了43个百分点）；进一步加强跨区域患者流动可帮助医疗系统吸收更多压力并减少对PCPs的需求。

Conclusion: 跨区域患者流动是医疗系统缓解危机时期需求激增压力的重要机制，为增强医疗系统的疫情准备和灾害响应能力提供了结构性洞见，有助于改善危机时期的患者护理。

Abstract: Large-scale disasters, such as pandemics and climate-related events, place extraordinary pressure on healthcare providers due to extreme demand surges. Managing these surges is essential to sustaining healthcare resilience. Although numerous studies on healthcare resilience, far less attention has been given to physicians and to how patterns of patient movement can help redistribute demand and alleviate stress on overburdened providers. In this study, we analyzed billions of electronic medical records documenting patient visits to primary care physicians (PCPs) to construct inter-regional patient flow networks across the U.S. During the COVID-19 pandemic, we observed that cross-regional flow rose to 2.81%, compared to the pre-pandemic level of 2.08%. This redistribution absorbed, on average, 58% of the excess stress on PCPs, meaning more than half of the surging demand was handled by patients' moves to less burdened regions, an absolute 43 percentage point improvement from the pre-pandemic baseline of 15%. Further analysis suggests that strengthening cross-regional patient flow could allow the healthcare system to absorb even more stress and reduce the demand for PCPs. These findings provide structural insights for the healthcare system to enhance its pandemic preparedness and disaster responses, and to improve patient care during crises.

</details>

### [199] [Subcortical Shape Variations and Their Associations with Cognition Across the 8th Decade of Life. A Study in the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29703)
*Maria del C. Valdes-Hernandez,Wonjung Park,Joanna Moodie,Susana Muñoz Maniega,Janie Corley,Fraser N. Sneden,Mark E. Bastin,Joanna M. Wardlaw,Simon R. Cox,Jinah Park*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究利用Lothian Birth Cohort 1936纵向数据，分析了社区老年人在80多岁期间皮层下脑结构的形态变化及其与认知老化的关联，发现海马、腹侧DC等结构存在不对称性形态变形，而丘脑、苍白球呈现更均匀的体积收缩，一般认知能力变化主要与顶点位移相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管粗脑体积测量在认知老化研究中广泛应用，但未能充分捕捉功能相关的脑老化特征。皮层下结构在认知中起重要作用，但其形态轨迹与认知变化的关联尚未被系统记录。

Method: 基于Lothian Birth Cohort 1936纵向研究的神经影像、人口学和认知数据，采用ANCOVA和混合线性模型，探索社区老年人在80多岁期间皮层下脑结构的形状变化及其与认知老化的关联。

Result: 皮层下结构形状变化呈现异质性：海马和腹侧DC表现出左右半球不对称的形态变形，而丘脑和苍白球则呈现近乎对称的均匀体积收缩。一般认知能力变化主要与不同时间点之间的向内和向外顶点位移相关。

Conclusion: 皮层下脑结构的形态变化模式各异，且这些变化与认知老化存在关联，揭示了超越粗体积测量的功能相关脑老化特征。

Abstract: The study of brain morphology changes in normal individuals may capture aspects of functionally-relevant brain aging not fully indicated by gross volumetry. Despite the important role of subcortical brain structures in cognition, the associations between their morphological trajectories and cognitive changes in aging have not been documented. We use neuroimaging, demographic, and cognitive data from a large longitudinal study of cognitive aging, the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936, to explore shape changes in subcortical brain structures of community-dwelling individuals across their 8th decade of life. We investigate the association of these changes with cognitive aging using ANCOVA and mixed linear model analyses. Subcortical shape changes were heterogeneous, with varied atrophy patterns across whole period. The hippocampus and the ventral DC experienced varied morphological deformations (from its baseline point) different in left and right hemispheres, while the thalami and globus pallidi shapes, for example, experienced a more uniform volume contraction, nearly symmetrical throughout different timelines. Changes in general cognition were mainly associated with inwards and outwards vertex displacements between the time-points.

</details>


### [200] [Inward rectifier potassium channels interact with calcium channels to promote robust and physiological bistability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.14107)
*Anaëlle De Worm,Guillaume Drion,Pierre Sacré*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文通过最小 conductance-based 模型和两室模型，发现背角投射神经元中 L型钙通道与内向整流钾通道（Kir）组合能产生稳健的生理双稳态，而L型钙通道与M型钾通道组合则效果较弱。CaL+Kir组合因Kir稳态电流具有负微分电导区，能扩大双稳态窗口，更抗噪声和变异，并被识别为中枢敏化的潜在内在机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阐明在背角投射神经元中枢敏化过程中，如何产生稳健且生理性的双稳态（plateau potentials和持续后放电），因为仅靠L型钙通道无法达到生理静息态，而大多数电压门控钾通道又会缩小双稳态窗口，这一机制此前尚不清楚。

Method: 采用最小 conductance-based 模型分析CaL通道与Kir或KM通道组合的动力学特性，并通过两室模型（包含真实离子通道组成）进行验证。使用分岔分析和稳态电流形状特征分析来比较双稳态窗口大小和鲁棒性。

Result: CaL+Kir组合产生更大的双稳态窗口，且对噪声和内在变异性更鲁棒；该窗口扩大效应源于Kir稳态电流在尖峰阈值附近具有负微分电导区（与CaL电流类似），而KM及其他多数电压门控钾电流缺乏此特征；CaL+Kir产生plateau-generating双稳态，而CaL+KM产生resonator-like动力学。

Conclusion: CaL+Kir组合被确定为中枢敏化的候选内在机制，为理解病理性疼痛中投射神经元兴奋性转换提供了离子通道层面的分子机制。

Abstract: Projection neurons in the dorsal horn relay nociceptive input to supraspinal centers. During central sensitization, a subset of them switches from tonic firing to plateau potentials with sustained afterdischarges, a change that requires intrinsic bistability between a resting and a spiking state. Voltage-gated L-type calcium (CaL) channels can produce bistability, but reach physiological resting states only when paired with voltage-gated potassium channels, most of which simultaneously shrink the bistability window. How robust, physiological bistability arises has therefore remained unclear. Using a minimal conductance-based model, we show that inward rectifier potassium (Kir) channels enlarge the bistability window when combined with CaL channels, while M-type potassium (KM) channels slightly reduce it. Within the parameter region where bistability is both robust and physiological, both channel types can sustain bistability, but the CaL+Kir combination produces a substantially larger window and is more robust to noise and intrinsic variability. This window-enlarging effect traces to a shape feature of the outward Kir steady-state current: like the CaL current, it has a region of negative differential conductance around the spike threshold, a feature absent from KM and from most other voltage-gated potassium currents. Bifurcation analysis further shows that the two pairs support qualitatively distinct excitability: plateau-generating bistability for CaL+Kir and resonator-like dynamics for CaL+KM. These conclusions hold in a two-compartment model of deep projection neurons with realistic ion channel complements, and identify the CaL+Kir pair as a candidate intrinsic mechanism for central sensitization.

</details>


### [201] [A Deep Learning Model of Mental Rotation Informed by Interactive VR Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.13517)
*Raymond Khazoum,Daniela Fernandes,Aleksandr Krylov,Qin Li,Stephane Deny*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个由等变神经编码器、神经符号对象编码器和神经决策代理组成的三组件机械模型，用于模拟人类心理旋转能力，并通过VR实验验证了模型在性能、响应时间和行为上与人类参与者高度一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理旋转是人类心理模拟和空间世界模型的基本能力，但现有缺乏对其计算机制的 mechanistic 建模。作者希望利用深度、等变和神经符号学习的进展，构建一个可解释的、与人类实验数据相符的心理旋转计算模型。

Method: 模型包含三个堆叠组件：(1)等变神经编码器——从图像生成3D空间表示；(2)神经符号对象编码器——从空间表示推导符号化对象描述；(3)神经决策代理——通过循环路径在3D潜空间中比较符号描述并执行旋转模拟。结合VR实验数据进行验证，并通过消融研究检验各组件的必要性。

Result: 模型在性能、响应时间和行为上与人类参与者在作者自有的VR实验及其他人的实验中表现一致；消融研究证明各组件均不可或缺。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了深度、等变和符号表示相结合在模拟人类心智方面的潜力，为近期深度神经网络模型在人类空间推理领域的研究增添了新的成果。

Abstract: Mental rotation -- the ability to compare objects seen from different viewpoints -- is a fundamental example of mental simulation and spatial world modeling in humans. Here we propose a mechanistic model of human mental rotation, leveraging recent advances in deep, equivariant, and neuro-symbolic learning. Our model consists of three stacked components: (1) an equivariant neural encoder, producing 3D spatial representations of objects from images, (2) a neuro-symbolic object encoder, deriving symbolic objects descriptions from these spatial representations, and (3) a neural decision agent, comparing these symbolic descriptions to prescribe rotation simulations in 3D latent space via a recurrent pathway. Our model design is guided by the existing experimental literature on mental rotation, which we complemented with experiments in VR where participants could at times manipulate the objects to compare. Our model captures well the performance, response times and behavior of participants in our and others' experiments, and through ablation studies we demonstrate the necessity of each component. Our work adds to a recent collection of deep neural models of human spatial reasoning, further demonstrating the potency of integrating deep, equivariant, and symbolic representations to model the human mind.

</details>


### [202] [Graph Neural Network Reveals the Cortical Morphology of Local Brain Aging in Normal Cognition and Alzheimer's Disease](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.10912)
*Samuel D. Anderson,Jordan Jomsky,Nikhil N. Chaudhari,Nahian F. Chowdhury,Xiaoyu,Zheng,Andrei Irimia,Alzheimers Disease Neuroimaging Initiative*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的局部脑龄（LBA）估计方法，利用皮层形态学特征（厚度、面积、曲率、灰白质强度比、沟深）在高空间分辨率下估计皮层各区域的脑龄。模型在14,423名认知正常成年人的T1-MRI数据上训练，在ADNI数据集上展现了优于现有方法的性能，并识别出与阿尔茨海默病（AD）临床认知障碍相关的生物学可解释的皮层老化模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全局脑龄（GBA）方法仅能概括整体大脑健康状态，缺乏在个体层面估计局部皮层特异性老化模式的计算框架。虽然已有研究探讨了解剖学因素对GBA的贡献，但尚无利用皮层形态学估计局部脑龄（LBA）的方法。

Method: 提出一种图神经网络（GNN），以皮层表面网格为输入，使用五种形态计量学特征（皮层厚度、表面积、曲率、灰白质强度比GWR、沟深）作为节点特征，在高空间分辨率（平均顶点间距1.37 mm）下逐顶点估计局部脑龄。模型在N=14,423名认知正常成年人的T1-MRI数据上训练。

Result: 1) 模型MAE低于现有最优方法；2) 在ADNI数据集中识别出比先前工作更具生物学合理性的老化模式：认知正常者联合皮层为主要老化位点，轻度认知障碍者海马旁回老化显著，AD患者全皮层广泛老化尤其内侧颞叶及相关网络；3) 特征消融实验显示曲率和GWR对AD病理更敏感；4) 区域LBA缺口与AD相关的神经心理学认知测量显著关联。

Conclusion: 基于GNN的皮层形态计量学建模能够实现生物可解释的局部脑老化映射，比先前工作具有更强的可解释性，并将皮层老化模式与临床认知结局联系起来。

Abstract: Estimating brain age (BA) from T1-weighted magnetic resonance images (MRIs) provides a powerful framework for quantifying anatomical brain aging. Whereas global BA (GBA) summarizes overall brain health, local BA (LBA) provides cortically specific patterns of aging at the subject level. Although previous studies have examined anatomical contributors to GBA, to our knowledge, no framework has been established to estimate LBA using cortical morphology. To address this gap, we introduce a graph neural network (GNN) that uses morphometric features$\unicode{x2013}$cortical thickness, surface area, curvature, gray/white matter intensity ratio (GWR), sulcal depth$\unicode{x2013}$to estimate LBA across the cortical surface at high spatial resolution (mean inter-vertex distance = 1.37 mm). Trained on cortical surface meshes extracted from the MRIs of cognitively normal (CN) adults (N = 14,423), our model achieves lower mean absolute error (MAE) than the existing state-of-the-art while identifying more biologically plausible patterns of aging in Alzheimer's disease (AD) on the ADNI dataset. Association cortices emerge as primary sites of morphometric aging in CNs, whereas mild cognitive impairment is characterized by widespread aging that is pronounced in the parahippocampal gyrus. AD subjects demonstrate significant aging across the entire cortex, particularly within medial temporal regions and associated cortical networks. Feature ablation highlights curvature and GWR as preferentially sensitive to AD pathology. Regional LBA gaps are significantly associated with neuropsychological measures of AD-related cognitive impairment, linking cortical aging patterns to clinical outcomes. These results demonstrate that GNN-based modeling of cortical morphometry enables biologically interpretable mapping of local brain aging with greater interpretability than prior work.

</details>

### [203] [Neural-Behavioral Representation of Natural Whole-body Movement in Monkeys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29355)
*Jieshi He,Puzhe Li,Yanan Sui,Mu-ming Poo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合大规模硬膜外皮层信号和多视角运动捕捉的框架，在自由运动的猕猴中实现了全身运动解码，使用自回归编码器-解码器模型在无明确物理约束条件下生成了准确且逼真的全身运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究受限于任务约束和有限肢体运动，无法在自然全身行为条件下实现灵长类动物的运动解码，主要挑战在于运动多样性及大规模神经表征的不可及性。

Method: 搭建定制数据采集平台，同步记录自由运动猕猴的分布式感觉运动区硬膜外皮层信号与多视角运动捕捉数据；使用自回归编码器-解码器模型学习紧凑的行为先验，并以神经信号为条件进行全身运动解码。

Result: 模型能够在无明确物理约束的条件下，解码出准确且逼真的全身运动，证明了利用大规模颅内神经活动解码灵长类自然全身运动的可行性。

Conclusion: 本研究为基于大规模颅内神经活动解码灵长类自然全身运动提供了概念验证性方法，拓展了运动解码的应用范围。

Abstract: Understanding how cortical activity represents natural whole-body behaviors in primates remains challenging. Limited by the diversity of movements and inaccessibility of large-scale neural representation of whole-body kinematics, previous motor decoding studies focused on constrained tasks and limited limb movements. Here, we present a neural-behavioral recording and modeling framework for freely moving monkeys, combining large-scale epidural cortical signals from distributed sensory- and motor-related areas with synchronized multi-view motion capture through a custom-made data collection platform. We reconstructed whole-body monkey kinematics and learned a compact behavior prior using an autoregressive encoder-decoder model. Conditioned on neural signals, the model decoded accurate and realistic whole-body movement without explicit physical constraints. Our results provide a novel proof-of-concept approach for decoding natural whole-body movements in primates using large-scale intracranial neural activity.

</details>


### [204] [One Mask to Rule Them All: On Hidden Facts after Editing and How to Find Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28839)
*Ali Holmov,Paul Youssef,Nandi Schoots,Christin Seifert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现ROME和MEMIT知识编辑方法虽修改不同事实，但都作用于相同的权重子集，该子集通过抑制后层过度注意力来实现编辑。编辑本质是压制而非覆盖知识，这解释了为何编辑无法传播到相关事实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识编辑方法（如ROME、MEMIT）主要通过修改MLP权重来更新事实关联，但其内部工作机制尚不清晰。研究者希望探究不同事实编辑是否共享相同的底层机制，以及编辑的本质是什么。

Method: 训练一个紧凑的二元掩码来覆盖编辑后的权重，通过该掩码能否逆转编辑来验证编辑是否集中在相同的权重子集上。在编辑过程中注入掩码以验证该机制的必要性。分析掩码对注意力分布的影响。

Result: 二元掩码可在训练集逆转80%的编辑，测试集超过70%，确认不同编辑共享共同功能结构。掩码通过消除后层过度注意力逆转编辑。注入掩码使编辑成功率从98%降至38%。

Conclusion: 编辑的本质是抑制而非覆盖已有知识，这解释了ROME和MEMIT无法将编辑传播到相关事实的原因。识别出的共同功能子空间可服务于检测和防御不当编辑。

Abstract: Knowledge editing methods such as ROME and MEMIT update factual associations in transformer models by modifying MLP weights. While evaluated mainly by output behavior, their internal mechanism remains underexplored. We investigate whether edits rely on a common mechanism, regardless of which fact is modified. Despite fact-specific weight changes, we argue that ROME and MEMIT target the same subset of weights critical for maintaining edits. To isolate this subset, we train a compact binary mask over the edited weights. The mask reverses 80% of edits on the training set and over 70% on the test set, confirming that diverse edits share a common functional structure. Our analysis reveals that the mask reverses edits by eliminating overattention in later layers. Additionally, we show that injecting the mask during editing drops editing success from 98% to 38%, demonstrating that this mechanism is necessary for edits to succeed. Our finding that edits suppress rather than overwrite knowledge explains why ROME and MEMIT fail to propagate changes to related facts. The identified common functional subspace informs detection and defense against unwanted edits.

</details>


### [205] [Representation Signatures and Risk-Feedback Alignment in LLM Trading Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28850)
*Weicheng Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过TradeArena测试平台研究LLM智能体在金融决策中的行为对齐与表征动态，发现规划嵌入漂移、有效秩收缩等预失败信号，并验证了风险反馈作为外部对齐信号的作用，同时揭示LLM在相关性盲点上的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大语言模型智能体在金融交易环境中行为对齐与表征动态的演化规律，特别是在市场压力下的失败前可检测信号，以及风险反馈机制能否作为无需微调的外部对齐信号。

Method: 构建TradeArena可审计交易测试平台，包含风险报告、执行模拟、记忆和可重放轨迹。通过80个滚动失败锚点跨越8条LLM轨迹，使用哈希、LSA、Transformer和白盒隐藏状态探针进行嵌入分析；进行无思维链目标权重、词汇控制、OHLCV噪声和虚假审计报告的压力测试；以及在51只股票上进行日内实验验证相关性盲点。

Result: 发现规划嵌入偏离正常状态中心、融合计划-风险表征区分正常与预回撤状态、有效秩收缩等预失败信号。收缩现象在多种嵌入方法中持续存在。理性级收缩在无思维链时消失，而意图空间收缩可能保留。结构化风险反馈可作为外部对齐信号，但非通用性能增强器。51只股票实验揭示LLM理性常合理化集中暴露于耦合资产，风险层反复剪切。

Conclusion: 可审计风险反馈和表征轨迹能够揭示LLM金融推理何时在对齐、漂移或失败，支持研究性主张而非盈利性主张。

Abstract: We study behavioral alignment and representation dynamics of large language model (LLM) agents in financial decision environments. Using TradeArena, an auditable trading-agent testbed with risk reports, execution simulation, memory, and replayable trajectories, we analyze how rationales, positions, and interventions evolve under market stress. We find measurable pre-failure signatures: planning embeddings drift from normal-state centroids, fused plan-risk representations separate normal from pre-drawdown states, and manifold diagnostics show effective-rank contraction before failures. To address small-sample and embedding-choice concerns, we use 80 rolling failure anchors across eight LLM trajectories and show that contraction persists across hash, LSA, Transformer, and white-box hidden-state probes. Stress tests with CoT-free target weights, lexical controls, OHLCV noise, and false-audit reports indicate that rationale-level contraction can vanish without rationales, while intent-space contraction may remain; lexical diversity does not collapse; and fused signatures remain informative under noise. We also find that structured risk feedback can act as an external alignment signal without fine-tuning, but not as a universal performance enhancer: true audit feedback improves calibration for some models, return and drawdown for others, and reveals cases where hidden or placebo feedback has higher short-horizon return but weaker alignment diagnostics. Finally, a 51-stock intraday experiment reveals a correlation blind spot: LLM rationales often justify concentrated exposure to coupled assets that the risk layer repeatedly clips, with a rolling Markowitz baseline as a covariance reference. These results support a research claim rather than a profitability claim: auditable risk feedback and representation trajectories reveal when LLM financial reasoning is aligning, drifting, or failing.

</details>


### [206] [Mechanistic origins of catastrophic forgetting: why RL preserves circuits better than SFT?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28860)
*Jeanmely Rojas Nunez,Viraj Sawant,Nathan Allen,Nomgondalai Amgalanbaatar,Yannis Zongo,Vasu Sharma,Maheep Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出差异电路脆弱性（differential circuit vulnerability）指标，从机制层面比较RL和SFT微调LLM时对内部计算电路的破坏程度。发现SFT虽能更快适应目标任务，但导致更严重的电路破坏和灾难性遗忘；RL则更好地保留基础电路，但任务适应较慢。电路保留程度可能是RL抗遗忘能力更强的原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作从行为层面发现RL比SFT更能保留先验能力，但机制层面的解释尚不明确。本文旨在从内部计算电路（mechanistic level）探究RL抗灾难性遗忘优势的根源。

Method: 提出差异电路脆弱性（differential circuit vulnerability）指标，在head级别度量微调过程中电路的退化程度。以Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct为基座模型，在科学问答任务上分别用RL和SFT进行微调，比较两种方法对内部计算电路的保留差异。

Result: SFT适应目标任务更快，但导致更大的电路破坏和先验能力遗忘；RL保留更大比例的基础电路，但任务适应速度较慢。两者在电路保留与任务适应之间存在明确的机制性权衡。

Conclusion: 电路保留程度可能解释了RL比SFT更能抵抗灾难性遗忘的原因，为理解不同微调方法的机制差异提供了新视角。

Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) frequently induces catastrophic forgetting of prior capabilities. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning (RL) retains prior capabilities more effectively than supervised fine-tuning (SFT), attributing this to policy-gradient updates remaining closer to the base policy \cite{shenfeld2025rl}. We extend this behavioral account to the mechanistic level and ask whether RL's advantage is mirrored by stronger preservation of internal computational circuits. We introduce differential circuit vulnerability, a head-level measure of how much a circuit degrades under fine-tuning, and use it to compare RL and SFT on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct adapted to scientific question-answering. We find a clear mechanistic trade-off: SFT adapts more rapidly to the target task but produces substantially greater circuit disruption and forgetting of prior capabilities, whereas RL preserves a larger fraction of the base circuit at the cost of slower task adaptation. These findings suggest that circuit preservation may help explain why RL is more robust to catastrophic forgetting. We released our code here: https://github.com/rl-sft-circuit-research/differential-circuit-vulnerability.

</details>


### [207] [Molecular Lead Optimization via Agentic Tool Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28862)
*Lingxiao Li,Haobo Zhang,Ruohao Fan,Bin Chen,Jiayu Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TRACE——一种轨迹感知的大语言模型推理智能体，将分子先导优化中的工具选择建模为序列决策问题，通过前瞻性规划实现满足结构约束的ADMET性质优化，在多个任务上优于传统单步优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有先导优化方法多为单步分子优化，无法考虑序列设计决策的长期后果，导致优化效果受限。

Method: 提出TRACE，一种轨迹感知的LLM推理智能体，将分子优化工具选择建模为关于行动轨迹的序列决策问题，在结构约束下进行前瞻性优化。

Result: 在多个ADMET优化任务上，TRACE在优化成功率、性质改善幅度和有效性方面均优于基线模型，同时保持了分子相似性。

Conclusion: 轨迹感知的序列决策方法能更有效地解决先导优化问题，LLM推理智能体在分子优化中具有显著优势。

Abstract: Drug discovery is a lengthy and resource-intensive process composed of multiple stages. Among these stages, lead optimization plays a critical role in transforming early hit compounds into viable drug candidates. This stage requires improving ADMET-related properties through subtle structural refinement while preserving key molecular substructures responsible for binding affinity to disease targets. Recent advances in artificial intelligence have shown promise in accelerating various aspects of drug discovery; however, most existing approaches to lead optimization rely on one-step molecular optimization, which fail to account for the long-term consequences of sequential design decisions. To address this limitation, we propose TRACE, a trajectory-aware, LLM-reasoning agent for molecular lead optimization that formulates tool selection as a sequential decision-making problem over action trajectories. Given a lead molecule and an optimization objective, TRACE makes trajectory-aware decisions over molecular optimization tools, enabling forward-looking refinement under structural constraints. Experiments on multiple ADMET optimization tasks show that our agent achieves higher optimization success, larger property improvements, and higher validity, while preserving molecular similarity compared to baseline models.

</details>


### [208] [Self-Play Reinforcement Learning under Imperfect Information in Big 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28863)
*Aalok Patwa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在四人非完美信息纸牌游戏Big 2中，通过自监督强化学习框架系统比较了多种算法，发现PPO在随机、贪心和启发式对手下优于MC Q近似、SARSA和Q-learning，且适度熵正则化和当前策略自对弈能显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究非完美信息多人博弈中智能体在隐藏信息、稀疏奖励和非平稳对手环境下的表现，Big 2作为测试平台提供了受控的实验条件。

Method: 构建自监督RL框架，在统一环境、输入表示、训练预算和评估协议下，比较PPO、MC Q近似、SARSA和Q-learning；并研究熵正则化和不同自对弈策略（当前策略自对弈、检查点自对弈、固定对手训练）的影响。

Result: PPO在所有对手类型下均优于其他算法；适度熵正则化防止策略过分确定从而提升性能；当前策略自对弈在有限预算下提供比检查点自对弈或固定对手训练更强的课程学习效果。

Conclusion: Big 2可作为研究非完美信息、多人交互、延迟奖励和可变动作集下深度强化学习的有效受控环境。
