Result: 在TabArena基准上，前向传播显著优于所有其他模型（包括调参和集成基线），帕累托支配速度/性能前沿。TabPFN-3-Plus (Thinking) 在TabArena上击败所有非TabPFN模型超过200 Elo，在最大数据子集上达420 Elo，比AutoGluon 1.5 extreme快10倍。在RelBenchV1上达到新SOTA，TabSTAR上SOTA，fev-bench上排名第2。SHAP值计算快120倍，整体比TabPFN-2.5快20倍。

Conclusion: TabPFN-3通过合成数据预训练和测试时计算缩放，大幅推进了表格预测的前沿，同时在速度、规模和跨模态泛化能力上取得显著突破，为表格基础模型建立了新标准。

Abstract: Tabular data underpins most high-value prediction problems in science and industry, and TabPFN has driven the foundation model revolution for this modality. Designed with feedback from our users, TabPFN-3 builds on this foundation to scale state-of-the-art performance to datasets with 1M training rows and substantially reduce training and inference time. Pretrained exclusively on synthetic data from our prior, TabPFN-3 dramatically pushes the frontier of tabular prediction and brings substantial gains on time series, relational, and tabular-text data. On the standard tabular benchmark TabArena, a forward pass of TabPFN-3 outperforms all other models, including tuned and ensembled baselines, by a significant margin, and pareto-dominates the speed/performance frontier. On more diverse datasets, TabPFN-3 ranks first on datasets with many classes, and beats 8-hour-tuned gradient-boosted-tree baselines on datasets up to 1M training rows and 200 features. TabPFN-3 introduces test-time compute scaling to tabular foundation models. Our API offering TabPFN-3-Plus (Thinking) exploits this to beat all non-TabPFN models by over 200 Elo on TabArena, rising to 420 Elo on the largest data subset, and outperforms AutoGluon 1.5 extreme while being 10x faster, without using LLMs, real data, internet search or any other model besides TabPFN. TabPFN-3 extends the capabilities of our models, enabling SOTA prediction on relational data (new SOTA foundation model on RelBenchV1) and tabular-text data (SOTA on TabSTAR via TabPFN-3-Plus); and improves existing integrations: a specialized checkpoint, TabPFN-TS-3, ranks 2nd on the time-series benchmark fev-bench, and SHAP-value computation is up to 120x faster. TabPFN-3 achieves this performance while being up to 20x faster than TabPFN-2.5. In addition, a reduced KV cache and row-chunking scale to 1M rows on one H100 with fast inference speed.

</details>


### [473] [Latency-Quality Routing for Functionally Equivalent Tools in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14241)
*Kexin Chu,Dawei Xiang,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LQM-ContextRoute，一种用于同功能工具提供商的上下文bandit路由方法。核心设计是延迟-质量匹配（Latency-Quality Matching），将延迟视为服务容量而非奖励补偿项，结合查询特定质量估计和LLM-as-judge反馈实现在线自适应。在多个基准测试上，该方法在F1、准确率和NDCG指标上显著优于SW-UCB，尤其在高异构性和运行时压力共存场景下表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具增强型LLM代理常通过多个功能等价但延迟、可靠性和回答质量各异的提供商访问同一工具类型（如网页搜索API、检索器、LLM后端），运行时负载下需要在无金标签的情况下进行提供商路由选择，现有方法未能很好处理延迟与质量的权衡。

Method: 提出LQM-ContextRoute上下文bandit路由方法，核心创新为延迟-质量匹配（Latency-Quality Matching）：将提供商按每服务周期的期望答案质量排序，而非让低延迟在加性奖励中抵消低质量；结合容量感知评分、查询特定质量估计和LLM-as-judge反馈，实现在线自适应负载变化和提供商质量差异。

Result: 在网页搜索负载基准上F1提升+2.18pp；在异构StrategyQA场景下准确率提升最高+18pp；在异构检索器池上NDCG提升+2.91~+3.22pp，且均保持在延迟-质量前沿。

Conclusion: 同功能工具路由应将延迟视为服务容量而非奖励中的补偿项，尤其在运行时压力与提供商质量异构性共存时，延迟-质量匹配设计能有效避免加性奖励崩溃，提升路由性能。

Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents increasingly access the same tool type through multiple functionally equivalent providers, such as web-search APIs, retrievers, or LLM backends exposed behind a shared interface. This creates a provider-routing problem under runtime load: the router must choose among providers that differ in latency, reliability, and answer quality, often without gold labels at deployment time. We introduce LQM-ContextRoute, a contextual bandit router for same-function tool providers. Its key design is latency-quality matching: instead of letting low latency offset poor answers in an additive reward, the router ranks providers by expected answer quality per service cycle. It combines this capacity-aware score with query-specific quality estimation and LLM-as-judge feedback, allowing it to adapt online to both load changes and provider-quality differences. On the main web-search load benchmark, LQM-ContextRoute improves F1 by +2.18 pp over SW-UCB while staying on the latency-quality frontier. In a high-heterogeneity StrategyQA setting, LQM-ContextRoute avoids additive-reward collapse and improves accuracy by up to +18 pp over SW-UCB; on heterogeneous retriever pools, it improves NDCG by +2.91--+3.22 pp over SW-UCB. These results show that same-function tool routing benefits from treating latency as service capacity, especially when runtime pressure and provider-quality heterogeneity coexist.

</details>


### [474] [Turning Stale Gradients into Stable Gradients: Coherent Coordinate Descent with Implicit Landscape Smoothing for Lightweight Zeroth-Order Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14373)
*Chen Liang,Xiatao Sun,Qian Wang,Daniel Rakita*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD)，一种确定性、样本高效且预算感知的零阶优化器。通过利用梯度相干性将历史梯度从负担转化为计算资产，实现每步O(1)查询复杂度，并在MLP/CNN/ResNet上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零阶优化方法面临样本效率低（如标准有限差分）或高方差（如随机子空间方法）的困境，亟需一种既样本高效又低方差的确定性优化方法。

Method: 提出CoCD算法，形式化定义梯度相干性，证明其等价于带有"热启动"的块循环坐标下降（BCCD），利用历史梯度的相干性实现每步O(1)查询复杂度；同时发现大步长有限差分具有隐式平滑效应。

Result: 在MLP、CNN和ResNet（最多27万参数）上，CoCD在样本效率和收敛损失/准确率上显著优于BCCD，且比随机化ZO方法具有更好的稳定性。

Conclusion: 确定性的、结构感知的更新策略在轻量级零阶优化中优于随机化方法，是更优的替代方案。

Abstract: Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimization is pivotal for scenarios where backpropagation is unavailable, such as memory-constrained on-device learning and black-box optimization. However, existing methods face a stark trade-off: they are either sample-inefficient (e.g., standard finite differences) or suffer from high variance due to randomized estimation (e.g., random subspace methods). In this work, we propose Coherent Coordinate Descent (CoCD), a deterministic, sample-efficient, and budget-aware ZO optimizer. Theoretically, we formalize the notion of gradient coherence and demonstrate that CoCD is equivalent to Block Cyclic Coordinate Descent (BCCD) with ``warm starts,'' effectively converting historical (stale) gradients from a liability into a computational asset. This mechanism enables $O(1)$ query complexity per step while maintaining global descent directions. Furthermore, we derive error bounds revealing a counter-intuitive insight: larger finite-difference step sizes can induce an implicit smoothing effect on the optimization landscape by reducing the effective smoothness constant, thereby improving convergence stability. Experiments on MLP, CNN, and ResNet architectures (up to 270k parameters) demonstrate that CoCD significantly outperforms BCCD in terms of sample efficiency and convergence loss/accuracy, and exhibits superior stability over randomized ZO methods. Our results suggest that deterministic, structure-aware updates offer a superior alternative to randomization for lightweight ZO optimization.

</details>


### [475] [DualKV: Shared-Prompt Flash Attention for Efficient RL Training with Large Rollouts and Long Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15422)
*Jiading Gai,Shuai Zhang,Xiang Song,Bernie Wang,George Karypis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DualKV，一种消除RL训练中共享提示词复制的FlashAttention内核变体，通过融合CUDA内核和重新设计数据流水线，在GRPO/DAPO训练中实现1.63-3.82倍策略更新加速，MFU从36%提升至76%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准FlashAttention在大规模RL后训练（如GRPO/DAPO）中，将共享的P个提示词token在N个响应序列间复制N次，导致前向和反向传播中大量计算和内存冗余。随着rollout数量N≥16且上下文长度P≥8K，这种冗余主导了策略更新成本。

Method: (1) 设计融合CUDA前向和反向内核，在单次内核启动中迭代两个不相交的KV区域——共享上下文和每个序列的响应；(2) 在veRL中重新设计数据流水线，将N(P+R)个token重新打包为P+NR个token每微批次，将token减少从注意力扩展到整个模型，压缩因子ρ=N(P+R)/(P+NR)。

Result: Qwen3-8B GRPO训练（8×H100，N=32，8K上下文）：1.63-2.09倍策略更新加速，2倍更大微批次，MFU从36%提升至76%。DAPO：2.47倍加速，77% MFU。30B MoE规模（16×H100）：3.82倍策略更新加速，3.38倍端到端步骤加速。

Conclusion: DualKV在数学上等价于标准注意力且无近似，有效消除了RL训练中共享提示词的计算和内存冗余，显著提升训练效率。

Abstract: Modern RL post-training methods such as GRPO and DAPO train on $N$ response sequences of $R$ tokens sampled from a shared prompt of $P$ tokens, but standard FlashAttention replicates all $P$ prompt tokens $N$ times across both forward and backward passes -- duplicating compute and memory on identical hidden states. In large-rollout, long-context RL training ($N{\geq}16$, $P{\geq}8\text{K}$), this redundancy dominates the policy update cost. We observe that in decoder-only models, causal masking makes prompt representations invariant across sequences at every layer, so all per-token operations (norms, projections, MLP) and attention can process the prompt once -- a property not yet exploited at the kernel level for training. We propose \textbf{DualKV}, the first FlashAttention kernel variant that eliminates shared-prompt replication during RL training, via (1)~fused CUDA forward and backward kernels that iterate over two disjoint KV regions -- shared context and per-sequence response -- in a single kernel launch, and (2)~a data-pipeline redesign in veRL that repacks $N(P{+}R)$ tokens into $P{+}NR$ tokens per micro-batch, extending the token reduction from attention to the entire model by a factor $ρ= N(P{+}R)/(P{+}NR)$. DualKV is mathematically equivalent to standard attention and introduces no approximation. On Qwen3-8B GRPO training with 8$\times$H100 GPUs ($N{=}32$, 8K-context), DualKV achieves $1.63$--$2.09\times$ policy-update speedup, enables $2\times$ larger micro-batches, and raises MFU from $36\%$ to $76\%$. Similar gains hold for DAPO ($2.47\times$ speedup, $77\%$ MFU). At 30B MoE scale on 16$\times$H100, DualKV achieves $3.82\times$ policy-update and $3.38\times$ end-to-end step speedup over FlashAttention (which requires 4-way Ulysses sequence parallelism to avoid OOM).

</details>


### [476] [To MRL or not to MRL: Text Embeddings are Robust to Truncation Without Matryoshka Learning, Except In Heavy Truncation Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16608)
*Sotaro Takeshita,Yurina Takeshita,Simone Paolo Ponzetto,Daniel Ruffinelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过对比实验发现，不使用MRL训练的模型在嵌入截断后（除非截断超过80%）性能与使用MRL的模型相当甚至更优，表明截断鲁棒性可能并非来自MRL，是否采用MRL取决于是否需要重度截断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明随机截断文本嵌入对下游性能影响很小，但没有工作直接比较随机截断与MRL的效果，因此本文旨在系统比较两种嵌入缩减方法的有效性。

Method: 对使用MRL和未使用MRL训练的模型应用相同方式的截断，在多个模型和下游任务上进行对比实验。

Result: 除非嵌入尺寸减少至少80%，非MRL模型的截断嵌入与MRL模型的结果相当甚至更优。

Conclusion: 截断鲁棒性可能并非来自MRL训练，是否选择MRL取决于是否需要重度截断（≥80%）。

Abstract: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is a widely adopted approach for training text encoders so they provide useful text representations at various sizes, available by simply truncating the resulting vectors at sizes pre-determined at training time. Recent works have shown that randomly truncating text embeddings has minimal impact in downstream performance unless vectors are reduced in size by at least 70%, suggesting that embeddings are already robust to truncation without the use of MRL. However, no prior work has compared random truncation to MRL, so it is unclear how the two methods compare as effective embedding reduction methods. In this paper, we study this by applying the same truncation used by MRL to models trained with and without MRL. Our results across several models and downstream tasks show that, unless heavily truncating embeddings (i.e. reducing their size by at least 80%), truncated embeddings of non-MRL models are competitive with, and often outperform models trained with MRL. This suggests that truncation robustness may not necessarily come from MRL, and that the choice of spending the additional training cost of MRL depends on whether heavy truncation is desired. We make our code available for reproduction.

</details>


### [477] [Matryoshka Concept Bottleneck Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20612)
*Ziye Chen,Hongbin Lin,Jie Li,Lijie Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Matryoshka Concept Bottleneck Model (MCBM)，通过嵌套层次化概念组织，在单一模型内实现自适应概念粒度推理，将测试时干预成本从线性降至对数级别O(log K)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）在实际部署中面临测试时干预成本高昂的问题：要么采用单一静态概念集导致专家需要穷举标注所有概念，要么训练多个不同概念预算的模型带来巨大的计算和维护开销。

Method: 受Matryoshka表示学习启发，MCBM将概念基于最大相关性和最小冗余度组织成嵌套层次结构，支持在无需重训练的情况下进行多粒度推理。理论上证明了预期干预成本从线性降至O(log K)，并保证单调性能提升。

Result: 实验表明MCBM在匹配独立训练模型性能的同时，实现了动态且高效的专家交互，验证了理论上的成本降低和性能保证。

Conclusion: MCBM通过单一统一架构解决了CBM中概念粒度与干预成本的权衡问题，为可解释深度学习的实际部署提供了一种高效、自适应的解决方案。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) have emerged as a prominent paradigm for interpretable deep learning, learning by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, their practical deployment is hindered by the high cost of test-time intervention, as correcting model errors typically requires human experts to manually inspect and verify a large set of predicted concepts. Existing approaches suffer from a fundamental structural limitation: they either adopt a single static concept set, forcing experts to exhaustively annotate concepts and incurring prohibitive intervention costs, or train multiple models tailored to different concept budgets, resulting in substantial computational and maintenance overhead. To address this challenge, we propose the Matryoshka Concept Bottleneck Model (MCBM), a unified architecture that enables adaptive concept utilization within a single model. Inspired by Matryoshka Representation Learning, MCBM organizes concepts into a nested hierarchy based on maximum relevance and minimum redundancy, allowing inference at multiple levels of conceptual granularity without retraining. Theoretically, we show that MCBM reduces the expected intervention costs from linear to logarithmic order, $O(\log K)$, while guaranteeing monotonic performance improvement. Empirically, extensive experiments demonstrate that MCBM matches the performance of independently trained models while enabling dynamic and efficient expert interaction.

</details>


### [478] [A Tutorial on Diffusion Theory: From Differential Equations to Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22586)
*Jiayi Fu,Yuxia Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提供了一个统一且自包含的教程，从微分方程视角系统阐述了扩散模型的理论基础，包括扩散概率模型、基于分数的建模、随机微分方程和数值采样方法，并展示了DDPM、DDIM、流匹配和基于分数的SDE如何纳入统一框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型的数学基础（扩散概率模型、基于分数的建模、SDE、数值采样）往往被分开阐述，缺乏统一的视角。本文旨在通过微分方程视角，提供一个自洽且统一的理论教程。

Method: 从条件高斯加噪过程出发，推导ODE和SDE表示，建立正向边际动力学，进而得到反向时间SDE和概率流ODE；论证反向采样中的核心未知量是边际分数，证明在噪声预测参数化下分数匹配等价于标准去噪目标；将DDPM、DDIM、流匹配和基于分数的SDE纳入统一框架。

Result: 建立了从微分方程视角统一理解扩散模型的理论框架，涵盖了正向/反向SDE、概率流ODE、分数匹配目标函数、反向时间采样与引导等核心内容，并将主流扩散模型方法统一在同一框架下。

Conclusion: 该教程在扩散过程的分析基础与现代生成算法之间搭建了桥梁，并延伸讨论了连续嵌入空间中的扩散语言模型和离散掩码令牌扩散。

Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as a dominant framework for generative modeling, but their mathematical foundations are often presented separately through diffusion probabilistic models, score-based modeling, stochastic differential equations, and numerical sampling methods. We write this tutorial to provide a unified and self-contained account of these viewpoints from the perspective of differential equations. Starting from a conditional Gaussian noising process, we derive ordinary differential equation (ODE) and stochastic differential equation (SDE) representations, pass to the corresponding marginal forward dynamics, and then obtain the reverse-time SDE and probability-flow ODE that make generation possible. We show that the central unknown quantity in reverse sampling is the marginal score, explain how score matching becomes the standard denoising objective under a noise-prediction parameterization, and discuss practical reverse-time sampling and guidance. We further place DDPM, DDIM, flow matching, and score-based SDEs in a common framework, and conclude with diffusion language models in continuous embedding space together with a brief discussion of discrete masked-token diffusion. The tutorial is intended as a bridge between the analytical foundations of diffusion processes and the modern generative algorithms built upon them.

</details>


### [479] [The Distillation Game: Adaptive Attacks & Efficient Defenses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22737)
*Youssef Allouah,Mahdi Haghifam,Sanmi Koyejo,Reza Shokri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过极小极大博弈框架研究模型蒸馏攻击中的效用-安全权衡，提出自适应评估方法（学生端重加权高价值样本）和产品-of-专家（PoE）防御策略（教师与代理学生联合生成）。实验表明，自适应评估下现有防御的鲁棒性显著降低，且PoE在成本远低于昂贵防御的同时保持了相近的鲁棒性和更优的推理质量，最终结论是强蒸馏难以完全阻止，抗蒸馏进展应以自适应学生而非被动学生为评估基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型提供者面临两难困境：模型的有用输出同时也会使其更容易被蒸馏攻击模仿。现有防御评估多采用被动学生（passive student）假设，未能反映真实攻击场景中自适应学生（adaptive student）的威胁，导致对防御效果的高估。

Method: 1. 建立效用约束教师与自适应学生之间的极小极大博弈框架；2. 推导单侧响应规则：学生端自适应评估（重加权高价值样本）和教师端防御模板（抑制对蒸馏最有用的输出）；3. 基于样本价值的廉价代理，提出Product-of-Experts（PoE）防御——在生成时将教师与代理学生联合（仅需前向传播）。

Result: 1. 自适应评估揭示被动-自适应差距：在GSM8K和MATH上，自适应学生从现有防御中恢复的能力显著高于被动评估结果；2. 在自适应评估下，昂贵防御与PoE之间的鲁棒性差距大幅缩小；3. PoE成本显著更低且能保留更高质量的推理轨迹。

Conclusion: 强蒸馏攻击仍然难以有效阻止；未来抗蒸馏研究的进展应以自适应学生（而非被动学生）作为评估基准。

Abstract: Distillation attacks create a deployment trade-off for model providers: the same outputs that make a model more useful can also make it easier to imitate. We study this trade-off through a minimax game between a utility-constrained teacher and an adaptive student. Our framework yields tractable one-sided response rules: an adaptive evaluation rule in which the student reweights high-value examples, and a teacher-side defense template that suppresses outputs most useful for distillation. From a cheap proxy for example value, we derive Product-of-Experts (PoE), a simple forward-pass-only defense that combines the teacher with a proxy student during generation. Empirically, adaptive evaluation reveals a large passive--adaptive gap: on state-of-the-art defenses, adaptive students recover substantially more capability than passive evaluation suggests on GSM8K and MATH. Under this stronger evaluation, the apparent robustness gap between expensive defenses and PoE narrows considerably, while PoE remains substantially cheaper and preserves higher-quality reasoning traces. Overall, our results suggest that strong distillation remains difficult to stop, and that progress on antidistillation should be judged against adaptive students rather than passive ones. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ysfalh/distillation-game.

</details>


### [480] [Building a privacy-preserving Federated Recommender system for mobile devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22924)
*Aasheesh Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种两阶段联邦推荐系统流水线，通过将非敏感偏好数据与敏感移动上下文数据分离，实现了在移动设备上的个性化内容推荐，而无需将敏感数据上传到云端。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统移动设备个性化内容推荐需要将用户敏感数据集中到服务器，这与现代隐私期望和地区法规相冲突，因此需要一种保护隐私的推荐方案。

Method: 采用两阶段流水线：第一阶段在云端使用协同过滤模型处理非敏感应用上下文数据，生成相关项目短列表；第二阶段在设备端利用敏感移动信号对候选列表进行重排序，仅模型更新/梯度离开设备。

Result: 在MovieLens、UCI人类活动识别和专有试点数据集上验证了方法有效性，并提供了基于Kotlin Multiplatform的生产级实现，可部署于Android和iOS。

Conclusion: 该方法在保护隐私的同时实现了移动设备上的个性化推荐，且具有跨平台的生产级可用性。

Abstract: Serving personalized content on mobile devices has traditionally required pooling sensitive user data on centralized servers, a practice increasingly at odds with modern privacy expectations and geographical regulations. We present a two-stage federated recommendation system pipeline for mobile devices, built around a principled separation between non-sensitive user preference data and sensitive mobile context data that never leaves the device. The first stage runs a collaborative filtering model on non-sensitive app-context data in the cloud to generate a shortlist of relevant items. The second stage re-ranks these candidates on-device using sensitive mobile signals, with only model updates/gradients ever leaving the device. We validate the approach on MovieLens, UCI Human Activity Recognition, and a proprietary pilot dataset, and deliver a production-ready implementation as a Kotlin Multiplatform library deployable on Android and iOS.

</details>


### [481] [Self-supervised Adversarial Purification for Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23239)
*Woohyun Lee,Hogun Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于自监督图自编码器（GPR-GAE）的对抗净化框架，通过将鲁棒性与分类器分离，利用多重广义PageRank滤波器进行图结构净化，在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著提升GNN的对抗鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统对抗训练等方法将准确性与鲁棒性这两个冲突目标绑定在同一个分类器中，难以平衡；需要一种将鲁棒性从分类器中解耦的方法。

Method: 提出GPR-GAE作为专用净化器：采用自监督训练策略，利用多重广义PageRank（GPR）滤波器捕获多样化结构表示，通过多步净化过程实现精确的图恢复。

Result: 在多种数据集和攻击场景下，GPR-GAE达到了最先进的鲁棒性，可作为独立即插即用的净化器用于GNN分类器。

Conclusion: 将鲁棒性与分类器解耦的自监督图净化框架有效解决了准确率与鲁棒性的权衡问题，GPR-GAE作为一种通用的图结构净化器具有良好的适应性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Defending Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) against adversarial attacks requires balancing accuracy and robustness, a trade-off often mishandled by traditional methods like adversarial training that intertwine these conflicting objectives within a single classifier. To overcome this limitation, we propose a self-supervised adversarial purification framework. We separate robustness from the classifier by introducing a dedicated purifier, which cleanses the input data before classification. In contrast to prior adversarial purification methods, we propose GPR-GAE, a novel graph auto-encoder (GAE), as a specialized purifier trained with a self-supervised strategy, adapting to diverse graph structures in a data-driven manner. Utilizing multiple Generalized PageRank (GPR) filters, GPR-GAE captures diverse structural representations for robust and effective purification. Our multi-step purification process further facilitates GPR-GAE to achieve precise graph recovery and robust defense against structural perturbations. Experiments across diverse datasets and attack scenarios demonstrate the state-of-the-art robustness of GPR-GAE, showcasing it as an independent plug-and-play purifier for GNN classifiers.

</details>


### [482] [Tiny Brains, Giant Impact: Uncovering the Keystone Neurons of LLM with Just a Few Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24846)
*Xiangtian Ji,Yuxin Chen,Zhengzhou Cai,Xiang Wang,An Zhang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现大语言模型中存在一组在跨任务推理时持续高度激活的"基石神经元"（keystone neurons），移除它们会导致模型能力崩溃。这些神经元在预训练阶段建立，参数校准精确。基于此，提出仅更新基石神经元的微调方法，在修改极少参数的情况下达到甚至超越全参数微调的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型表现出强大的综合能力，但其内部工作机制尚未被充分理解。作者希望揭示支撑模型行为的核心神经机制。

Method: 1) 分析多种开源Transformer模型在跨任务推理时的神经元激活模式，发现持续高激活的神经元子集；2) 通过探测跨任务激活强度，隔离出极稀疏的基石神经元子集；3) 验证移除这些神经元会导致模型能力崩溃；4) 分析这些神经元的稳定性和内在性及其在预训练中建立的过程；5) 提出仅更新基石神经元的监督微调方法。

Result: 基石神经元是模型稳定且内在的神经元子集，主要在预训练期间建立；相关参数在训练过程中被精确校准；仅更新基石神经元的微调方法在修改极少参数的情况下，能达到甚至超越全参数微调的任务增益，同时更好地保持其他能力维度的性能。

Conclusion: 大语言模型中存在一组关键的基石神经元，它们对模型能力至关重要。利用这一发现，可以通过仅微调少量关键神经元实现高效且保能力的模型优化。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) display strong comprehensive abilities, yet the internal mechanisms that support these behaviors remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we show that across a wide range of open-weight Transformers, a subset of neurons remains consistently highly activated during inference across tasks of multiple capability dimensions. By probing along the cross-task activation strength, an extremely sparse subset is isolated, whose removal causes a collapse in model behavior, which we term keystone neurons. Our analysis reveals that keystone neurons are a stable and intrinsic neuron subset of the model that is largely established during pretraining. The parameters associated with these neurons are tightly calibrated during the training process, and their precise values are critical for the capabilities of the model. Building on these insights, we propose a supervised fine-tuning approach that updates only keystone neurons, achieving task gains comparable to or even better than full-parameter fine-tuning while better preserving performance in other capability dimensions, despite modifying a much smaller number of parameters.

</details>


### [483] [Theoretical Analysis of Sparse Optimization with Reparameterization, Weight Decay, and Adaptive Learning Rate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25134)
*Huangyu Xu,Jingqin Yang,Qianqian Xu,Jiaye Teng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReWA方法，通过重参数化、权重衰减和自适应学习率解决ℓ_p正则化(0<p<1)中梯度无界导致的优化不稳定问题，在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上实现了优于ℓ_1正则化的稀疏性提升同时保持测试准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ℓ_p正则化(0<p<1)虽能诱导稀疏性，但其梯度无界导致优化不稳定，亟需一种既能保持稀疏性又能解决优化稳定性问题的方法。

Method: 提出ReWA方法，核心包含三个组件：重参数化(Reparameterization)、权重衰减(Weight decay)和自适应学习率(Adaptive learning rate)，三者协同构建与ℓ_p正则化相关但优化景观更稳定的新目标。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上使用ResNet，ReWA相比ℓ_1正则化方法显著提升了模型稀疏性，同时测试准确率得以保持。

Conclusion: ReWA通过重塑优化景观有效缓解了ℓ_p正则化的不稳定问题，是一种兼具稀疏性与测试性能的可行替代方案。

Abstract: Sparse optimization is a fundamental challenge in various practical applications. A popular approach to sparse optimization is $\ell_p$ regularization. However, it may encounter optimization instability due to the unbounded gradients when $0<p<1$. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to sparse optimization termed ReWA, based on Reparameterization, Weight decay, and Adaptive learning rate. ReWA is closely connected to $\ell_p$-regularization, yet it unveils a distinct optimization landscape that helps mitigate instability issues. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet with ResNets demonstrate that ReWA leads to significant sparsity improvements over the $\ell_1$-regularization approach while preserving test accuracy.

</details>


### [484] [Autoregression-Free Neural Operators for Time-Dependent PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25413)
*Jiaquan Zhang,Caiyan Qin,Haoyu Bian,Libin Cai,Yi Lu,Chaoning Zhang,Wei Dong,Yuanfang Guo,Yang Yang,Hen Tao Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无自回归神经算子(AFNO)，通过将PDE时间演化映射到潜空间并用流匹配学习连续时间向量场，避免自回归 rollout，实现长时程稳定预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于神经算子的方法在求解时间相关PDE时，依赖自回归 rollout 直接在物理场空间递推预测，导致误差随 rollout 步长累积；且缺乏连续时间建模能力，长时程预测不稳定。

Method: 将PDE的时间演化映射到潜空间，在潜空间中用流匹配(flow matching)学习连续时间向量场，通过显式物理参数条件化捕捉不同参数配置下的动力学，避免自回归 rollout。

Result: 在六个PDE基准上的实验表明，AFNO在长时程预测稳定性上优于基线方法，且一致减少了 rollout 误差。

Conclusion: AFNO通过潜空间连续时间建模和流匹配，有效解决了自回归 rollout 的误差累积问题，为长时程PDE求解提供了一种更稳定的范式。

Abstract: Neural operators learn mappings from function-dependent inputs to solutions, providing an effective framework for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). For time-dependent PDEs, existing methods typically perform long-horizon prediction through autoregressive rollout directly in high-dimensional physical field spaces, where each predicted state is recursively fed back as the input for the next step. Although effective for short-term prediction, this autoregressive rollout and the lack of continuous-time modeling lead to progressive error accumulation over long-horizon rollouts. In this work, we propose Autoregression-Free Neural Operators (AFNO), which map the time evolution of PDEs into a latent space and model continuous-time vector fields within it. AFNO uses flow matching to learn the latent vector field, thereby enabling continuous evolution over extended horizons, avoiding autoregressive rollout and capturing dynamics under varying parameter configurations through explicit conditioning on physical parameters. Theoretical analysis and extensive experiments on six PDEs demonstrate that AFNO improves long-horizon prediction stability and consistently reduces rollout errors compared with the baselines.

</details>


### [485] [GoQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26092)
*Maoyang Xiang,Bo Wang,Tao Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GoQuant是一种算法-硬件协同设计框架，通过几何正交残差投影量化将乘法累加操作替换为移位加操作，在超低比特（sub-4-bit）下解决对数幂次量化的低角分辨率问题，在LLaMA-2-7B 3-bit量化下达到6.10困惑度，并将28nm工艺下关键路径延迟降至0.35ns。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型和视觉Transformer在边缘设备部署受限于内存和密集MAC阵列的时序瓶颈。超低比特下对数幂次量化虽可用移位操作替代MAC，但其非均匀指数格点存在固有的低角分辨率问题，在sub-4-bit阈值下高维特征流形显著退化。

Method: 将量化问题形式化为对偶基几何投影，自适应地使用仅移位加操作合成高分辨率残差格点；提供解析求解器替代计算密集的梯度优化，将LLaMA-2-7B全模型校准时间压缩至约15分钟。

Result: 3-bit (W3/A16)约束下LLaMA-2-7B困惑度达6.10，优于传统MAC密集型基线（如AWQ）；4-bit场景保持竞争性精度。28nm工艺下标准单元RTL综合显示，并行移位加数据路径将关键路径延迟降至0.35ns，有效缓解密集乘法器树的时序瓶颈。

Conclusion: GoQuant通过算法-硬件协同设计有效解决了超低比特量化中低角分辨率的结构缺陷，在跨模态部署中展示了硬件效率，为边缘设备上的大模型推理提供了可行的低延迟方案。

Abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices is significantly constrained by memory limitations and the critical timing bottlenecks introduced by dense Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) arrays. In the ultra-low bit regime, logarithmic Power-of-Two (PoT) quantization provides a hardware-efficient alternative by replacing MAC operations with bit-shifts. However, the non-uniform exponential lattice is inherently limited by a \textbf{Low Angular Resolution Regime}, a structural flaw that becomes particularly pronounced at sub-4-bit thresholds, leading to a notable degradation of high-dimensional feature manifolds. To address this geometric limitation, we propose Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection Quantization (GoQuant), an algorithm-hardware co-design framework. By formulating quantization as a dual-basis geometric projection, GoQuant adaptively synthesizes a higher-resolution residual lattice using strictly shift-and-add operations. Furthermore, its analytical solver offers a practical alternative to computationally intensive gradient-based optimization, reducing the full-model calibration time for LLaMA-2-7B to approximately 15 minutes. Extensive evaluations demonstrate GoQuant's applicability across modalities and its hardware efficiency. Under the 3-bit (W3/A16) constraint, it achieves a perplexity of 6.10 on LLaMA-2-7B, comparing favorably to conventional MAC-intensive baselines like AWQ without relying on asymmetric scaling, while maintaining competitive accuracy in 4-bit scenarios. At the silicon level, standard-cell RTL synthesis at a 28nm node indicates that GoQuant effectively mitigates the timing bottlenecks associated with dense multiplier trees. By flattening the combinational logic depth, our parallel shift-and-add datapath reduces the critical path delay to 0.35 ns.

</details>


### [486] [Bridging Classification and Reconstruction: Cooperative Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26193)
*Qideng Tang,Dai Chaofan,Wubin Ma,Yahui Wu,Haohao Zhou,Tao Zhang,Huan Li,Dalin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoAD框架，通过将分类范式（Outlier Exposure）与重建范式（Masked Autoencoder）协同统一，利用分类模块生成概率驱动的软掩码指导重建模块，同时重建模块缓解分类模块的泛化问题，从而有效检测微妙和复杂的时序异常。实验表明CoAD在多个基准数据集上显著优于现有方法，且轻量高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度时间序列异常检测方法难以检测微妙和长期异常；Outlier Exposure（分类范式）泛化能力差，Masked Autoencoder（重建范式）存在掩码对齐问题。两类方法各自存在局限性，亟需一种融合两者优势的框架。

Method: 提出CoAD框架，统一分类与重建两种范式：（1）分类模块设计概率驱动的软掩码，解决分类粒度不当和频率信息忽略问题；（2）软掩码引导重建模块聚焦异常区域；（3）重建模块的反馈缓解分类模块的泛化问题，形成协同设计。

Result: 在高质量基准数据集上，CoAD在严格评估协议下显著优于现有SOTA深度学习和传统数据挖掘方法；同时模型轻量，速度远超现有方法，适用于大规模实时应用。

Conclusion: 协同统一分类与重建范式是解决时间序列异常检测中微妙和复杂异常检测问题的高效路径，CoAD证明了深度学习在该领域的潜力与实用性。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) has long been a hot research topic in data mining due to its various applications. Recent studies challenge the effectiveness of popular deep learning methods for TSAD, suggesting their failure in detecting subtle and prolonged anomalies. Outlier Exposure (OE) and Masked Autoencoder (MAE) emerge as two promising paradigms (classification and reconstruction) for solving the above problems. However, OE-based methods are constrained by poor generalization, while MAE-based methods are limited by masking misalignment issues. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel framework, CoAD, which unifies the two paradigms to leverage their complementary strengths while mitigating their respective weaknesses. In this framework, the classification module generates probability-informed soft masks for the reconstruction module, which in turn alleviates the generalization problem of the classification module. This cooperative design enables CoAD to effectively detect subtle and complex anomalies that are often overlooked by existing methods. Additionally, the classification module is carefully designed to resolve issues related to improper classification granularity and the neglect of frequency information. Extensive experiments on high-quality benchmark datasets, conducted under rigorous evaluation protocols, demonstrate that CoAD significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art deep learning and traditional data mining methods, highlighting the potential of deep learning in TSAD. Moreover, CoAD is lightweight and substantially faster than existing SOTA methods, demonstrating its practical value for large-scale, real-time applications.

</details>


### [487] [On the Role of Inductive Bias in Time-Series Pretraining: A Case Study in Learning Generalizable Representations for Clinical Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26194)
*Sharmita Dey,Diego Paez-Granados*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PathoFM 是一个面向脊髓损伤步态分析的编码器中心 Transformer，通过局部补全、时间连续性和无监督上下文动态三种互补目标进行预训练，发现动态导向的目标混合能在分类和回归任务间实现最佳迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床时间序列学习受限于小规模异质队列和协议漂移，而下游任务涵盖分类（病理诊断）和回归（时序预测），需要研究何种预训练归纳偏置能使表征跨任务类型和跨主体迁移。

Method: 提出 PathoFM 编码器中心 Transformer，在多元步态窗口上使用三种互补预训练目标：局部补全（重建连续掩码跨度以强化局部结构）、时间连续性（从观测前缀预测掩码中段以增强平滑性和因果一致性）、无监督上下文动态（通过注意力机制基于主体示例窗口进行支持-查询重建）。

Result: 动态导向的目标混合产生最均衡的迁移性能：分组目标有利于判别边界但会降低连续目标所需的幅度保真度，重建目标保留波形结构但分类性能可能下降。结合局部重建与时间连续性，并在可获取示例时加入上下文条件化，可得到鲁棒的跨主体泛化表征。

Conclusion: 对于临床时间序列的预训练，动态导向的目标混合（局部重建+时间连续性+上下文条件化）是实现跨任务类型和跨主体迁移的有效策略。

Abstract: Clinical time-series learning is routinely constrained by small, heterogeneous cohorts and protocol drift, while its downstream use spans both classification (e.g., pathology diagnosis) and regression (e.g., temporal forecasting). These constraints make foundation-model pretraining appealing, but raises an important question of which inductive biases should the pretraining objective impose so that representations transfer across task types and subjects. We study this question in pathological gait analysis for spinal cord injury (SCI) via PathoFM, an encoder-centric transformer pretrained on multivariate gait windows with three complementary objectives: Local Completion (reconstruct contiguous masked spans to enforce local structure), Temporal Continuity (predict a masked mid-horizon continuation from an observed prefix to enforce smoothness and causal consistency), and Unsupervised In-Context Dynamics (support-query reconstruction conditioned on subject exemplar windows via attention). Empirically comparing objective families (grouping/contrastive, dynamics-based, and generative reconstruction), we find that dynamics-centric mixtures produce the most balanced transfer: grouping objectives favor discriminative margins but can degrade magnitude fidelity needed for continuous targets, whereas reconstruction-only objectives preserve waveform structure but may underperform on classification. Overall, combining local reconstruction with temporal continuity, and adding in-context conditioning when exemplar access is realistic, yields robust subject-generalizing representations.

</details>


### [488] [Function-Valued Causal Influence in Nonlinear Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26408)
*Valentina V. Kuskova,Dmitry Zaytsev,Michael Coppedge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文批判了时间序列因果发现中普遍使用标量边分数总结非线性模型因果关系的方法，指出这种做法忽略了非线性自回归模型学习到的状态依赖函数效应；作者形式化了函数值因果影响的概念，并提出基于个体条件期望（ICE）的框架直接从训练模型中估计因果响应函数；合成实验和民主发展案例研究表明，标量分数无法区分的边可能呈现出单调、阈值、饱和和符号变化等不同功能行为，而函数值分析能揭示标量方法遗漏的特定制度和不对称因果结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列因果发现方法在使用非线性机器学习模型后，几乎总是用标量边分数来总结因果关系，但这种做法扭曲了非线性自回归模型实际学习到的状态依赖函数，导致不同状态间的变化与残差噪声相混淆，因此需要提出更准确的函数值因果影响表征方法。

Method: 首先形式化了可加性贡献分解架构下的函数值因果影响概念；然后以神经加法向量自回归（NAVAR）为代表架构，提出基于个体条件期望（ICE）的框架从训练模型中直接估计因果响应函数；最后通过合成实验和民主发展案例研究验证方法有效性。

Result: 合成实验表明标量分数无法区分的边实际上可以表现出单调、阈值、饱和和符号变化等截然不同的功能行为；民主发展案例研究显示函数值分析能够揭示标量中心方法系统性地遗漏的特定制度和不对称因果结构。

Conclusion: 标量边分数是非线性时间序列因果发现中的严重信息瓶颈，函数值因果影响分析能够提供更丰富的因果结构洞察，应当作为现有标量方法的补充或替代。

Abstract: Causal discovery in time series is increasingly performed using nonlinear machine-learning models, yet the resulting causal relationships are almost always summarized by scalar edge scores. We argue that this practice obscures the true object learned by nonlinear autoregressive models: a state-dependent function whose effect varies across regimes, magnitudes, and contexts. We formalize function-valued causal influence for additive, contribution-decomposable architectures and show that scalar causal scores constitute a severe information bottleneck, conflating between-state variation with within-state residual noise. Using Neural Additive Vector Autoregression as a representative architecture, we introduce a practical framework based on Individual Conditional Expectation for estimating causal response functions directly from trained models. Through controlled synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that edges with indistinguishable scalar scores can exhibit qualitatively different functional behaviors, including monotonic, thresholded, saturating, and sign-changing effects. An applied case study on democratic development further shows that function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structure systematically missed by score-centric approaches.

</details>


### [489] [Localizing Memorized Regions in Diffusion Models via Coordinate-Wise Curvature Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26756)
*Gwangho Kim,Sungyoon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于曲率差异的方法，通过坐标方差坍缩的几何特征来定位扩散模型生成图像中的局部记忆化区域，并利用分数差异代理区分过拟合驱动的记忆化与数据内在约束，在Stable Diffusion上的实验优于先前的注意力定位方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆化检测方法多依赖全局或模型级信号，难以定位生成图像中记忆化出现的具体位置，且无法区分过拟合驱动的记忆化与数据固有约束导致的相似现象。

Method: 1) 将局部记忆化几何表征为坐标方差坍缩；2) 提出曲率差异方法，通过减去欠拟合基线（无条件模型或弱训练版本）的曲率来隔离过拟合驱动的记忆化；3) 推导分数差异代理，为广泛使用的基于分数差异的检测指标提供几何解释。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion上的实验表明，所提方法在利用真实记忆化掩码评估时，定位性能优于先前的基于注意力的方法。

Conclusion: 曲率差异方法能有效定位扩散模型中的局部记忆化，分数差异代理为现有检测指标提供了理论支撑，有助于隐私保护和版权合规。

Abstract: Diffusion models can unintentionally memorize training samples, raising concerns about privacy and copyright. While recent methods can detect memorization, they often rely on global or model-specific signals and provide limited insight into where memorization appears within a generated image. We provide a geometric characterization of local memorization as a coordinate-wise variance collapse. However, such collapse can also arise from intrinsic data constraints rather than overfitting. To isolate overfitting-driven memorization, we propose curvature-difference methods that subtract the curvature of an underfitted baseline, either the unconditional model or a less-trained version of itself. We further derive a score-difference proxy that provides a geometric explanation for the widely used score-difference-based detection metric. Experiments on Stable Diffusion, evaluated against ground-truth memorization masks, show that our method outperforms the prior attention-based localization method. Code is available at https://github.com/Gwangho99/mem-curv-diff.

</details>


### [490] [Two Speeds of Learning: A Representation-Readout Decomposition of Grokking and Double Descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27078)
*Chi-Ning Chou,Oscar Uzdelewicz,Neng-Chun Chiu,Yao-Yuan Yang,SueYeon Chung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出表示-读出分解框架，通过分析编码器表示学习与最终分类器读出校准两种竞争过程的相对速度波动，统一解释深度学习训练中出现的grokking和epoch-wise double descent等看似异常的学习动态现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对grokking和双下降等现象的解释往往局限于特定任务，缺乏跨任务和跨架构的任务无关分析框架，难以统一诊断和解释这些看似矛盾的学习动态。

Method: 利用表示几何、神经正切核和线性探测等工具，将学习动态分解为编码器的表示学习过程和分类器的读出校准过程，分析两者相对速度的波动如何导致异常泛化行为。

Result: 发现grokking前读出偏向训练集，表示学习是渐进的而非缺失，推翻了lazy-to-rich假说；框架还能区分虚假泛化与真正泛化，揭示非标准训练导致表示退化与读出失调是异常泛化的根源。

Conclusion: 表示-读出分解为理解学习动态和揭示底层算法提供了自上而下的统一分析框架，有助于可解释性研究。

Abstract: Training loss and accuracy are the standard signals used to monitor generalization during deep neural network training. Two well-documented phenomena complicate this picture: in grokking, train loss falls rapidly while test performance improves abruptly only after a long delay; in epoch-wise double descent, train loss decreases monotonically while test loss or error rises and falls. Existing accounts are often task-specific, and a task-agnostic analysis framework for diagnosing and explaining these phenomena across realistic tasks and architectures is missing. We address this challenge by analyzing two competing processes that underlie learning dynamics: representation learning in the encoder and readout calibration in the final classifier. Using tools from representational geometry, neural tangent kernels, and linear probing, we show that both processes are active throughout training, with the fluctuations of their relative speed giving rise to seemingly anomalous generalization dynamics. Applying the representation-readout decomposition to grokking across a wide range of tasks and architectures, we find that the readout is train-biased before grokking onset, and representation learning is gradual but not absent, contrary to the lazy-to-rich account. The framework further provides diagnostic signatures distinguishing spurious from genuine generalization: in a previously reported MNIST grokking example and an epoch-wise double descent example, apparent delayed or non-monotone generalization is shown to arise from representation degradation and readout misalignment induced by non-standard training recipes. Together, these results establish the representation-readout decomposition as a top-down framework for understanding learning dynamics and revealing underlying algorithms for interpretability research.

</details>


### [491] [Density-aware Sample-specific Attack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27809)
*Qiyuan Wang,Yao Li,Raymond K. W. Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于密度比率估计的双层优化后门攻击框架，通过将触发样本引导至干净数据分布的低密度区域，实现对微调和剪枝防御的免疫，在多个数据集上达到99%以上的攻击成功率，且后防御ASR比最强基线高50-85个百分点，对神经元剪枝防御完全免疫。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后门攻击方法在面临微调或剪枝等训练后防御时容易失效，亟需一种能够抵御这些防御的鲁棒后门攻击方法。

Method: 通过贝叶斯最优受害者训练模型推导出最佳样本特定触发构建的准则，提出双层优化框架：利用条件时间分数匹配估计密度比，优化混合模型目标函数将触发样本置于干净数据分布的低密度区域。

Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10、GTSRB和TinyImageNet上，攻击前ASR超过99%；微调防御下后防御ASR比最强基线高50-85个百分点；神经元剪枝防御下完全免疫（零神经元被移除）。

Conclusion: 当前防御范式存在根本性缺陷，需要开发在干净分布支持域之外运作的防御机制。

Abstract: Despite recent progress in backdoor attacks, existing methods remain susceptible to post-training defenses that erase the backdoor through fine-tuning or pruning. We revisit the core objectives of backdoor attacks and derive principled criteria characterizing optimal sample-specific trigger construction under a Bayes-optimal model of the victim's training. Our analysis reveals that both attack success and clean-accuracy preservation are simultaneously optimized when triggered samples are steered into low-density regions of the clean data distribution, a distributional condition that controls all moments of the poisoned distribution at once rather than a handful of input-space summary statistics. We introduce a bilevel optimization framework that estimates density ratios via conditional time-score matching and optimizes a mixture-model objective to place triggered samples in these sparse regions. Extensive evaluations on MNIST, CIFAR-10, GTSRB, and TinyImageNet demonstrate that our method achieves above 99\% attack success rate before defense and retains 50--85 percentage points higher post-defense ASR than the strongest baselines under fine-tuning defenses. Against neuron-pruning defenses, the method exhibits complete immunity, with zero neurons identified for removal across all pruning thresholds. These results expose a fundamental gap in current defense paradigms and underscore the need for defenses that operate beyond the support of the clean distribution.

</details>


### [492] [Continual Learning in Modern Hopfield Networks with an Application to Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27975)
*Ken Takeda,Masafumi Oizumi,Ryo Karakida*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用现代Hopfield能量来分析扩散模型在持续学习中的遗忘机制，证明了高能量、孤立样本更容易被遗忘，并提出了基于能量的回放样本选择策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型（包括扩散模型）越来越多地被用作基础模型并通过顺序微调进行适配，使得持续学习成为一个重要问题。然而，生成模型中的持续学习仍未被充分理解：任务切换后，学习分布的哪些方面最容易被遗忘，以及应该优先回放哪些样本？

Method: 通过现代Hopfield网络（MHN）与扩散模型之间的联系，将MHN中的分析迁移到扩散模型。引入内在遗忘（intrinsic forgetting）作为任务切换后Hopfield能量的增加。在MHN的可处理设置中，理论证明高能量、异常值样本比聚类样本经历更大的能量增加。进一步分析记忆回放，证明回放对高能量样本特别有效，从而提出基于能量的回放样本选择。

Result: 在MHN和两种扩散模型（Stable Diffusion和像素空间DDPM）的持续学习实验中验证了预测：Hopfield能量能够追踪基于重建的遗忘，回放实验显示出与MHN分析一致的能量依赖的遗忘缓解效果。

Conclusion: 高能量、孤立样本在持续学习中更容易被遗忘，基于能量的回放选择策略可以有效缓解遗忘，该结论在扩散模型中同样成立。

Abstract: Generative models, including diffusion models, are increasingly used as foundation models and adapted through sequential fine-tuning, making continual learning an essential problem setting. However, continual learning in such generative models remains poorly understood: after a task change, what aspects of the learned distribution are most easily lost, and what replay samples should be prioritized? We address these questions through the modern Hopfield energy. Recent links between modern Hopfield networks (MHNs) and diffusion models allow analyses in MHNs to be transferred to diffusion models. We introduce intrinsic forgetting as an increase in Hopfield energy after the task change. In tractable settings in an MHN, we prove that high-energy, outlier-like samples undergo a larger energy increase than cluster-like samples, implying that samples located in sharp, isolated basins are more forgettable. We further analyze memory replay and show that replay is particularly effective for high-energy samples, enabling an energy-based selection of replay samples. We validate these predictions in experiments on MHNs and two diffusion models under continual-learning settings: Stable Diffusion and a pixel-space DDPM. In these diffusion models, Hopfield energy tracks reconstruction-based forgetting, and replay experiments reveal energy-dependent mitigation of forgetting that is consistent with the MHN analysis.

</details>


### [493] [QuITE: Query-Based Irregular Time Series Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28166)
*JungHoon Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QuITE是一种即插即用的嵌入模块，通过可学习查询令牌和单层自注意力机制聚合不规则多元时间序列观测，无需插值或修改骨干架构，在预测和分类任务中分别取得最高54.7%和15.8%的相对提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有处理不规则多元时间序列的方法要么设计专用架构限制了成熟模型的复用，要么通过插值映射到规则网格上引入人工值扭曲时间动态，亟需一种无需架构修改且不引入人工值的通用嵌入方案。

Method: QuITE模块使用可学习的查询令牌（query tokens），通过单层自注意力机制聚合不规则采样点，直接生成与骨干网络兼容的潜在表示，作为即插即用的嵌入层替代传统均匀采样嵌入。

Result: 在多个真实世界基准数据集上，QuITE在预测任务中平均相对提升达54.7%，分类任务中达15.8%，且适用于多种骨干架构。

Conclusion: 不规则时间序列建模的关键瓶颈在于传统嵌入层假设均匀采样，QuITE通过查询机制有效解决了该问题，验证了输入嵌入设计比骨干架构选择更为关键。

Abstract: Irregular Multivariate Time Series (IMTS) are common in practice, yet their irregular sampling complicates effective modeling. Existing approaches typically either (i) design specialized architectures that limit the reuse of proven Multivariate Time Series (MTS) models, or (ii) map IMTS onto regular temporal grids through interpolation, which may distort temporal dynamics by introducing artificial values. To address these limitations, we propose a new input-embedding-based approach. We identify that the key bottleneck lies not in the backbone architecture, but in conventional embedding layers that assume uniform sampling. In this work, we introduce QuITE (Query-Based Irregular Time Series Embedding), a simple yet effective plug-and-play embedding module for IMTS. QuITE employs learnable query tokens to aggregate irregular observations through a single self-attention layer, directly producing backbone-compatible latent representations without artificial value generation or architectural modification. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks show that QuITE consistently improves MTS models, yielding average relative gains of up to $54.7\%$ in forecasting and $15.8\%$ in classification across diverse datasets and backbone architectures. Code is available at: https://github.com/Meaningfull9502/QuITE.

</details>


### [494] [ProRL: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Recommendation via Rectified Policy Gradient Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28293)
*Hongru Hou,Tiehua Mei,Denghui Geng,Jinhui Huang,Ao Xu,Hengrui Chen,Jiaqing Liang,Deqing Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ProRL框架，通过逐级奖励中心化和位置特定优势估计两种机制，解决了主动推荐系统中策略梯度估计存在的长度依赖偏差和高方差问题，在三个真实数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动推荐系统旨在通过中间推荐路径引导用户偏好转向目标物品，但直接应用策略梯度存在两个缺陷：(1)路径级奖励分解为逐级奖励时存在正均值，产生长度依赖偏差，使梯度偏向路径延伸而非有意义的探索；(2)用整个路径级奖励加权每一步，忽略分解结构，导致梯度方差过高。

Method: 提出ProRL框架，包含两种机制：(1)逐级奖励中心化（Stepwise Reward Centering）——减去期望奖励以中和长度依赖偏差，确保路径延伸产生零期望梯度信号；(2)位置特定优势估计（Position-Specific Advantage Estimation）——利用奖励分解结构计算逐位置基线，降低梯度方差。两者结合使策略梯度精确指向路径质量。

Result: 在三个真实数据集上的实验表明，ProRL显著优于现有的主动推荐系统方法。

Conclusion: 通过修正策略梯度估计中的偏差和方差问题，ProRL能更有效地生成引导用户偏好转移的推荐路径，为主动推荐系统的强化学习应用提供了更优的解决方案。

Abstract: Proactive Recommender Systems (PRSs) aim to guide user preference shift toward target items by generating paths of intermediate recommendations. Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a principled framework for optimizing such sequential decision tasks, as path rewards can naturally capture both short-term acceptance and long-term guidance effectiveness. However, naively applying policy gradients to PRS results in deficient gradient estimation. We identify two deficiencies: (1) path-level rewards decompose into step-level rewards with positive mean, creating a length-dependent bias that causes gradients to favor path extension over meaningful exploration; (2) weighting each step by the entire path-level reward ignores the decomposition structure, leading to high gradient variance. To rectify these two deficiencies, we propose an effective RL framework ProRL with two novel mechanisms for proactive recommendation. First, Stepwise Reward Centering subtracts expected rewards to neutralize length-dependent bias, ensuring that path extension yields zero expected gradient signal. Second, Position-Specific Advantage Estimation leverages the reward decomposition structure to compute step-dependent baselines, reducing gradient variance. Together, these mechanisms yield policy gradients that precisely target path quality. Our experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that ProRL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art PRSs. Our code is available at https://github.com/hongruhou89/ProRL.

</details>


### [495] [LEIA: Learned Environment for Interactive Architected Materials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28368)
*Haiqian Yang,Yuan Cao,Markus J. Buehler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LEIA，一个面向工程化超构材料的交互式世界模型，能够实时响应边界条件并生成变形与应力场；同时引入MicroPlate基准，在两个微结构建模机制下验证LEIA优于基线方法，并展示其在超构材料快速代理引导搜索中的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型虽能处理游戏环境和机器人操作，但真实工程材料具有非线性本构、历史依赖内变量、惯性动力学及多尺度层级结构，传统方法难以实时交互式模拟，亟需一种能处理大规模三维非结构化网格并支持逐步边界条件加载的物理世界模型。

Method: LEIA采用自回归方式逐步骤响应用户指定的加载条件，处理大规模三维非结构化网格；构建MicroPlate基准，涵盖显式微结构解析的晶格板和隐式内变量建模的均质板两种机制；在两种机制下与四种基线方法对比评估。

Result: LEIA在MicroPlate基准的两个机制下均优于四种基线方法；在超构材料新设计搜索中，LEIA能够高效生成候选方案并进行应力精确排序，排序结果经有限元真实验证。

Conclusion: LEIA证明了世界模型可扩展至物理工程领域，为超构材料的实时交互式模拟与数据驱动设计提供了有效工具。

Abstract: World models have enabled interactive exploration of game environments and robotic manipulation, but physical engineering remains beyond their reach: real materials exhibit nonlinear constitutive laws, carry history-dependent internal state, undergo inertial dynamics, and may possess hierarchical structures spanning multiple length scales. We present LEIA (Learned Environment for Interactive Architected materials), a world model that lets engineers apply boundary conditions step by step and observe the resulting deformation and stress fields in real time. LEIA handles large three-dimensional unstructured meshes and generates autoregressive responses to user-specified loading. We introduce MicroPlate, a benchmark of architected plates spanning two regimes of microstructure modeling: architected lattices that resolve microstructure explicitly through three-dimensional geometry, and a homogeneous plate where microstructural change is modeled implicitly through internal degrees of freedom. MicroPlate is used to assess LEIA alongside four baseline methods across both regimes. Finally, we demonstrate that LEIA enables efficient candidate generation and ranking for fast surrogate-guided search for de novo designs of architected materials, with stress-accurate candidate ranking validated by finite element ground truth.

</details>


### [496] [Revisiting Metafeatures to Explain Model Differences on Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28418)
*Markus Herre,Andrej Tschalzev,Sascha Marton,Christian Bartelt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过对TabArena基准测试中51个表格数据集的元特征分析，研究发现：（1）神经网络与树模型之间的性能差距无法用任何元特征解释；（2）非基础模型与基础模型之间的差距存在一个关联但不稳定的元特征；（3）TabICLv2与TabPFN-2.6之间有一个稳健关联。总体而言，全局元特征方法无法稳健解释表格数据集的性能差异，表明表格数据集具有高度异质性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型兴起，但传统模型在许多任务上仍表现良好，选择合适的模型仍然困难。作者希望通过数据集元特征来探究不同模型族之间性能差距的原因，从而为模型选择提供指导。

Method: 基于TabArena基准测试结果，分析数据集层面的性能差距，并将其与模型无关的数据集描述符（元特征）进行关联。采用严格的统计检验（含错误发现率控制），并进行留一数据集（leave-one-dataset-out）预测验证。

Result: (1) 神经网络与树模型差距：无元特征通过错误发现率控制；(2) 非基础模型与基础模型差距：一个关联稳健但无法泛化到留一数据集预测；(3) TabICLv2与TabPFN-2.6差距：一个稳健关联能改进留出集预测。整体上，元特征预测器未能比简单基线有实质性改进。

Conclusion: 表格数据集具有高度异质性，全局元特征方法不够稳健，无法在51个TabArena数据集上提供有说服力的解释。

Abstract: With the rise of tabular foundation models alongside traditional models still performing well on many tasks, choosing the right model for a tabular dataset remains difficult. We investigate whether dataset meta-features can explain performance gaps between model families on tabular prediction tasks. Using the TabArena benchmark results, we analyze dataset-level performance gaps and relate them to model-agnostic dataset descriptors. After strict statistical tests with false discovery control, we find that (1) for neural network vs. tree gaps, no meta-feature survives false discovery control, (2) for non-foundation vs. foundation model gaps, one association is robust but does not generalize when tested in leave-one-dataset-out prediction, and (3) for TabICLv2 vs. TabPFN-2.6, one robust association also improves held-out prediction. Furthermore, we conduct a leave-one-dataset-out analysis and find that meta-feature predictors fail to improve meaningfully over a simple baseline. Overall, our results show the heterogeneity of tabular datasets and that global meta-feature approaches are not robust enough to offer explanations on the 51 TabArena datasets.

</details>


### [497] [Stage-wise Distortion-Perception Traversal in Zero-shot Inverse Problems with Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28711)
*Jiawei Zhang,Ziyuan Liu,Leon Yan,Zhenyu Xiao,Yuantao Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MAP-RPS框架，通过最大后验估计阶段和重噪声后验采样阶段，实现使用单个扩散模型在零样本逆问题中灵活遍历失真-感知权衡，并扩展至潜在空间得到LMAP-RPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管扩散模型在零样本逆问题求解中取得了成功，但如何以高效且原則性的方式在扩散逆算法中实现失真-感知权衡（D-P tradeoff）的灵活遍历仍缺乏充分研究。

Method: 提出MAP-RPS框架，包含两个阶段：1) MAP估计阶段，近似MMSE解并提供低失真初始化；2) 重噪声后验采样阶段，逐步提升感知质量。进一步扩展至潜在空间得到LMAP-RPS，利用大规模预训练潜在扩散骨干网络。

Result: 实验表明MAP-RPS和LMAP-RPS在各种任务上实现了更有效的D-P遍历，同时作为真实世界逆问题的高效求解器展现出强劲性能。

Conclusion: 本文提出的两阶段框架能够在零样本逆问题中有效遍历失真-感知权衡，且理论分析验证了设计的有效性，潜在空间扩展增强了方法的适用性。

Abstract: The distortion-perception (D-P) tradeoff is a fundamental phenomenon of Bayesian inverse problems, which characterizes the inherent tension between distortion performance and perceptual quality. Enabling flexible traversal of the D-P tradeoff at inference time is crucial for practical applications. Despite the recent success of diffusion models in zero-shot inverse problem solving, efficient and principled strategies for D-P traversal in diffusion-based inverse algorithms remain inadequately characterized. In this paper, we propose a stage-wise framework for realizing D-P traversal using a single diffusion model in zero-shot inverse problems. Our proposed method, termed MAP-RPS, starts with an MAP estimation stage that approximates the MMSE solution and provides a low-distortion initialization, followed by a re-noised posterior sampling stage that progressively improves perceptual quality. We provide theoretical analyses for both stages, establishing the validity and effectiveness of the proposed design. Furthermore, we extend MAP-RPS to the latent space, yielding LMAP-RPS, which enjoys broader applicability by leveraging large-scale pre-trained latent diffusion backbones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAP-RPS and LMAP-RPS enable more effective D-P traversal on various tasks, while also exhibiting strong performance as efficient solvers for real-world inverse problems.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [498] [Human-in-the-Loop Swarms: A Bionic Swarm Approach to Real-World Soil Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29091)
*Petras Swissler,Mohammadali Rashidioun,Nicholas Sahu,Raaid Kabir,Ayodeji Aderibigbe,Oladoyin Kolawole*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"Bionic Swarm"系统，通过人类介入回路的方式降低群体机器人和现场机器人研究的准入门槛，并验证了一种名为Score-Biased-Search的地理搜索算法在真实室外环境中的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 群体机器人和现场机器人领域因硬件部署成本高、开发周期长，导致真实世界验证面临重大障碍，亟需一种低成本、低门槛的验证方法。

Method: 提出Bionic Swarm系统：将难以在机器人上实现但非算法核心的任务抽象化，交由人类用户通过智能手机网页应用执行；蓝牙传感器采集数据并上传至中央服务器运行群体算法，服务器再将指令下发至人类用户。同时提出Score-Biased-Search算法，通过给重建地图上的每个位置打分，将搜索模式偏向高期望得分区域。

Result: Score-Biased-Search算法在仿真中表现出相对于搜索智能体数量的超线性地图重建速度；通过Bionic Swarm平台在真实室外环境中成功验证了该算法的有效性。

Conclusion: 人机协同（人类介入回路）的方法显著降低了现场机器人和群体机器人研究的准入门槛，为低成本实物验证提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Swarm and field robotics face significant barriers to real-world validation due to the high cost and development time to deploy hardware. This paper introduces the ``Bionic Swarm,'' a novel system that lowers these barriers by abstracting away many of the tasks that are difficult to implement on robots but which do not contribute to the overall algorithm evaluation, giving these tasks to human users. These human users take directions from a smartphone web-app that takes measurements from Bluetooth-connected sensors and relays them to a centralized server. This server runs the swarm algorithm and directs actions to the human users. We evaluate this system through the experimental validation of a geotechnically-focused search algorithm named Score-Biased-Search, which functions by assigning a ``score'' to each location on a reconstructed map, then biases search patterns through areas of higher expected scores, and which exhibits superlinear map reconstruction relative to the number of search agents. After presenting simulation results for the algorithm, we then apply the algorithm on the Bionic Swarm platform to validate its function in a real-world, outdoor setting. This work demonstrates that this human-in-the-loop approach significantly lowers the barrier to entry for field and swarm robotics research.

</details>


### [499] [Multi-Resolution End-to-End Deep Neural Network for Optimizing Latency-Accuracy Tradeoff in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29138)
*Qitao Weng,Heechul Yun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多分辨率端到端CNN，通过每分辨率批归一化和分辨率重定向技术，在CARLA自动驾驶场景中根据延迟预算动态选择最优输入分辨率，相比固定分辨率基线显著提升了车道入侵、闯红灯和碰撞等安全指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DNN在自动驾驶等实时应用中存在延迟-精度权衡问题，固定分辨率模型在场景上下文和计算资源变化时变得次优，需要一种能根据运行时条件动态调整输入分辨率的方案。

Method: 采用多分辨率端到端CNN，通过每分辨率批归一化支持运行时在延迟预算下选择理想输入尺度，并引入分辨率重定向技术实现无需原始训练数据集的多分辨率训练。

Result: 在CARLA城市驾驶挑战中，相比固定分辨率基线，多分辨率方法在每路线安全指标（车道入侵、闯红灯、碰撞）上取得一致改进。

Conclusion: 考虑延迟时，最优网络配置随场景上下文和计算可用性动态变化；多分辨率方法能有效探索延迟-安全前沿，提升自动驾驶系统的实时安全性。

Abstract: Latency-accuracy tradeoffs are fundamental in real-time applications of deep neural networks (DNNs) for cyber-physical systems. In autonomous driving, in particular, safety depends on both prediction quality and the end-to-end delay from sensing to actuation. We observe that (1) when latency is accounted for, the latency-optimal network configuration varies with scene context and compute availability; and (2) a single fixed-resolution model becomes suboptimal as conditions change.
  We present a multi-resolution, end-to-end deep neural network for the CARLA urban driving challenge using monocular camera input. Our approach employs a convolutional neural network (CNN) that supports multiple input resolutions through per-resolution batch normalization, enabling runtime selection of an ideal input scale under a latency budget, as well as resolution retargeting, which allows multi-resolution training without access to the original training dataset.
  We implement and evaluate our multi-resolution end-to-end CNN in CARLA to explore the latency-safety frontier. Results show consistent improvements in per-route safety metrics - lane invasions, red-light infractions, and collisions - relative to fixed-resolution baselines.

</details>


### [500] [Learning and Adaptation in Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing Bead Geometry Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29144)
*Chen-Lung Lu,John Wen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于循环神经网络和一步预测控制的数据驱动方法，用于机器人电弧增材制造过程中的焊道高度和宽度控制。通过在线更新模型以适应热条件变化，实验证明该方法在高度和宽度一致性上优于恒定输入和静态模型基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人WAAM过程由复杂非线性热-几何耦合动力学支配，传统方法难以有效处理多输入/多输出（MIMO）系统的过程控制，亟需数据驱动的鲁棒调控方案。

Method: 使用简单循环神经网络（RNN）架构从输入/输出数据学习过程模型，结合一步预测控制策略进行焊道规划与控制；通过前一层预测误差在线更新学习模型以适应热条件变化。

Result: 在集成线扫描反馈的机器人WAAM实验平台上，所提方法在高度和宽度一致性方面相比恒定输入和静态模型基线取得了显著改进。

Conclusion: 提出的学习和自适应框架为增材制造过程的数据驱动鲁棒调控提供了一条实用路径。

Abstract: Robotics Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM) is governed by complex and nonlinear process dynamics coupling thermal field to the build geometry. The process may be regarded as a multi-input/multi-output dynamical system with welding torch speed and wire feed rate as inputs and weld bead deposition height and width as outputs. In this paper, we use the input/output data to learn a data-driven model and use it for weld planning and control. We show that a simple recurrent neural network architecture and one-step-ahead predictive control can improve the process performance in terms of height and width consistency. To account for the changing thermal conditions during the printing process, we update the learning model using prediction error from the previous layer. This adaptation step further improves the prediction accuracy and controller performance. Experiments on a robotic WAAM testbed with integrated line-scanner feedback significant improvements in height and width consistency compared to constant input and static model baselines. The proposed learning and adaptation framework provides a practical pathway toward robust, data-driven regulation of additive manufacturing processes.

</details>


### [501] [CA-AC-MPC: CUDA-Accelerated Actor-Critic Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29155)
*Antoonio Buo,Vittorio Cammarota,Michele Avagnale,Pierluigi Arpenti,Vincenzo Lippiello,Fabio Ruggiero*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种CUDA加速的AC-MPC变体，通过加速优化求解过程显著减少训练和推理延迟，同时保持基线方法的控制性能。在敏捷无人机竞速任务中实现了最先进的圈速和接近极限的动态行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AC-MPC的可微MPC层在前向和反向传播中需要重复求解优化问题，导致严重的训练和推理延迟，成为其实际部署的瓶颈。

Method: 引入CUDA加速技术，对AC-MPC中的可微MPC层进行并行化加速，减少端到端执行时间。

Result: 在敏捷无人机竞速任务中，该方法实现了最先进的圈速和接近极限的动态行为，同时训练和推理时间显著减少。

Conclusion: CUDA加速能够有效解决AC-MPC的计算瓶颈，在保持控制性能的同时大幅提升效率。

Abstract: In the literature, actor-critic model predictive control (AC-MPC) integrates MPC with reinforcement learning to enable high-performance control of complex dynamical systems. However, its differentiable MPC layer requires repeatedly solving an optimization problem in both the forward and backward passes, leading to substantial training and inference latency. This paper tackles this bottleneck introducing a CUDA-accelerated variant that significantly reduces end-to-end execution time while preserving the control performance of the baseline formulation. Simulation results on an agile drone racing task show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art lap times and near-limit dynamic behaviour with markedly reduced training and inference time.

</details>


### [502] [Extreme dynamic symmetry enables omnidirectional and multifunctional robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29254)
*Jiaxun Liu,Boxi Xia,Boyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"动态对称性"概念，通过量化机器人质心加速度均匀性（动态各向同性），证明在超过1000种模拟形态中高动态对称性持续改善轨迹跟踪、任务成功率、鲁棒性和能效。开发了Argus系列球形机器人（含物理20腿原型），实现接近极限的动态各向同性，展示了方向无关运动、复杂地形穿越、快速自稳定及抗故障能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对称性在自然系统中是核心组织原则，但机器人领域仅局限于几何形态层面的应用。作者希望将对称性提升到动态驱动能力层面，探索其对机器人性能的统一性影响。

Method: 提出动态对称性（dynamic symmetry）概念，通过动态各向同性（dynamic isotropy）度量机器人质心加速度的均匀性。在1000+模拟形态中验证性能，开发Argus系列球形机器人（径向线性驱动器构型），构建物理20腿原型实现近极端动态各向同性。

Result: 高动态对称性一致改善轨迹跟踪、任务成功、鲁棒性、弹性和能效，极限状态效益最显著。20腿Argus原型实现方向无关运动、杂乱/可变形地形敏捷穿越、快速自稳定、部分执行器故障抵抗、分布式感知实现全向感知和物体交互。

Conclusion: 设计机器人在形态和可达动力学层面的对称性，为在不确定陆地与地外环境中实现敏捷性、鲁棒性和多功能性提供通用路径。

Abstract: Symmetry is a central organizing principle in natural systems, yet its use as a unifying design strategy in robotics has largely remained limited to geometric form. We show that symmetry can instead be leveraged at the level of dynamic actuation capability. We introduce dynamic symmetry, the uniformity of a robot's attainable center-of-mass accelerations, and formalize it through a measure coined as dynamic isotropy. Across more than 1000 simulated morphologies, we found that higher dynamic symmetry consistently improved trajectory tracking, task success, robustness, resiliency, and energy efficiency, with the benefits becoming most pronounced as dynamic isotropy approached its theoretical limit. To study this regime systematically, we developed Argus, a family of spherical robots designed to explore the effects of increasing dynamic symmetry. Members of the Argus family vary in their actuation geometry and dynamic symmetry level while sharing a common architectural principle: radially oriented linear actuators that directly shape the robot's center-of-mass dynamics. Among them, we built a physical 20-leg Argus variant that achieved near-extreme dynamic isotropy and demonstrated orientation-invariant locomotion, agile traversal of cluttered and deformable terrain, rapid self-stabilization, and resilience to partial actuator failures. Its distributed sensing further enabled omnidirectional perception and object interaction during continuous motion. These results show that designing robots for symmetry not only in morphology but also in their attainable dynamics provides a powerful and general pathway toward agility, robustness, and multifunctionality in uncertain terrestrial and extraterrestrial environments.

</details>


### [503] [MonoDuo: Using One Robot Arm to Learn Bimanual Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29298)
*Sandeep Bajamahal,Lawrence Yunliang Chen,Toru Lin,Zehan Ma,Jitendra Malik,Ken Goldberg*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MonoDuo提出了一种利用单臂机器人演示数据训练双臂机器人策略的框架。通过人机协作收集单臂数据，结合手部姿态估计、图像分割与修复技术生成合成演示，实现从单臂到双臂的零样本策略迁移，并在五项任务中取得高达70%的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂协调操作至关重要，但双臂机器人和数据集的稀缺限制了双臂策略的学习；而单臂机器人在实验室中广泛可用，因此探索如何利用单臂机器人数据训练双臂策略。

Method: (1) 通过遥操作单臂机器人执行任务一侧、人类执行另一侧，然后交换角色收集数据；(2) 利用手部姿态估计、图像和点云分割及修复技术，将RGB-D观测增强为针对目标双臂机器人的合成演示；(3) 基于这些合成演示训练双臂策略。

Result: 在五项任务上评估，相比仅依赖人类双臂视频的方法，MonoDuo实现了对未见双臂机器人配置的零样本部署，成功率最高达70%；仅需25条目标机器人演示进行少样本微调，成功率相比从头训练提升65-70%。

Conclusion: MonoDuo有效实现了从单臂机器人数据到双臂机器人策略的知识迁移，证明了该方法的有效性。

Abstract: Bimanual coordination is essential for many real-world manipulation tasks, yet learning bimanual robot policies is limited by the scarcity of bimanual robots and datasets. Single-arm robots, however, are widely available in research labs. Can we leverage them to train bimanual robot policies? We present MonoDuo, a framework for learning bimanual manipulation policies using single-arm robot demonstrations paired with human collaboration. MonoDuo collects data by teleoperating a single-arm robot to perform one side of a bimanual task while a human performs the other, then swapping roles to cover both sides. RGB-D observations from a wrist-mounted and fixed camera are augmented into synthetic demonstrations for target bimanual robots using state-of-the-art hand pose estimation, image and point cloud segmentation, and inpainting. These synthetic demonstrations, grounded in real robot kinematics, are used to train bimanual policies. We evaluate MonoDuo on five tasks: box lifting, backpack packing, cloth folding, jacket zipping, and plate handover. Compared to approaches relying solely on human bimanual videos, MonoDuo enables zero-shot deployment on unseen bimanual robot configurations, achieving success rates up to 70%. With only 25 target robot demonstrations, few-shot finetuning further boosts success rates by 65-70% over training from scratch, demonstrating MonoDuo's effectiveness in efficiently transferring knowledge from single-arm robot data to bimanual robot policies.

</details>


### [504] [The Open Motion Planning Library 2.0](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29301)
*Weihang Guo,Theodoros Tyrovouzis,Emiliano Flores,Clayton W. Ramsey,Zachary K. Kingston,Ioan A. Şucan,Mark Moll,Lydia E. Kavraki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OMPL 2.0 是在近二十年发展基础上的重大升级，面向实时运动规划，支持硬件加速和现代AI研究工作流，并回顾了该库与运动规划领域的协同发展历程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自2008年首次发布以来，OMPL已成为运动规划社区的基础工具，但随着实时运动规划和AI研究需求的增长，原有架构需要重大升级以满足新一代应用场景。

Method: 在原有广泛采样算法库的基础上，OMPL 2.0引入了硬件加速机制以实现实时运动规划，并集成现代AI研究工作流接口，同时扩展了新的规划器、状态空间和问题形式化（如渐近最优规划、延迟规划、约束运动规划、时序逻辑目标规划等）。

Result: OMPL 2.0成功实现了面向实时运动规划的硬件加速能力，并与AI研究生态无缝对接，同时保持了其作为运动规划社区标准库的地位。

Conclusion: OMPL与运动规划领域在过去近二十年中共同成长，该库对研究社区产生了广泛而深远的影响；OMPL 2.0的发布标志着运动规划库向实时化和智能化方向的重要演进。

Abstract: The Open Motion Planning Library (OMPL), first released in 2008, has become a cornerstone of the motion planning community, providing implementations of a wide range of state-of-the-art sampling-based algorithms. Over almost two decades of continuous development, we have steadily expanded the library with new planners, state spaces, and problem formulations. These additions range from asymptotically optimal and lazy planners to constrained motion planning and planning with temporal-logic goals. Building on this foundation, we introduce OMPL 2.0, a major evolution of the library that targets real-time motion planning through hardware acceleration and integrates seamlessly with modern AI research workflows. We also reflect on how OMPL and the field of motion planning have grown together over the years, and discuss the library's broader impact on the research community.

</details>


### [505] [Decentralized LLM-Driven Coordination of Acoustic Robots for Contactless Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29378)
*Yingying Wang,Narsimlu Kemsaram,Sriram Subramanian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种去中心化框架，通过Whisper语音识别、LLM语义解析和JSON任务表示，将自然语言指令转换为分布式声学机器人的无接触物操作业，在TurtleBot3平台上实现了最高96%的任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究尚未充分探索将大语言模型与分布式声学移动机器人结合，以支持非专业用户通过自然语言指挥多机器人系统进行无接触物体操控。

Method: 采用Whisper进行语音识别，LLM进行语义解析生成结构化JSON任务表示（包含机器人分配、时间依赖、空间约束和同步需求），再通过分布式调度器协调执行；系统部署于两台配备超声相控阵的TurtleBot3机器人上。

Result: 在顺序执行、并行多机器人运输和同步协同操作三个场景中，任务成功率分别为96%、86%和70%。

Conclusion: 自然语言指令可有效转化为分布式机器人动作以实现无接触操作，LLM驱动的自动化在分布式机器人系统的人机交互中具有显著潜力。

Abstract: Natural language interfaces can simplify interaction with multi-robot systems, especially when non-expert users need to issue high-level commands. Acoustic manipulation using ultrasonic phased arrays also enables contactless object handling for applications such as healthcare, laboratory automation, and precision transport. However, combining large language models (LLMs) with distributed acoustic mobile robots remains underexplored. This paper presents a decentralized framework for natural language-driven coordination of acoustic robots for contactless object manipulation. The system converts spoken instructions into executable multi-robot task plans using Whisper-based speech recognition, LLM-based semantic parsing, structured JSON task representation, and distributed scheduling. The JSON schema encodes robot assignments, temporal dependencies, spatial constraints, and synchronization requirements for sequential, parallel, and synchronized execution. The system is implemented on two TurtleBot3-based acoustic robots, each equipped with an ultrasonic phased array for contactless object transport. Experiments were conducted in three scenarios: sequential execution, parallel multi-robot transport, and synchronized cooperative manipulation. The system achieved task success rates of 96 percent for sequential tasks, 86 percent for parallel execution, and 70 percent for synchronized collaborative transport. These results show that natural language commands can be transformed into distributed robot actions for contactless manipulation, highlighting the potential of LLM-driven automation for human-robot interaction in distributed robotic systems.

</details>


### [506] [Phase-Conditioned Imitation Learning with Autonomous Failure Recovery for Robust Deformable Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29407)
*Dayuan Chen,Kai Tang,Yukuan Zhang,Kazuhiro Kosuge,Yasuhisa Hirata*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种相位条件化、力觉感知的鲁棒可变形物体操作框架（PhaseR），通过FiLM调节的ACT编码器、多模态相位预测器和混合阻抗控制器，在双臂挂/脱T恤任务中将成功率从56%提升至87%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准模仿学习策略（如ACT）在推理时依赖马尔可夫假设，导致视觉相似但需要矛盾动作的观测出现状态混叠，且无法自主从执行失败中恢复。

Method: 1）FiLM调节的ACT编码器：根据当前任务相位调制特征提取，实现单一策略内相位特定行为；2）多模态相位预测器：融合视觉、力觉和位姿反馈实时估计相位，检测接触失败并触发恢复轨迹；3）混合阻抗控制器：保证柔顺执行；4）触觉遥操作接口：用于力觉感知数据采集。

Result: 消融实验表明FiLM调制显著优于无条件和token级条件基线；t-SNE分析显示FiLM诱导了分离良好的相位特定特征表示；闭环系统在双臂挂T恤任务中成功率从56%提升至87%。

Conclusion: 通过结合相位条件化、力觉反馈和自主错误恢复，该框架有效解决了可变形物体操作中的状态混叠和失败恢复问题，显著提升了Robustness。

Abstract: This paper presents a phase-conditioned, force-aware framework for robust deformable object manipulation. Standard imitation learning policies such as Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) rely on a Markovian assumption at inference, causing state aliasing when visually similar observations require contradictory actions and preventing autonomous recovery from execution failures. We address this with a closed-loop hierarchical architecture. A FiLM-conditioned ACT encoder modulates feature extraction based on the current task phase, enabling a single unified policy to produce phase-specific behaviors while sharing action dynamics across phases. A multi-modal phase predictor fusing visual, force, and pose feedback estimates the phase in real time, detecting contact failures that are invisible to vision alone and autonomously triggering recovery trajectories. The system is completed by a hybrid impedance controller for compliant execution and a haptic teleoperation interface for force-aware data collection. Ablation studies show that FiLM-based modulation significantly outperforms both unconditioned and token-level conditioned baselines, and t-SNE analysis confirms that FiLM induces well-separated, phase-specific feature representations. Validated on hanging and removing a T-shirt with dual arms, the closed-loop system improves the hanging success rate from 56\% to 87\% through autonomous error recovery. Code and videos: https://leledeyuan00.github.io/phaser/

</details>


### [507] [A Progress-Aware Leader-Follower Midair Docking System for Dual-Drone Aerial Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29410)
*Yifan Cai,Jan Ming Kevin Tan,Xiangqi Li,Chenzhe Jin,Narsimlu Kemsaram,Valerio Modugno*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种双无人机空中对接平台，采用主从编队和被动磁锁紧模块，实现轻量化、可重复的小型无人机空中对接，并集成了完整的软硬件栈和基准评估系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型无人机空中对接是实现模块化空中协同与操作的关键技术，但面临精确相对位姿控制、推力与有效载荷约束紧张、以及需要可重复对接平台的挑战，现有工作缺乏系统化、可基准测试的解决方案。

Method: 采用主从编队架构，设计轻量化模块化框架配合被动磁锁紧机构实现对接；提出进度感知任务管理器管理四个阶段（接近、对齐、捕获、稳定）；集成ROS 2与Crazyflie/PX4接口的完整软硬件栈，并实现同步日志记录用于基准评估。

Result: 在仿真和真实实验中，使用编队误差、基线偏航一致性、对接成功率、对接时间及失败模式统计等定量指标对平台进行了全面评估，验证了平台的有效性和可重复性。

Conclusion: 该平台为模块化空中协同和可重复空中对接操作提供了实用的测试床，支持对接监督与同步策略的统计性比较，为小型无人机空中对接研究建立了可基准化的评估标准。

Abstract: Reliable midair docking between small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is essential for modular aerial cooperation and manipulation, but it requires precise relative-pose control and repeatable platform under tight thrust and payload constraints. We present a dual-drone docking platform where two quadrotors operate in a leader-follower formation and dock using a lightweight modular frame with passive magnetic latching. A progress-aware mission supervisor manages phase transitions: approach, alignment, capture, and settle. This platform integrates a complete hardware-software stack (ROS 2 with Crazyflie/PX4 interfaces) and synchronized logging for benchmark evaluation. We evaluate the platform in simulation and real-world experiments using quantitative metrics such as formation error, baseline and yaw consistency, docking success rate, time-to-dock, and failure-mode statistics. The platform enables statistically grounded comparison of docking supervision and synchronization strategies and provides a practical testbed for modular aerial cooperation and repeatable midair aerial manipulation.

</details>


### [508] [3DVLA: Enhancing Vision-Language-Action Models via 3D Spatial and Instance Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29416)
*Zhongyu Xia,Yousen Tang,Bingqing Wei,Yongtao Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 3DVLA是一个即插即用框架，通过引入多视图一致性的3D特征编码、实例估计模块和自监督3D编码分支，为预训练视觉-语言-动作模型注入3D场景理解能力，在机器人操作任务中显著提升性能且无需额外标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型缺乏3D场景理解，表现为三个相互关联的缺陷：弱3D空间位置提取（无多视图一致性约束）、不足的3D实例理解、以及遮挡下的脆弱推理。直接将成熟3D感知方法集成到VLA中面临架构不兼容和对昂贵实例级标注的依赖。

Method: (1) 含显式多视图一致性约束的全模态3D特征编码与空间条件几何聚合方法；(2) 基于高层实例token的实例估计模块实现3D实例感知；(3) 掩码自监督3D编码分支（保留预测器用于视觉token补全）处理遮挡。

Result: 在LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0数据集上与多个VLA基线集成，操作性能取得一致且显著的提升，验证了有效性和即插即用兼容性。

Conclusion: 3DVLA有效弥补了VLA模型缺失的3D场景理解能力，即插即用且无需额外人工标注，为提升机器人操作性能提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models have achieved remarkable progress in robotic manipulation, yet they suffer from a critical limitation: a lack of 3D scene understanding. This deficiency manifests as three intertwined challenges: weak extraction of 3D spatial positions without enforcing multi-view consistency, inadequate 3D instance understanding, and fragile reasoning under occlusion. Although mature 3D perception methods exist, their direct integration into VLA pipelines is hindered by architectural incompatibility and by heavy reliance on costly instance-level annotations. To address the above challenges, we propose 3DVLA, a plug-and-play framework that injects robust 3D reasoning into pretrained VLAs without requiring extra manual labels or discarding VLM priors. Specifically, 3DVLA tackles the three challenges through: (1) pervasive 3D feature encoding with explicit multi-view consistency constraints across all modalities and a Spatially-Conditioned Geometry Aggregation method, (2) an instance estimation module with high-level instance tokens for 3D instance awareness, and (3) a masked self-supervised 3D encoding branch that retains its predictor for visual token completion to handle occlusions. We integrate 3DVLA with multiple VLA baselines and evaluate on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0. Results show consistent and significant gains in manipulation performance, validating both the effectiveness and plug-and-play compatibility of our approach.

</details>


### [509] [ElegantVLA: Learning When to Think for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29438)
*Ye Li,Huanan Liu,Kangye Ji,Yuan Meng,Jiajun Fan,Yuansong Wang,Shiyu Qin,Chenglei Wu,Shu-Tao Xia,Zhi Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ElegantVLA提出了一种相位自适应推理框架，通过动态计算调度（视觉编码器、LLM、动作头）来加速VLA模型，在不修改基础模型的情况下，在GR00T和CogACT上实现最高3.77倍加速，并将控制频率从13.8 Hz提升至26.3 Hz。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型计算成本高、控制频率低，难以满足实时机器人操控需求；现有加速方法通常优化单一组件或使用固定加速规则，忽视了顺序具身控制中不同控制步骤的非均匀推理需求。受人类运动控制启发，VLA模型应学会何时投入完整计算、何时复用先前计算。

Method: 提出ElegantVLA，一种即插即用的相位自适应推理框架。引入轻量级调度器，通过观测时序表征相似性、机器人运动线索和任务进度，联合分配视觉编码器、LLM和动作头的计算资源。感知-语言推理阶段：基于视觉-语言表征稳定性选择五级Vision-LLM计算模式（从完全重计算到多步时序复用）。动作生成阶段：选择三级去噪模式，稳定运动时复用中间去噪状态，目标敏感阶段保留完整精炼。

Result: 在GR00T和CogACT上分别实现2.55倍和3.77倍加速；在6项真实世界GR00T任务中，计算量降低2.18倍，控制频率从13.8 Hz提升至26.3 Hz。

Conclusion: ElegantVLA是一种通用加速框架，适用于现代具有显式动作生成模块的VLA流水线，无需修改或重训练基础模型，通过动态计算调度有效平衡了计算效率与操控性能。
